title: Cost Analyst
description:
About the role

As a Cost Analyst at Avery Dennison, you will play a critical role in evaluating financial data, operational costs, and product profitability to support key business decisions. You will work closely with finance, operations, and supply chain teams to analyze manufacturing costs, identify variance drivers, and implement continuous improvement opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

This role is offered on a hybrid basis from our Saray location.

  • Conduct monthly product costing, inventory valuation, and variance analysis to evaluate operational efficiency.
  • Monitor standard vs. actual production costs and identify key cost drivers across manufacturing lines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive enterprise lean sigma initiatives and cost optimization projects.
  • Prepare comprehensive cost reports, forecasts, and financial analyses for management decision-making.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and group financial policies.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Cost Analyst, Financial Analyst, or similar role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., Oracle or SAP) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Skills you need to succeed:

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into actionable insights.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional departments in a dynamic environment.

What we offer

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

  • Financial & Health Benefits: We offer Health insurance and various allowances, including Social, Food, Bairam, Meal, Shuttle, and Heating allowances.
  • Time Off: Enjoy a minimum of 16 days of Annual Leave (increasing with seniority) and we also provide specific paid leave for life events.
  • Continuous Development: We invest in your growth with individually set-up development plans, access to language courses, and various internal trainings.
  • Flexible Work & Well-being: Hybrid work options (for most roles).
  • Community Engagement: Opportunities to participate in volunteer activities to support Non-Profit Organizations.

title: European Graduate Program - Operations / Lean Manufacturing
description:
About the role

Kickstart your career with a high-impact, two-year international rotational program designed to shape future leaders in manufacturing, lean operations, and digital transformation. Your first 12-month rotation is based in Oegstgeest, Netherlands, followed by an international assignment at one of our European production sites in Year 2.

We will empower you to quickly take on responsibilities while exploring all facets of our business. You will contribute to both daily operational management and strategic manufacturing projects. Beyond technical expertise, you will develop strong communication and leadership skills essential for driving sustainable continuous improvement and leaving a lasting mark on our sites.

In your first year, you will step into a key role as a Core Team Member for the Ignite Movement - an organizational initiative driving a growth mindset, curiosity, and continuous improvement across the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Connect and align core operational streams across Training, Management, Design, and Communication.
  • Manage and optimize shared digital platforms and resource hubs for our growing internal community.
  • Partner with Movement Leads to design engaging training materials, digital tools, and interactive workshops.
  • Apply Lean methodologies to test, refine, and elevate day-to-day manufacturing workflows.
  • Explore and integrate digital tools, basic scripts, and emerging AI technologies to streamline operational processes.

Wondering what your career path will look like after completion of the program?

We are committed to your long-term career and will remain in close contact with you throughout your journey. As the end of the program approaches, we will discuss options for a permanent role, ensuring we align your talents with the needs of our organization.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Production, or General Engineering (or equivalent).
  • Initial practical exposure (internships, co-ops, or academic projects), ideally within an international manufacturing environment.

  • Foundational knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, or Lean Six Sigma tools.

Further skills you will need to succeed:

  • Digital Aptitude: Proficiency in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs). Basic coding knowledge (JavaScript, HTML, CSS for Apps Script) and an interest in AI workplace tools are strong pluses.
  • An autonomous, proactive approach with a passion for experimentation and problem-solving
  • Outstanding interpersonal and strong organizational skills, with a genuine passion for collaborating with people across different teams.

title: Project Leader to AFRYs Nordic Real Estate & Workplace department
description:
The Project Leader is responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering workplace and real estate projects across the Nordic region, including lease-related matters, change initiatives and workplace transformation projects.

The role works closely with Real Estate, business stakeholders and external partners across the Nordic countries, ensuring delivery in line with scope, timeline and budget. Projects may be delivered in countries other than where the Project Leader is based.

    • Define project scope, timelines, budgets and deliverables
    • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards
    • Identify and manage risks, dependencies and critical path
  • Lease negotiation & regulatory processes
    • Support and lead lease negotiations in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
    • Manage matters related to rent reviews, lease extensions and terminations
    • Represent or support cases in the Rent Tribunal when required
    • Ensure compliance with legal and contractual obligations
  • Change Management & implementation
    • Drive change management initiatives linked to workplace transformation
    • Ensure successful adoption of new ways of working, workplace concepts and policies
    • Develop and execute communication and engagement plans for stakeholders
    • Support business leaders through transition phases
  • Stakeholder management
    • Act as a credible and trusted advisor towards business stakeholders
    • Manage expectations in a complex organization with multiple stakeholders and opinions
    • Facilitate decision-making through structured dialogue and clear communication
    • Build strong relationships across functions, regions and seniority levels
  • Workplace expertise & advisory
    • Knowledge within workplace strategy, portfolio management and workplace design principles
    • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of workplace and portfolio strategies
    • Ensure projects align with defined workplace principles and long-term portfolio direction
    • Translate project learnings into actionable insights to strengthen future strategy development
  • Strategic Development & Governance
    • Contribute to the development of future workplace, portfolio and governance frameworks
    • Support the establishment of common standards, processes and decision-making structures across regions
    • Identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous development of Real Estate & Workplace practices
    • Provide expert input to strategic initiatives, business cases and portfolio decisions
  • Governance, reporting & communication
    • Ensure projects follow internal governance, approval processes and policies
    • Track and manage project budgets, forecasts and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle
    • Provide structured reporting on progress, risks and financials
    • Prepare decision material for senior stakeholders when required
  • At least 7-10 years of experience within workplace, corporate real estate, facilities management, or related disciplines, including responsibility for complex projects and strategic advisory.
  • Project management within workplace, real estate or similar field
  • Understanding of workplace and real estate portfolio strategy, with ability to contribute to strategic development
  • Experience in lease negotiations and understanding of tenancy law / rent tribunal processes
  • Experience leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, locations and business functions.
  • Experience of delivering projects across the Nordic countries, including projects outside the employee’s country of residence, is considered an advantage.
  • Strong stakeholder management in complex organizations
  • Experience within change management and workplace transformation
  • Financial understanding related to projects and leases

This is an internal role within AFRY, working closely with business stakeholders and support functions to develop and deliver workplace and real estate solutions for AFRY's own operations rather than external clients.

Mindset & behaviors

  • High credibility and strong communication skills
  • Structured, solution-oriented and accountable
  • Comfortable operating in large and complex organizations
  • Proactive team player with collaborative approach
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and multiple opinions

At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

title: Environmental Geochemist
description:
INTERMEDIATE GEOCHEMIST
Sudbury, ON.

Are you looking for an opportunity to…

Leave a positive impact on the environment through progressive design?
Work in a close-knit group of motivated professionals?
Focus on continued growth and development?
Develop your critical thinking skills?
Develop a career that provides a mix of local and global projects?

What makes us stand out?

Our tag line “Down to Earth / Up to the Challenge” says a lot about who we are. In broad terms, we think KCB’s primary differentiators are:

our global reputation for technical excellence
our appetite to tackle problems with unique complexities
our creative perspectives that come through diverse and inclusive teams
our size, large enough to win intriguing projects, small enough to know you by name
everyone maintains a technical focus

What you would engage in:

Our focus is on the application of critical thinking to the management of mine waste and water. If continuing your career journey with us, you would be part of our Mining Environmental Group, based out our Sudbury office. The role of Geochemist comes with the flexibility to work a hybrid schedule and will provide you with the opportunity to:

Conduct geochemical analyses of soil, rock, and water samples to assess environmental impact and identify potential risks associated with mining activities.
Develop and implement geochemical models to predict long-term trends and assess the effectiveness of mitigation measures.
Provide technical expertise and strategic advice to clients on geochemical aspects of mining projects, including waste management, acid rock drainage, and water treatment.
Collaborate with engineers, geologists, and environmental scientists to design and implement monitoring programs and remediation strategies.
Prepare comprehensive reports, presentations, and regulatory submissions to communicate findings and recommendations to clients and regulatory authorities.
Stay current with industry developments, and best practices in geochemistry.
Lead less experienced staff through the methodologies of TSF design solutions

What we require:

We respect the knowledge and experience you have gained to date and are willing to help you build on it. We do however require the following qualifications:

A degree in Geochemistry, Environmental Science, or related field, master’s degree preferred.
A track record of continued development.
At least five years’ experience related to geochemical analysis and consulting, with a focus on the mining sector.
Proficiency in geochemical modeling software and data analysis tools.
An ability to build relationships with multidisciplinary project-based teams.
Experience in a safety focused environment with near miss and incident reporting requirements.

In addition to the must have requirements you will excel in the role if you have the following:

An ability to find creative solutions and know how to present them.
A willingness to mentor others and be mentored.
An ability to build rapport with clients, colleagues, and industry partners.
Demonstrate that you are flexible and seek solutions rather than focus on problems.

Along with continued career development, KCB offers:

Hybrid work opportunities
Annual performance and salary review
PSMJ’s supported track record of profitability, leading to above average bonus payouts
Vacation policy that aligns to your experience
Paid OT, and sick days
Flexible benefits, including RSP, social, and mental well-being initiatives
Commitment to global ESG standards

We are a global organization committed to employment equity. We respect the uniqueness that makes you, you. We encourage applications from all qualified career seekers, regardless of gender, sex, religion, or nationality.

To learn more about projects you could be a part of check out Projects - KCB (klohn.com) and our Careers page for more details.

description:

Non-sales environment, taking inbound service calls.

You will be based at your home address with an assigned office in The Riverway Centre, Stafford, which you will attend minimum of 3 days each week. The in-office days will be a Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday.

This is a full-time role - 37.5 hrs per week, Monday to Friday between 8.00 am and 8.00 pm with some Saturday between 9am and 5pm.

We are looking for Inbound Enquiry Centre Advisors to join our expanding customer service team on a full-time permanent basis in Stafford, UK.

The role involves providing a high-quality claimant experience by telephone to new and existing claimants of Personal Independence Payment (PIP) who are looking to place a new claim for PIP or are already receiving the Disability Living Allowance (DLA) and are at the point of renewing their benefit. Our customer service teams are responsible for resolving both simple and complex issues for a whole range of customers as well as completing administrative tasks.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Answering calls from claimants/representatives and dealing with queries such as appointment bookings, in a professional and effective manner, ensuring the highest standard of claimant experience.
  • Accurate data input, with attention to detail for completion of administrative tasks.

  • Good listening skills – able to understand customer problems and give clear and concise explanations.
  • The ability to work well within a team and demonstrate flexibility to meet the needs and expectations of the team/business.
  • The ability to take ownership of issues, resolving wherever possible at the initial stage of the enquiry.
  • Polite and professional telephone manner, showing respect and empathy to callers.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for customer service.
  • Good time management.
  • High attention to detail and accurate data inputting.
  • Ability to work a range of shift patterns during contact centre opening hours.
  • Be adaptable to change in a constantly shifting environment.

  • Access to our Employee Network Groups, which represent every strand of diversity and allow colleagues to connect and learn from each other on an open, inclusive platform.

title: Helpdesk Support III
description:
Full-Time – Weekends Required | Pleasant Grove, Utah | IT Department

Position Summary
CCBank is seeking a highly skilled Helpdesk Support III to serve as a dedicated technical lead and subject-matter expert (SME) for the bank and its subsidiaries.
This role goes beyond traditional support. The Technical Lead will:

  • Provide advanced support across Windows and macOS
  • Document all systems and workflows
  • Train users and the internal IT team
  • Deliver analytics and insights
  • Operate in a fast-paced, AI-enabled, tech-forward environment

This individual will remain a fully integrated member of the IT Helpdesk team, ensuring collaboration, shared learning, and unified support standards across the bank.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership

  • Act as an IT partner for users, leadership, and operations.
  • Develop deep expertise in systems, applications, workflows, and dependencies.
  • Document all processes, configurations, and common troubleshooting paths.
  • Identify gaps, risks, and modernization opportunities within the environment.
  • Support IT leadership and SysAdmin teams throughout integration, stabilization and innovation.
  • Responsibilities as assigned

Advanced Technical Support (Tier 1–3) — Windows & Mac

  • Provide escalated support across Windows and macOS environments.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving M365, Entra ID, AD, MFA, MDM, VPN, networking, and printing.
  • Support workstation transitions, domain clean-up, and authentication migrations.
  • Assist with server access, backup validation, and system maintenance tasks as needed.
  • Responsibilities as assigned

Training, Enablement & AI-Enhanced Documentation

  • Deliver training for users on systems, workflows, security tools, and technology best practices.
  • Provide internal training to CCBank’s IT Helpdesk team, ensuring they understand workflows, expectations, and support nuances.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, shared ownership, and unified service standards.
  • Use AI and tech-forward tools to create documentation, videos, guides, and training content.
  • Build training programs that reduce recurring issues and elevate user proficiency.

Operational Reporting & Metrics

  • Track and analyze support trends:
    • Ticket volumes, Subjects, Resolution categories
    • Common root causes
    • Authentication, SSO and MDM issues
    • Darktrace and Mimecast user patterns and education
  • Provide weekly and monthly reporting with insights and recommendations.
  • Suggest workflow improvements, system consolidations, and end-user enablement opportunities.

Helpdesk Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a senior member of the Helpdesk Team — fully integrated, not siloed.
  • Collaborate with peers to share knowledge, refine processes, and maintain consistency.
  • Mentor junior technicians and support team development.
  • Assist with queue management, escalations, and knowledge-sharing.
  • Work flexible hours to meet the bank’s needs.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
AI-oplossingen bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat ze veilig, schaalbaar en betrouwbaar draaien bij klanten is iets anders. Daar kom jij in beeld.

Als DevOps Engineer binnen het EIFFEL Solutions Lab bouw je het fundament onder de technologiegedreven dienstverlening van Team EIFFEL. Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-oplossingen, digitale proposities en innovatieve diensten snel, veilig en schaalbaar naar productie kunnen. Niet voor één business line, maar voor heel Team EIFFEL. Van Legal en Finance tot Data, Technology en Engineering: jij maakt de stap van idee naar impact mogelijk.

Dit ga je doen

Je werkt samen met collega's uit het EIFFEL Solutions Lab aan innovatieve oplossingen op het snijvlak van business, technologie en AI. Samen ontwikkelen, valideren en schalen we proposities die klanten helpen slimmer, sneller en toekomstbestendiger te werken.

Jij zorgt ervoor dat die oplossingen daadwerkelijk draaien.

  • Je ontwikkelt en beheert CI/CD-pipelines voor snelle en betrouwbare deployments.
  • Je automatiseert infrastructuur met Infrastructure as Code en zorgt dat nieuwe omgevingen binnen enkele uren beschikbaar zijn.
  • Je maakt AI-oplossingen, data-platformen en digitale proposities productie-klaar.
  • Je richt monitoring, logging en alerting in zodat prestaties, beschikbaarheid en kosten continu inzichtelijk zijn.
  • Je borgt security, compliance en toegangsbeheer binnen onze oplossingen.
  • Je werkt samen met architecten, developers, IT en technologiepartners om nieuwe proposities succesvol live te brengen.
  • Je automatiseert terugkerende werkzaamheden en versnelt de ontwikkelcyclus van het hele team.
  • Je draagt bij aan een schaalbaar platform waarop toekomstige EIFFEL Solutions kunnen worden gebouwd.

Je bent fit for the job als je...

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt als DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer of vergelijkbare rol.
  • Ervaring hebt met Azure, AWS of GCP.
  • Sterk bent in CI/CD tooling zoals Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions.
  • Ervaring hebt met Terraform, Docker en Kubernetes.
  • Kennis hebt van observability, monitoring en incidentmanagement.
  • Begrijpt wat AI-, data- en cloudworkloads vragen van een moderne infrastructuur.
  • Ervaring hebt met security, privacy en compliance binnen complexe of gereguleerde omgevingen.
  • Technologie ziet als middel om sneller klantwaarde te realiseren.

Dit krijg je van ons

Wij bieden je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een van de strategische groeipijlers van Team EIFFEL. Je werkt aan state-of-the-art AI-oplossingen en technologieplatformen die direct bijdragen aan de toekomst van onze dienstverlening.

Je Krijgt

  • Directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van nieuwe technologiegedreven proposities.
  • Ruimte voor ondernemerschap binnen een sterk groeiende organisatie.
  • De mogelijkheid om te werken op het snijvlak van business, technologie en AI.
  • Samenwerking met experts uit verschillende disciplines en business lines.
  • De vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om impact te maken op organisatie-, klant- en marktniveau.
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen

Dit zijn wij

Het EIFFEL Solutions Lab is de plek waar nieuwe technologiegedreven proposities ontstaan. Hier combineren we de domeinkennis van Team EIFFEL met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI, data en technologie.

Samen met Venture Builders, architecten en engineers ontwikkelen en valideren we oplossingen die inspelen op actuele vraagstukken van klanten. Wat werkt, schalen we door binnen Team EIFFEL. Zo bouwen we aan een toekomst waarin vakmanschap en technologie elkaar versterken en structureel meer waarde creëren voor klanten, professionals en onze organisatie.

Team EIFFEL is een toonaangevende multidisciplinaire professional services organisatie met ruim 3.000 professionals actief binnen Legal, Finance, Data, Technology, Engineering en Projectmanagement.

Onze ambitie is helder: uitgroeien tot de leidende tech-enabled professional services organisatie van Nederland. Daarom investeren we volop in innovatieve proposities die vakmanschap combineert met data, AI en technologie.

Het EIFFEL Solutions Lab speelt hierin een sleutelrol. Hier bouwen we de oplossingen van morgen. Niet als experiment, maar als schaalbare dienstverlening die daadwerkelijk impact maakt voor klanten én Team EIFFEL.

Deze Skills Komen Van Pas

  • Probleemoplossing
  • Data-analyse

Je bent iemand die snelheid en betrouwbaarheid niet als tegenpolen ziet. Je houdt van bouwen, automatiseren en verbeteren. Tegelijkertijd weet je verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden om oplossingen succesvol live te brengen.

Daarnaast Ben Je

  • Verbindend en sterk in samenwerken.
  • Oplossingsgericht en pragmatisch.
  • Analytisch en gestructureerd.
  • Creatief in het automatiseren van processen en het oplossen van technische uitdagingen.
  • Ondernemend, proactief en resultaatgericht.
  • In staat om technische keuzes begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan verschillende stakeholders.

title: Enhetschef till hälso- och sjukvård, vård och omsorgboende
description:
1 plats(er).

Vi söker en engagerad enhetschef inom hälso- och sjukvården. Hos oss får du utvecklas som ledare och vara med och skapa en verksamhet där människor trivs, utvecklas och gör skillnad.

Har du erfarenhet av ledarskap och trivs med att ta ansvar, fatta beslut och skapa engagemang i ditt team? Då har vi jobbet för dig!

Vi intervjuar löpande så tveka inte, skicka in din ansökan idag! Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Din roll hos oss

Som enhetschef inom kommunal hälso- och sjukvård leder du ett team av kompetenta och engagerade medarbetare. Du har det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhet, personal, kvalitet, ekonomi och arbetsmiljö – men framför allt leder du med tillit och tydlighet. Du driver förbättringsarbete, stöttar dina medarbetare i vardagen och samarbetar med kollegor, MAS, HR och utvecklingsfunktioner för att stärka kvalitet och arbetssätt i hela organisationen.

Här finns utrymme för idéer, initiativ och långsiktighet – och för ett ledarskap som gör skillnad både för patienter och för teamet du leder.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker en tydlig, modig och tillitsfull ledare med förmåga att planera, prioritera och fatta beslut. Du är mål- och resultatinriktad och skapar förtroendefulla relationer, leder genom dialog och kommunicerar på ett sätt som engagerar och skapar delaktighet. Du drivs av samarbete och ser styrkan i att arbeta tillsammans – såväl inom kommunen som över organisationsgränser. Med ett helhetsperspektiv värdesätter du både människans behov och verksamhetens större uppdrag.

Du har en högskole- eller universitetsexamen inom hälso- och sjukvård eller annan relevant högskole- eller universitetsexamen och det är en fördel om du har ledarskapsutbildning. Vi vill att du har ledarerfarenhet med ansvar för budget, analys och uppföljning. Du är nyfiken på och trivs med att driva utveckling, förändring, digitalisering och välfärdsteknik.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av förändringsledning, arbete i politiskt styrd organisation och kunskap om samverkansavtal inom offentlig sektor. B-körkort krävs.

Vid erbjudande om anställning krävs att du uppvisar registerutdrag enligt gällande lagstiftning.

Det här är vi

I vår hälso- och sjukvårdsverksamhet är framtiden redan i rörelse. Vi står mitt i ett spännande skifte mot Nära vård, där digitalisering, samverkan och nya arbetssätt gör skillnad på riktigt. Här får du vara med och forma hur kommunal vård och omsorg utvecklas – för både invånare och medarbetare.

Omsorgsförvaltningen spänner över hela omsorgens bredd - från äldreomsorg och funktionsstöd till hälso- och sjukvård. Genom nära samarbete mellan våra verksamhetsområden skapar vi en helhet för varje individ. Här finns en kultur präglad av utveckling, ansvar och omtanke - där varje chef spelar en viktig roll i att leda verksamheten framåt och bidra till en hållbar omsorg för framtiden

Omsorgsförvaltningens verksamhet riktar sig till äldre och personer som har behov av funktionsstöd samt till personer med behov av hemsjukvård. Verksamheten är funktionsindelad i fyra verksamhetsområden: stöd i ordinärt boende, stöd i vård- och omsorgsboende, hälso- och sjukvård samt funktionsstöd. I förvaltningen finns också myndighetsenheten, riksgymnasiet och hjälpmedelscentrum i Östra Skåne.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du utrymme att växa – både som ledare och som person. Vi erbjuder kommunens chefsutvecklingsprogram, mentorskap och kollegialt lärande i en miljö där idéer tas tillvara. Hos oss finns möjligheten att påverka framtidens arbetssätt inom kommunal hälso- och sjukvård – från digitalt stöd till personcentrerad vård. Vi är en organisation som vågar tänka nytt, och du får möjlighet att vara med och påverka vägen framåt.

Vi är drygt 7000 medarbetare i Kristianstads kommun som gör skillnad i människors vardag, varje dag. Hos oss hittar du medarbetare som brinner för välfärden och vill utveckla idéer till verklighet. Kristianstads kommun erbjuder flera olika karriärvägar så att du kan utvecklas genom hela arbetslivet. Läs mer om våra förmåner och oss som arbetsgivare här. (https://www.kristianstad.se/jobbochforetagande/jobbochpraktik/kommunensomarbetsgivare.670.html)

Bra att veta

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via ansökningsknapp. Istället skickar du din ansökan med posten eller lämnar ansökan på Rådhus Skåne. Märk kuvertet med titel och referensnummer. Har du frågor kan du kontakta medborgarcenter 044-13 50 00.

Har du frågor kring hur du gör din ansökan, kontakta systemets support på telefon 0771-69 36 93. Välj 1 - Visma Recruit och 2 - arbetssökande.

Lön

Kristianstads kommun tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning.

Tillträde

Tillträde för tjänsten är enligt överenskommelse.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer — Python / React / GCP / AI
description:
Ignyte is seeking a highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, integrate, deploy, and maintain software across a diverse technology environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can take a business objective or loosely defined requirement and turn it into a working production solution with minimal supervision.

The engineer will work under the architectural direction of a highly experienced senior technical leader while maintaining substantial ownership over implementation, delivery, and production support.

The role spans customer-facing applications, internal tools, integrations, cloud infrastructure, structured data, workflow automation, and AI-enabled software.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance full-stack web applications
  • Develop modern frontend applications using React
  • Build backend services, APIs, integrations, and automation using Python
  • Design and maintain PostgreSQL databases
  • Develop and manage applications and infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, and third-party services
  • Develop solutions using Google Workspace APIs, including Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and related services
  • Build and maintain headless CMS and modern web architectures
  • Extend, troubleshoot, and modernize existing applications and codebases
  • Build internal business applications and operational tools
  • Translate business workflows into scalable software and automated processes
  • Develop AI-enabled applications, workflows, and automation
  • Implement structured data processing and validation
  • Generate documents and other outputs from structured and unstructured data
  • Implement CI/CD, automated testing, deployments, logging, and monitoring
  • Troubleshoot production issues across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and integration layers
  • Maintain secure, scalable, documented, and maintainable code
  • Participate in architecture and technical design discussions
  • Propose solutions and communicate technical tradeoffs clearly

Nature of the Engineering Work

Our engineering environment spans multiple products, technology stacks, and business systems.

Engineers are expected to be comfortable moving between new development and existing applications rather than working within one narrow technology or product.

Typical work may include:

  • Customer-facing web applications
  • Existing enterprise software
  • Internal business applications
  • Systems integration
  • Workflow automation
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Structured data processing
  • AI-assisted applications
  • Business process automation
  • Production troubleshooting and modernization

The successful candidate must be comfortable switching between frontend, backend, database, infrastructure, integration, and AI-related work depending on business priorities.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Significant professional engineering experience predating modern generative-AI coding tools
  • Advanced Python experience
  • Strong React frontend development experience
  • Strong PostgreSQL and SQL experience
  • Production experience with Google Cloud Platform
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, and third-party integrations
  • Experience with Google Workspace APIs
  • Experience with headless CMS or similar modern web architectures
  • Experience working with unfamiliar or inherited codebases
  • Experience with Git, branching, code review, and CI/CD
  • Practical DevOps and production deployment experience
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting capability
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and performance

This role requires flexibility across technologies.

The ideal candidate is comfortable learning and working within existing systems even when the technology differs from their primary stack.

Candidates should be capable of:

  • Navigating inherited codebases
  • Identifying technical debt
  • Modernizing systems incrementally
  • Selecting appropriate technologies based on the problem rather than personal preference

AI is expected to be a normal part of the software development process.

Candidates should have practical experience with some combination of:

  • OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar APIs
  • AI-assisted coding tools
  • LLM integrations
  • Structured outputs
  • Function and tool calling
  • Retrieval-augmented generation
  • Prompt and context engineering
  • AI workflow automation

Candidates must understand software engineering fundamentals independently of AI-generated code and be capable of reviewing, debugging, testing, and improving AI-assisted implementations.

We are looking for someone who uses AI to increase engineering productivity, not someone who depends on AI to understand the software they are building.

Systems Integration

A significant portion of the role involves connecting applications and business systems.

Candidates should be comfortable designing workflows involving:

  • REST APIs
  • JSON
  • Webhooks
  • Authentication and OAuth
  • Event-driven processing
  • Business rules
  • Scheduled processes
  • Retry logic
  • Logging and monitoring

Experience integrating platforms such as Google Workspace, CRM systems, accounting systems, cloud platforms, databases, and third-party SaaS applications is highly desirable.

Structured Data & Automation

The engineer should be comfortable building systems that transform information between multiple formats and systems.

This may include:

  • Converting structured and unstructured information into validated JSON
  • Data validation
  • Schema-driven processing
  • Workflow orchestration
  • AI-assisted data extraction and transformation
  • Human review and approval workflows

DevOps & Production Ownership

Engineers are expected to own work beyond code completion.

Responsibilities include:

  • Testing
  • Deployment
  • CI/CD
  • Monitoring
  • Troubleshooting
  • Documentation
  • Performance optimization
  • Production support

The engineer should be capable of taking work from development through stable production deployment.

Security

Candidates should understand secure software development practices, including:

  • Authorization
  • Role-based access
  • Secrets management
  • API security
  • Audit logging
  • Least-privilege access

Prior cybersecurity or compliance experience is useful but not required.

Working Style

This role requires significant independence.

The engineer may receive a business requirement such as:

“We need these systems connected and this workflow automated.”

They should be able to:

  • Understand the business objective
  • Investigate the existing environment
  • Identify technical requirements
  • Design an implementation approach
  • Identify APIs and dependencies
  • Develop the solution
  • Test it
  • Deploy it
  • Document it
  • Support it in production

The engineer will receive architectural guidance from senior technical leadership but should not require detailed technical tickets or step-by-step development instructions.

We expect engineers to bring proposed solutions, identify risks early, and ask focused questions when necessary.

Communication

  • Excellent written and spoken English is required
  • Must communicate technical decisions clearly
  • Must be comfortable working directly with business leadership
  • Must explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Must proactively communicate blockers, risks, and dependencies
  • Must document systems and important technical decisions

Technical Assessment

Final candidates will complete a practical technical assessment.

The assessment may evaluate:

  • API integration
  • JSON and structured data
  • Ability to interpret incomplete business requirements

The assessment will focus on realistic engineering work rather than algorithm puzzles.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who has spent years building production software before AI coding assistants became common and now uses modern AI tools aggressively to improve productivity.

They are:

  • Technically strong
  • Highly independent
  • Pragmatic
  • Comfortable across multiple technology stacks
  • Capable of understanding existing systems quickly
  • Comfortable moving between product development and automation
  • Able to turn ambiguous business requirements into working software
  • Comfortable taking technical direction while independently owning execution

This is not a narrowly defined frontend, backend, or DevOps position.

We are looking for a broad senior engineer capable of owning complex software problems across the stack.

title: Return to Work Coordinator
description:
Join Paradigm as a Return-to-Work Coordinator in a fully remote role with typical business hours. In this position, you will help connect injured workers with meaningful transitional duty opportunities while building strong relationships with nonprofit partners and supporting a smooth, positive experience for everyone involved. We are seeking someone who is organized, customer-focused, and energized by managing multiple priorities in a collaborative environment. The hourly pay range for this role is $21.06 to $23.00, depending on experience and qualifications.
Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain relationships: Establish and nurture partnerships with nonprofit organizations to create a network of potential Transitional Duty placement sites.
Identify suitable assignments: Collaborate with nonprofit organizations to identify appropriate Transitional Duty roles that match injured workers' physical abilities, restrictions, and skill set.
Facilitate placements: Coordinate the placement of injured workers in selected Transitional Duty assignments, creating draft offer letter, creating driving instructions, and setting up the time tracking process.
Maintain internal database of nonprofit transitional work sites.
Communicates challenges with placement process to Transitional Return to Work Specialist to strategize next steps.
Accurately document time and case activity on individual files in case management software (Alarisware)
Responsible for complying with Paradigm Information Security requirements and policies, for safeguarding Paradigm or Paradigm related passwords, and for notifying Paradigm of any Information Security incidents per policy SEC 10-12 Information Security Incident Management
Performs other duties as necessary and assigned
Communicate with stakeholders: Maintain open communication with injured workers, nonprofit partners, and TRTW Specialists to ensure a smooth and effective volunteer experience.
Manage administrative tasks: Track volunteer hours, manage timesheets, and update case management software with relevant information.
Resolve issues and concerns: Address any problems or conflicts that may arise during the volunteer assignment, working collaboratively with all parties involved.
By effectively fulfilling these responsibilities, the Return-to-Work Coordinator contributes significantly to the success of the Transitional Return to Work program, helping injured workers regain their confidence and skills while making a positive impact on the community.

Qualifications:

Training program is designed to equip you with the knowledge and skills needed to excel in your role. The program spans 8-12 weeks and includes: Classroom instructions, On-the-Job Shadowing and Mentoring.
Associate or bachelor’s degree
Must be comfortable with heavy phone work
Customer Service Experience
Ability to manage competing priorities
Ability to work in a fast-paced work environment
Ability to meet expected deadlines
Critical thinking skills and creative problem solving
Computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office programs—Word, and Excel
Exceptional communication skills both written and verbal
Exceptional organization and time management skills

title: Inspector (Mechanical)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Site Supervision Inspector responsible for conducting project site inspections, identifying potential issues, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to verify the quality and quantity of work executed by contractors. The Inspector will ensure that all mechanical works comply with contractual requirements, approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, and client requirements. The role includes conducting regular site inspections of work submitted by the contractor through WIRs and MIRs, reviewing installations, witnessing testing and commissioning activities, and providing timely approvals. reports and progress tracking.

Responsibilities
• Carry out site inspections and supervision activities and report findings directly to the Mechanical Engineer.
• Inspect chilled water piping systems and oversee the testing and commissioning of overall Mechanical systems such as but not limited to HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, system also coordinating seamless integration of mechanical system with project BMS.
• Review and interpret contract documents, shop drawings, technical specifications, and applicable local and international codes and standards.
• Ensure compliance with project quality, health, safety, and environmental requirements.
• Review and verify QA/QC documentation, including ITPs, Method Statements, WIRs, MIRs, NCRs, and as-built records.
• Confirm that construction activities meet project specifications and client requirements through inspections, measurements, testing, commissioning, and coordination with relevant authorities and stakeholders.
• Document inspection activities, contractor resources, work locations, construction methods, and progress records accurately and promptly.
• Monitor material deliveries, perform material inspections, and verify proper storage and handling procedures.
• Track quality assurance activities and assist in resolving technical and quality-related issues.
• Maintain thorough inspection records and prepare detailed reports as required.
• Apply a strong working knowledge of ASHRAE, IPC, ASPE, SBC, ASME, ASTM, NFPA, and other relevant international standards.

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in mechanical building services, including installation, inspection, testing, and commissioning.
  • Aviation experience preferred.
  • Proven experience in the inspection of HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, gas, and fuel oil systems, including AHUs, FCU’s, ETSs room, and lift stations.
  • Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration.
  • Data Center and Aviation project experience is desirable.
  • Quality Control or Quality Assurance certification is considered an added value advantage.

title: Software Engineer (Python / Go)
description:
Meet the team

Applications are the lifeblood of organizations. They support the processes that engage customers, partners, and employees. Effective application management isn't just a "nice to have" - it's critical to the success of your organization.

Your impact

You will build reliable services primarily in Python and Go, with opportunities to make hands‑on contributions to React-based interfaces and reusable UI components.   • Use independent judgment to understand existing code and improve it as needed, while maintaining a high standard of quality.
  • Understand the challenges and trade‑offs involved in building and deploying new systems to production.
  • Lead code reviews and use your understanding of customer experiences to prevent future problems.
  • Follow the software development lifecycle in an Agile methodology and contribute to a strong engineering culture through testing, observability, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS and Azure.
  • Experience working in Kubernetes systems, with familiarity with kubectl and Docker containers.
  • Experience working with thoughtfully designed RESTful APIs and influencing API design choices.
  • Mastery of test‑driven development and developing different levels of automated tests, such as unit, functional, and integration tests.
  • Excellent problem‑solving, collaboration, and communication skills, both verbal and written.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Site Supervision Engineer (Aviation Exp)
description:
The Site Supervision Engineer is responsible for executing day-to-day site inspections and technical monitoring of construction activities, ensuring that civil, structural, architectural, and related building works are performed in accordance with approved design drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and schedule targets.

This role acts as a primary technical presence in the field, monitoring contractor execution, supporting cross-disciplinary coordination with MEP services, and actively supporting the project's quality (QA/QC) and safety (HSE) procedures on-site.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct daily routine site inspections for ongoing civil, structural, architectural, and site infrastructure works.
• Verify that all materials, execution techniques, and workmanship on-site strictly comply with approved drawings, project specifications, method statements, and local codes.
• Inspect structural elements, concrete pours, steel frame assemblies, masonry, floor slabs, and buildings envelopes details during execution.
• Assist in reviewing and coordinating with the technical team for contractor technical submittals, including Requests for Information (RFIs), shop drawings, Material Approval Requests (MARs), and work method statements.
• Log, monitor, and assist in resolving site quality issues; perform re-inspections for closed-out Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and punch list items under the direction of the Senior Engineer.
• Coordinate on-site with MEP inspectors to ensure smooth integration of systems with civil and structural works.
• Monitor daily contractor workforce deployment, equipment usage, work productivity, and activity sequence against short-term target schedules.
• Identify field execution delays early and report them to the Senior Site Supervision Engineer for resolution.
• Coordinate regularly with the on-site HSE Team to maintain a safe working environment.
• Support HSE enforcement during daily site walks.
• Prepare accurate daily site logs, inspection reports, and photographic records documenting site progress, manpower counts, weather conditions, and site challenges.
• Support the Senior Engineer in gathering data for weekly/monthly progress reports and quantifying work progress for monthly contractor payment validations.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architectural Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant construction and site supervision experience, preferably on major and complex projects.
• Prior site supervision experience on aviation-related projects or specialized industrial/large-span structural projects is strongly preferred.
• Sound working understanding of MEP systems to ensure effective interdisciplinary coordination on site.
• Membership in the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) or professional licensing is required.
• Familiarity with international and local building codes, site quality control processes, and standard construction methodology.
• Awareness of aviation facility technical requirements and local regulatory/authority compliance.
• Proficiency in Revit, CAD software (AutoCAD), document control systems (Aconex), and MS Office.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are a plus.
• Excellent communication, coordination, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple contractors, interfaces, and priorities within a demanding project environment.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach
• Understanding of sustainable construction practices and their application within project delivery.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.
• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

This role provides technical leadership on-site, manages contractor execution, and ensures seamless coordination across Civil, Structural, Architectural, and MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) disciplines, while working in close partnership with dedicated project safety (HSE) and quality (QA/QC) teams.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and oversee day-to-day construction activities, acting as the Client/Consultant’s primary site representative.
• Manage and coordinate the Contractor’s site activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, project requirements, and applicable standards.
• Monitor construction progress and performance against the approved project schedule, identifying delays, risks, and required corrective actions.
• Coordinate construction activities across multiple disciplines and interfaces, ensuring effective sequencing and minimizing conflicts.
• Review and provide technical input on shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, RFIs, technical submissions, and other construction documentation.
• Conduct regular site inspections and monitor workmanship, materials, testing, and installation to ensure compliance with quality requirements.
• Coordinate closely with the Contractor, Client, consultants, airport stakeholders, authorities, and other project stakeholders.
• Identify construction issues, design discrepancies, and constructability concerns and coordinate timely resolution.
• Review and follow up on RFIs, NCRs, site instructions, technical queries, and corrective actions.
• Monitor and verify reported construction progress and provide input for progress reports and payment assessments.
• Participate in progress, coordination, technical, and construction meetings and lead site-level discussions as required.
• Maintain comprehensive records of site activities, inspections, instructions, progress, and outstanding works.
• Support the assessment and management of variations, claims, delays, and other contractual matters.
• Coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, and handover activities.
• Monitor the preparation and submission of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, test records, and other closeout documentation.
• Ensure that construction activities are properly planned and coordinated to meet project milestones and operational requirements.
• Provide regular updates to the Project Manager on construction progress, key risks, issues, and required decisions.
• Collaborate closely with the HSE Manager and HSE team to ensure construction activities align with the project’s health, safety, and environmental plan.
• Support the HSE team during site walks by identifying potential engineering/structural hazards and backing HSE enforcement on safe work practices.
• Prepare detailed daily, weekly, and monthly site progress reports covering completed activities, equipment and manpower counts, site conditions, and critical issues.
• Participate in regular progress and coordination meetings with client representatives, design consultants, and contractor management teams.
• Assist the Project management in evaluating contractor monthly progress payment applications, site instructions, and technical variation requests.

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Architecture, or related field.
• Minimum 15 years of relevant construction and site supervision experience, preferably on major and complex projects.
• Proven track record of successful project delivery in large-scale construction projects.
• Proven experience working on aviation/airport projects is required.
• Demonstrated experience in a Construction Management and Site Management capacity, including direct oversight of contractors and multidisciplinary teams.
• Strong understanding of construction methods, sequencing, quality management, HSE requirements, and project controls.
• Strong knowledge of construction contracts, project specifications, drawings, and technical documentation.
• Sound working knowledge of MEP systems and interdisciplinary coordination, ensuring civil/structural works align seamlessly with mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire suppression installations and other systems.
• Familiarity with local building codes and regulations in Saudi Arabia
• Strong familiarity with international codes and quality control standards.
• Solid understanding of aviation facility technical standards and local civil aviation regulatory compliance.
• Proficiency in using site management tools, Revit, CAD software (AutoCAD), document control platforms (Aconex), and MS Office.
• Strong leadership, conflict-resolution, and site coordination skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are a plus.
• Excellent communication, coordination, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple contractors, interfaces, and priorities within a demanding project environment.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented approach
• Understanding of sustainable construction practices and their application within project delivery.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.
• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

title: Year In Industry Placement - Electronic Engineering Consultant - 2027
description:
Year In Industry Students at TTP use their engineering skillsets to support multi-disciplinary project teams in inventing new products and technologies, utilising commercial aptitude to drive projects forward. To succeed in this role, you’ll demonstrate leadership, build collaborative relationships with clients and ultimately work to having a strong understanding of industries we work across.

From a technical perspective, you will be involved in all aspects of technology and product development: from invention, to analysis, to prototype design and transfer to manufacture. The diversity in our work means that you can find yourself making a difference in a wide range of applications as vast as building state-of-the-art drug delivery devices, accelerating drug discovery through AI & next-gen DMTA, or developing a 5G NTN handset antenna.

You will have the opportunity to work on multiple such projects at any one time, so over a year at TTP your experiences and applications will be vast, and you can expect to develop and expand your understanding of entirely new fields of science and technology rapidly.

Equal to your technical work, you will also develop as a consultant. This means harnessing your entrepreneurial mindset: building an understanding of the markets we work in, engaging directly with clients to present your findings, and proactively ensuring their requirements are fully understood and met. As you gain experience, you will have opportunities to work on complex projects, build teams, and help expand TTP’s reach by building connections and engaging with clients.

We believe growth happens best in a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely and curiosity is encouraged – this is why we have the requirement for all staff to work on-site five days a week. You'll receive mentorship and guidance when needed, but also the space and trust to take initiative, explore your interests, and shape your own development. You'll be encouraged to contribute early, take ownership of your work, and collaborate across disciplines to deliver impactful solutions.

  • Deep intellectual curiosity and inventiveness, with a desire to understand how things work at a fundamental level. You should have an academic record that reflects your capacity for rigorous, first-principles thinking - being on track for a minimum 2:1 in Electronic Engineering or a closely related discipline, with strong accompanying A-Levels (or equivalent, i.e. IB qualifications).

  • Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, excited by the opportunity to turn breakthrough technologies into real-world products, ventures, and impact.

  • Proactive and self-starting, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and a drive to make things happen.

  • Collaborative and emotionally intelligent, able to build trust, influence stakeholders, energise those around you, and communicate complex technical ideas with clarity, empathy, and precision, regardless of your audience's background.

  • Strategic and systems-minded, able to see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges and opportunities while considering the commercial aspects of technology product development, and navigate ambiguity while keeping priorities sharp and focused.

We're looking for candidates who want to impact the industry both commercially and technically; those who don't just solve problems - but who seek them out, thrive on them, and elevate those around them while doing so.

We recruit on a rolling basis, so although there is no application deadline, the advert will close once all spaces have been filled. We recommend applying early for the best chance. You must have completed at least 2 years of your degree when your Year in Industry Placement begins, so students at the beginning of second year are welcome to apply.

This placement will start in August/September 2027.

TTP operates from an award-winning campus in green surroundings, just south of Cambridge.

We offer a generous benefits package, including:

  • Private medical insurance (for you and your dependants)
  • Free onsite lunch
  • Life insurance (6 x salary)
  • 25 days annual holiday - pro rata

title: Manufacturing Associate
description:
Job Scope

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function.


The Manufacturing Associate performs all functions associated with manufacturing operations. This includes operating process machines and auxiliary equipment, troubleshooting, and maintaining the machine. The manufacturing associate is also expected to collaborate with colleagues and engineers on tasks including (but not restricted to): set-up, calibration, rework, material handling, sampling and experiments. This role requires technical understanding of the manufacturing process and uses custom programs to support the collection of operating data to make real-time adjustments to processes, instruments or equipment. The manufacturing associate will assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process and improve shop floor management.


Key Responsibilities

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)


  • Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections.


  • Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time. Working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.


  • Operate the process machines and material handling equipment used in production, following implemented work instructions, standard operating procedures, and guidelines.


  • Perform troubleshooting, autonomous maintenance, cleaning activities and pre-start up inspections/safety checks on production and material handling equipment and fixtures.


  • Support the review and optimization of work instructions and process documentation.


  • Train and validate the competence of new manufacturing associates.


  • Assist with the distribution and handling/re-stocking of PPE and shop floor consumables.


  • Handle production waste.


  • Report current condition, status and also deviations in machine function, area cleanliness or personnel behavior to shift leader.


  • Contribute to maintaining high 5S standards within the process areas and general factory areas.


  • Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for cleaning, material handling, waste handling, and PPE use.


  • Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process.


  • Work proactively with the support functions (Manufacturing technicians, quality, logistics, etc).


  • Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resources for the benefit of the business.


Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role


Qualifications and Experience


  • High school education or a relevant education (e.g., industrial program at a gymnasium level, automation operator/technician education, process operator/technician education) is a plus.


  • 1 year previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing).


  • Experience with some of the following is advantageous: permit procedures, Lock Out Tag Out, near-miss reporting, safety audits, maintenance audits, process control systems, and daily follow-up on safety actions.


  • Understanding how to utilize equipment to run efficient manufacturing with energy and costing optimization.
  • Experience with production processes including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic components.


Specific skills & Knowledge


  • Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.


  • Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.


  • High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.


  • This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.


  • A genuine technical interest and curiosity about working within production is highly valued. A good understanding of machines and equipment such as pipes, pumps, and valves is a plus.

title: Refugee Resettlement | Employment Specialist
description:
Catholic Charities is looking for the right people; people who wish to serve their community as a part of a family friendly organization doing good within the Houston-Galveston area. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees. People of all faiths helping people in need.

Refugee Resettlement assists in helping create a home-away-from-home, we assist government-approved refugees in becoming self-sufficient through cultural orientation, job development, family reunification and resettlement.


The Employment Specialist is responsible for the development, support, and implementation of Employment Services. Employment Services works to develop employment opportunities, vocational and educational partnerships, conduct outreach, develop, and provide coaching and teaching components to support clients to successfully navigate the job search process and secure employment. This position delivers services related to economic self-sufficiency; career resiliency & training; and employment stability coaching to individuals and families receiving case management support through participation in Catholic Charities program services. Organize, plan, and execute workforce development events as necessary for various assigned projects.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES

  • Develop and implement employment initiatives which include identifying, developing, and maintaining community partnerships for the purpose of stabilizing individuals and families through the opportunity to increase earning potential over time.
  • Develop effective working relationships with employers and maintain regular contact to monitor program satisfaction.
  • Assess the staffing needs of businesses and track employment placement and retention outcomes for program participants; develop employment, vocational and education opportunities within the community assisting individuals to increase their earning potential over time.
  • Determine client eligibility, assess client strengths and interests through interview and test administration, link with potential employers, and coordinate with assigned case manager. Working with clients to create and implement individualized action plans that foster employment and self-sufficiency. Coach clients as they follow their action plan in pursuit of employment. Encourage clients who experience rejections and promote client resilience. Alert clients of potential job opportunities and recruitment events. Provide clients access to job fairs through direct sponsorship or referral to events sponsored by community partners.
  • Teach pre-employment classes and meet individually with clients struggling to become employed. Edit existing resumes and help clients to development new resumes for use in job search. Work with clients to practice interview skills; offer "mock interviews" for clients. Assist clients to schedule job interviews; assess status of clients after placement; track employment status for 90 days or other designated period. Advocate on client's behalf, if needed, to resolve workplace issue(s). Arranging transportation and other assistance for clients, as needed, in the course of securing a job. Referring clients to other services, such as ESL, vocational training, on-the-job Training (OJT), and literacy and education services. Assisting clients to enroll in services offered by community partners. Following-up to promote success.
  • Performing other duties as assigned.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
About Promtior

Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we've helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients' teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business).

We're a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being.

About the Role

This is not a narrow ETL development role. We are looking for a hands‑on senior engineer who moves comfortably between architecture, implementation, troubleshooting and conversations with product and business stakeholders.

What you’ll own

Architecture

  • Help design evolve the architecture for a data platform, lakehouse and warehouse environment, as the product grows.
  • Design clean, maintainable data models that support product features, analytics, reporting and AI/ML use cases.
  • Make pragmatic architectural decisions.

Pipelines

  • Design and build end-to-end pipelines ingesting from APIs, operational databases, third‑party platforms, files and external data providers.
  • Build scalable ingestion, transformation and orchestration workflows, from raw ingestion through curated, product‑ready datasets.
  • Design incremental pipelines that handle changing source data.
  • Optimize pipelines and queries for performance, reliability and cost.

Reliability

  • Implement data quality, validation, observability and monitoring.
  • Identify inconsistencies and anomalies across multiple data sources.
  • Define engineering standards for testing, documentation, version control and deployment.

Collaboration

  • Translate operational problems from product and business stakeholders into technical solutions.

Requirements

  • Minimum 4+ years of data engineering experience
  • Production experience with Databricks.
  • Advanced Python and advanced SQL.
  • Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of relational and analytical data modeling.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, databases, files and third‑party systems.
  • Experience designing incremental pipelines and handling changing source data.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, observability and reliability.
  • Hands‑on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP).
  • Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, modular and reusable code, production debugging, and infrastructure and deployment concepts.
  • Professional English (see Language below).

Nice to have

  • Depth in Databricks, Spark and lakehouse architecture.
  • Having built a data platform from an early stage, rather than only maintaining an established one.
  • Domain experience in financial services, logistics, supply chain or trade data.
  • Ingestion from highly fragmented or poorly structured sources.
  • Document-processing pipelines.
  • Data feeding AI/ML applications.
  • Data governance, lineage and security.
  • Working directly with U.S. clients or product teams.
  • Startup or product-company experience.

How you work

  • You ask the right questions and understand the business problem behind the ticket.
  • You investigate unfamiliar datasets independently.
  • You challenge weak architectural decisions.
  • You design a solution and then personally build it.
  • You communicate trade-offs clearly and operate comfortably with ambiguity.
  • You take responsibility for systems in production.
  • You raise the technical level of the people around you.

Benefits

  • 20 paid days off per year.
  • Hybrid work model.
  • Flex Days: monthly team activities.
  • Professional development courses.
  • Internal clubs (soccer, padel, running, cinema).

Location

Montevideo, Uruguay.

Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Corrientes or Chaco, Argentina.

Hybrid work arrangement

Region Dalarna införde hösten 2025 vårdinformationssystemet Cosmic. Vi söker nu en avtalscontroller som på både en operativ och strategisk nivå aktivt arbetar med avtalet. Avtalskonstruktionen skiljer sig från tidigare system och ställer höga krav på strukturerad uppföljning, affärsmässighet och leverantörsstyrning. För att säkerställa att Region Dalarna får fullt värde av avtalet och att leveranser sker enligt överenskommelse söker vi nu en avtalscontroller med särskilt fokus på vårdinformationssystemet.

Tjänsten är placerad inom upphandlingsavdelningen och innebär ett nära samarbete med verksamhet, juridik, ekonomi, IT samt externa parter.

Region Dalarna ingår i en regionsamverkan med åtta andra regioner runt Cosmic, Sussa samverkan, varför en del i avtalshanteringen också är att representera regionen Sussagemensamt kring avtalsfrågor.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som avtalscontroller ansvarar du för den kommersiella och avtalsmässiga uppföljningen av vårdinformationsavtalet. I rollen ingår bland annat att:

  • Följa upp avtalets villkor, leveransnivåer och incitament
  • Säkerställa ekonomisk kontroll och korrekt fakturering
  • Identifiera, analysera och hantera avtalsavvikelser
  • Stödja verksamheten, t.ex. hälso- och sjukvårdens stödfunktioner och ledning, samt systemförvaltning, i avtals- och tolkningsfrågor
  • Delta i och bidra till affärsdialoger och förhandlingar med leverantör
  • Samordna Region Dalarnas arbete gentemot SUSSA Samverkan i avtalsfrågor
  • Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, strukturer och verktyg för avtalsuppföljning
  • Arbeta proaktivt med riskhantering och realisering av avtalets strategiska nytta över tid
Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis ekonomi, juridik, inköp eller motsvarande erfarenhet
  • Erfarenhet av avtalsuppföljning, avtalsförvaltning eller leverantörsstyrning
  • God affärsmässig förståelse och erfarenhet av komplexa avtal
  • Förmåga att analysera avtal ur både ekonomiskt och verksamhetsmässigt perspektiv
  • Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i svenska, i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Erfarenhet av större IT- eller tjänsteavtal
  • Erfarenhet från offentlig verksamhet
  • Vana av samverkansmodeller eller flerpartsavtal
  • Erfarenhet av arbete nära juridik och/eller upphandling

Personliga egenskaper

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är strukturerad, analytisk och uthållig. Du är trygg i dialoger med leverantörer och kan stå stadigt i affärsmässiga diskussioner. Du trivs i en koordinerande roll med många kontaktytor och har förmåga att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt.

Ansökan
  • Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via systemet, utan kontakta rekryterande chef direkt
  • Vi tar interna referenser på nuvarande och tidigare anställda i Region Dalarna
  • På Att söka jobb hos oss - Region Dalarna kan du läsa mer om Region Dalarna som arbetsgivare, vår värdegrund, arbetsmiljö, förmåner samt vilka kontroller som görs inför anställning
  • Vi har gjort vårt medieval och avböjer kontakt från sälj- och rekryteringsföretag

Wat je meebrengt:
