title: Lokalvårdare till Butiks städning 2 dagar i Veckan
description:
Northclean Facility Services AB ingår i Northclean-gruppen, vars mål är att bygga Nordens främsta företagsgrupp inom branschen genom att förvärva och utveckla de mest väletablerade och framgångsrika bolagen från norr till söder. Vi värdesätter att ha nära till beslut och att ha stort fokus på närhet till kunden och våra medarbetare. Hos oss är alla jobb lika viktiga och vi står stadigt i vår ambition att städa och putsa fönster bäst. Våra värdeord; ansvar, engagemang och omtanke vägleder oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Vi vet att om vi trivs bra på jobbet så gör vi även ett bättre jobb!

Vill du ha ett extra jobb där du gör verklig skillnad, får röra på dig och lämnar butiken skinande fräsch efter dig? Då kan detta vara något för dig. Vi söker en lokalvårdare som vill städa en butik i Norrtälje 2 dagar i veckan och bli en del av ett företag där service, kvalitet och omtanke står i centrum.

Arbetsort är Grisslehamn Samt I Görla med flexibel arbetstid

Vad du kommer att göra

Du ser till att butiken känns välkomnande, ren och trivsam för både kunder och personal. Du jobbar självständigt men har ett team och en trygg struktur i ryggen, med tydliga rutiner och stöttande kollegor. Arbetet är viktigt för kundens intryck – det är du som gör första intrycket möjligt.

  • Städning av butiksyta, personalutrymmen och kundtoaletter
  • Golvvård som sopning, moppning och enklare maskinstädning
  • Tömning av papperskorgar och återvinning enligt rutin
  • Påfyllnad av förbrukningsmaterial, som tvål och papper
  • Daglig kontroll att lokalerna upplevs rena, fräscha och säkra
  • Kommunikation med arbetsledning vid avvikelser eller behov

Vem vi tror att du är

Du gillar ordning och reda och trivs när saker blir klara och snygga. Du är trygg, noggrann och har lätt för att bemöta människor på ett trevligt sätt. Erfarenhet av städning är såklart ett plus, men det viktigaste är att du vill lära dig och ta ansvar.

  • Har 1 års erfarenhet av lokalvård, butiksstädning eller liknande servicearbete, eller vill gärna lära dig yrket
  • Trivs med fysiskt arbete och är bekväm med att stå, gå och lyfta lättare material
  • Är noggrann, punktlig och håller vad du lovar
  • Har god social förmåga och gillar att bidra till en positiv stämning
  • Kan följa skriftliga och muntliga instruktioner och jobba efter rutiner
  • Kan kommunicera på svenska i tal så att du kan ta emot instruktioner och prata med kollegor

Varför du vill jobba hos oss

Hos oss blir du en del av ett företag där lokalvård och facility services är hjärtat i verksamheten, inte något som ”bara ska göras”. Vi brinner för service, kvalitet och kundfokus, men också för dig som medarbetare. Här är det viktigt att du känner dig trygg, välkommen och sedd – oavsett bakgrund.

  • Friskvårdsbidrag till alla anställda, för att du ska må bra både på jobbet och efter
  • Yrkesutbildning via vår interna yrkesskola för nya medarbetare – du får lära dig lokalvårdsyrket på ett proffsigt sätt
  • Fortlöpande personlig utveckling och vidareutbildning för dig som vill växa i rollen
  • Tydligt ledarskap, stöttande kollegor och en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där mångfald ses som en styrka
  • Balans mellan självständigt arbete och samarbete – du får frihet men är aldrig ensam i längden
  • Flexibla arbetsupplägg i företaget med olika typer av skift, vilket kan ge möjligheter framåt om du vill jobba mer

Placering och arbetstid

Tjänsten gäller butiksstädning i Norrtälje. Du arbetar 2 dagar i veckan enligt överenskommen fast rutin, med tydliga tider och arbetsmoment. Upplägget passar dig som vill ha ett extra jobb vid sidan av studier, annan sysselsättning eller helt enkelt vill jobba lite mindre men ändå göra något meningsfullt.

Så skickar du in din ansökan

Du ansöker via vår webbplattform genom att fylla i ansökningsformuläret och bifoga ditt cv. Skriv gärna några rader om dig själv, varför du gillar att jobba med service och lokalvård samt när du kan börja. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart du har möjlighet.

title: Handläggare med it-intresse
description:
På Åklagarmyndigheten känner vi stolthet när vi går till jobbet. Tillsammans är vi över 2 250 engagerade och kompetenta medarbetare som står upp för rättssäkerhet, rättstrygghet och demokratiska värden. Oavsett roll i myndigheten bidrar alla till vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag. För oss är arbetet mot brottsligheten ett lagarbete där varje medarbetares kompetens och insats gör skillnad. Vill du bli en del av Åklagarmyndigheten? Vi strävar efter att vara en välkomnande och inkluderande arbetsplats som speglar samhällets mångfald. Ansök redan i dag! 1 plats(er).

Norrorts åklagarkammaren söker en handläggare

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Anställningen är placerad på Norrorts åklagarkammare. Som handläggare möter du en händelserik vardag med varierande arbetsuppgifter.

Du arbetar självständigt men också tillsammans i grupp för att få det administrativa arbetet att fungera. Service är en stor del i ditt vardagliga arbete, både internt och externt.

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bl.a. att:

  • utföra arbete med enklare it-support lokalt, som t.ex. byte av datorer, mobiltelefoner och skärmar, bistå med support vid mjukvarufrågor vad gäller myndighetens system och applikationer, felsökning och uppdatering
  • vara kammarens kontaktperson mot myndighetens centrala it-support, uppdatera it-inventering, utfärda inloggningskort, beställa behörigheter m.m.
  • hålla i introduktion och utbildning i kammarens it-verktyg och telefoni
  • ge åklagare administrativt stöd, t.ex. arbete i brottmålsdiariet, hantera arkivering och utföra allmänna kontorsuppgifter
  • kontrollera, bedöma och registrera inkomna ärenden
  • vara kontakten utåt i många sammanhang och därmed ge god service till både allmänheten och till andra myndigheter – främst via telefon och e-post
  • utföra arbetsuppgifter som fördelas från administrativ chef t.ex. viss beredning.

Vardagen är händelsestyrd och det kan snabbt inkomma brådskande ärenden som gör att du behöver ta snabba beslut och kunna göra en avvägning av vad som är brådskande eller inte.

Dina kvaliteter och kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som

  • har gymnasieexamen eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
  • har aktuell skicklighet som motsvarar några års väl vitsordat arbete med administrativa uppgifter som Åklagarmyndigheten bedömer som relevant
  • har erfarenhet av arbete i it-miljö och med digitala verktyg inom administration, telefoni, möten m.m.
  • har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person vill vi att du

  • är noggrann, strukturerad och följa de förhållningsregler och rutiner som finns
  • är självständig och ansvarstagande
  • är stresstålig då arbetsbelastningen vid vissa tillfällen kan vara hög
  • är stabil och ha god självkännedom
  • har lätt för att samarbeta och har ett öppet förhållningssätt gentemot din omgivning
  • är serviceinriktad
  • har god kommunikationsförmåga.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Det är meriterande om du har

  • arbetat inom rättsväsendet

  • erfarenhet av arbete med enklare it-support avseende digital mötesteknik, Microsofts klientprodukter, Adobe, mobiltelefoni, nätverk, skrivare, datorer, VPN-uppkoppling.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.

Tester kan förekomma i rekryteringsprocessen.

Inför erbjudande om anställning kan det bli aktuellt för Åklagarmyndigheten att genomföra registerkontroll i misstankeregistret och belastningsregistret. Registerkontrollen genomförs på slutkandidaten.

Åklagarmyndigheten är en beredskapsmyndighet. Vid en anställning kan du komma att krigsplaceras på Åklagarmyndigheten. Läs mer under Jobba hos oss (https://www.aklagare.se/karriar/att-jobba-hos-oss/krigsplacering/).

På grund av arkivbestämmelser sparar vi ansökningar i två år. När du ansöker kommer dina personuppgifter att behandlas enligt offentlighetsprincipen samt dataskyddsförordningen. När du skickar din ansökan till oss, samtycker du till detta.

Vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan på svenska.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

title: Security Officer I Full time Second shift
description:
Dedicated security resource for ambulatory and off-site locations.

The Security Officer I reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Under the direction of the Security Leadership, this position is responsible for adhering to established policies and procedures to protect the hospital from theft and damage; provides protection for patients, visitors, Associates, and medical staff; investigates and quells disturbances; restrains patients upon proper direction and assistance of medical/clinical staff.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates/quells hospital incidents and disturbances to maintain patient, visitor, and employee security.
  • Completes descriptive reports for supervisory personnel.
  • Notifies appropriate city officials (police and fire) and prepares descriptive reports for supervisory personnel.
  • Performs regular perimeter and internal patrols of the hospital buildings and grounds to assure protection of patients and property and to prevent the entry of unauthorized persons into the hospital. These patrols are both on foot and mobile.
  • Conducts investigations into incidents of hazardous conditions, reported theft, criminal activity, and any other security or safety issues as reported.
  • Monitors the access control system, fire and duress alarms, and the security video system.
  • Controls traffic as necessary to always assure access for emergency vehicles and access for patients and visitors accordingly.
  • Controls traffic as necessary during incidents and for helicopter transports.
  • Maintains security of restricted areas by checking and locking doors according to pre-set schedules or as required by special circumstances.
  • Provides escorts for staff to their vehicles as requested.
  • Delivers deceased bodies to the morgue and releases same to authorized persons in accordance with established policies.
  • Responds to all emergency codes in accordance with department specific guidelines.
  • Alerts the department Manager of any activities or deviation from departmental standards that may require disciplinary action or follow-up.
  • Enforces all hospital policies and procedures as directed.
  • Officers must display a competent and professional service image yet be approachable and service minded at all times.
  • This image should encourage people to freely ask for assistance or convey information that may allow the officer to prevent problems or reduce exposure of the hospital to damage or loss.
  • Conduct contraband searches for patient and employee safety as needed.
  • Monitor individuals or situations to ensure patient and employee safety as needed.
  • Oversees staff parking permit process, and monitors compliance per established policy and procedure.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Education: High-school diploma or GED
  • Licensure:
  • Valid driver’s license.
  • Certification:
  • Successful completion of IAHSS Basic exam within 90 days of hire
  • Maintain IAHSS Basic certification,
  • Current Basic Life Support certification through American Heart Association within 9 months of hire,
  • Successful completion of Northwestern Medicine Defensive Tactics in Healthcare within 6 months of hire
  • Behavioral Attributes:
  • Interpersonal and communication skills necessary to interact effectively with a variety of individuals, including employees, medical staff, patients, visitors, law enforcement and other outside agencies
  • Writing skills necessary to complete reports and paperwork that meets departmental standards.
  • Physical Demands: Physical ability and knowledge of how to operate a motor vehicle.

Preferred:

  • Experience in healthcare security, police work, or military service
  • Valid FOID card
  • Associate/Bachelor’s degree

Additional Information

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

NorthwesternMedicine Career Page

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

title: Associate / Senior Associate, Corporate Finance
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to join a global Corporate Finance Advisory business with a strong local presence. Deloitte Corporate Finance is among the most active M&A advisors globally and in Europe and now we are looking to expand our Corporate Finance team as we have an increasingly high level of activity. We continue to expand our footprint in the Nordic M&A market, which is why we are always looking for ambitious and talented individuals with a strong drive to join our team.

To support our growth, we are now looking for Associate / Senior Associate to join our Corporate Finance team in Helsinki.

About the role

As an Associate or Senior Associate in our Corporate Finance team you will work in diverse client engagements across M&A, strategic advisory, valuation and analysis together with our team. You will participate in the day-to-day project management of our engagements, which includes for example preparing materials to support our clients’ decision-making, creating sales materials, identifying new potential customers, performing demanding analyses in Excel and being in constant dialogue with our clients.

Deloitte Corporate Finance has broad experience in executing complex transactions for large listed multinational companies and Private Equity investors across industries. We also advise medium-sized and family-owned businesses. Our assignments primarily consist of sell-side and buy-side mandates and carve-outs for listed companies, with both smaller and larger transactions represented. International deals are carried out in close collaboration with Deloitte’s global network, and the number of cross-border transactions is steadily increasing.

Our job is versatile and fast paced, so we hope you feel comfortable working in constantly changing situations. In return we as an employer provide you a smoother daily life through flexible ways of working, community where we enjoy working together in a fun and casual atmosphere, and suitable amount of responsibility according to your situation.

Why Deloitte?

🟢 At Deloitte, we value every individual and prioritise feedback and coaching at all stages of your career. Our career development opportunities help you build the skills and capabilities you need to succeed and progress in your career.

🟢 Our flat hierarchy means that work is centred around the strengths of our experts. We make a positive impact on each other, our clients, and society through our significant client projects.

🟢 We work with a hybrid working model and aim to offer flexibility to our employees. We value face-to-face collaboration and learning at our modern office in Ruoholahti, while also providing opportunities for remote work.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
You’ll join a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists working on our core automation platform, from first prototypes through to production systems. You’ll design, implement and test firmware that runs on ARM microcontrollers, work directly with hardware on the bench, and help shape technical decisions across firmware, electronics and the wider system.

This is not a role confined to the firmware team: you may spend as much time working with electronics, mechanical, automation and systems engineers, and with biologists, as you do with other firmware or software engineers. You’ll need to enjoy crossing disciplinary boundaries and learning enough about the wider system to help make it work as one coherent whole.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own firmware development for key parts of our core technology, from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification and support in production.
  • Write and review high-quality C for ARM microcontrollers (primarily STM32), focusing on robust, maintainable and testable code.
  • Design and maintain automated tests for embedded firmware, including unit, integration and hardware-in-the-loop, and integrate them into continuous integration workflows.
  • Turn system needs into clear firmware requirements and interfaces, working directly with electronics, mechanical, automation and software engineers, plus biologists.
  • Make and communicate technical decisions within your area, balancing engineering rigour, maintainability and delivery speed, and support other engineers through design discussions and code reviews.
  • Debug complex embedded-system issues using tools such as debug probes, oscilloscopes, multimeters and logic analysers, getting to the root cause of tricky problems.
  • Use Linux-based tools and development environments as part of your day-to-day work.
  • Support and occasionally develop custom test equipment for internal use, helping the wider team move faster.
  • Use higher-level languages such as Python, C# or Java to build supporting tools and simple GUIs for debugging, testing or internal users.

Depending on your experience, you may also:

  • Turn your hand to electronics design and prototype modification when needed, working with electronics engineers to shape interfaces and resolve cross-discipline issues.
  • Develop and optimise hard real-time algorithms for motion control, sensing or safety-critical functions.
  • Use Docker and containers to create reliable, repeatable development and test environments.
  • Contribute to embedded Linux software and the interfaces between it and our microcontroller firmware.

About you

You enjoy seeing firmware come to life in real hardware, and you like being close to the bench, motors and sensors rather than hidden away from the physical system. You are comfortable owning firmware end to end, from first requirements and architecture through to code that ships, and you get energy from solving problems with people from different technical backgrounds.

We’re looking for:

  • A strong track record of designing and delivering embedded systems, with the judgement to take ownership and make pragmatic technical decisions independently.
  • Extensive professional experience developing firmware in C and/or C++ on ARM microcontrollers, ideally STM32.
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining automated tests for embedded systems, including using them within continuous integration workflows.
  • Confidence working directly with hardware and independently debugging complex systems at both code and signal level.
  • Strong skills in interpreting component datasheets and electronics schematics, and using them to inform design and debugging.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, support other engineers and solve problems with people from very different disciplines.

Cellular Origins is currently based on the TTP Campus, within purpose-built sustainable offices, labs and green surroundings, 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and collaboration, while providing you the freedom to do your best work.

Our employee benefits include:

  • Annual bonus
  • 25 days holiday
  • Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary
  • Private medical insurance for employees and dependants
  • Enhanced family friendly leave
  • Life insurance worth 6x salary
  • Electric car leasing scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Season ticket loan

title: Data Centre Field Operations Engineer
description:
About The Role

We are seeking an Infrastructure Operations Lead to oversee operational performance across our high-density GPU data center footprint.

This is an on-site vendor governance and technical escalation role. You will act as our primary operational anchor—managing vendor performance and holding our Managed Service Provider (MSP), Co-Location Facility Provider, and Enterprise Customers accountable to their operational standards, service contracts, and SLAs.

Key Responsibilities

  • 360° Vendor & Service Governance: Oversee third-party service delivery to enforce hardware repair SLAs, ticket response times, and spare parts/RMA workflows. Ensure the co-location provider meets power and high-density cooling guarantees, while keeping enterprise customers within agreed operating boundaries.
  • Crisis Management & Incident Command: Act as On-Site Incident Commander during high-severity outages or infrastructure degradation. Lead recovery efforts by coordinating across vendor engineering teams and internal stakeholders.
  • Incident & Executive Communication: Provide concise, real-time updates to executive leadership and enterprise clients during major outages, translating complex technical failures into clear operational impact.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Post-Mortems: Lead technical investigations following major incidents. Audit and challenge technical RCAs provided by vendors (MSP/Colo) to identify systemic hardware, environmental, or workflow issues, ensuring permanent corrective actions are executed.
  • Technical Escalation & Standards: Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex GPU/HPC hardware escalations that exceed standard vendor runbooks, and maintain ownership of operational standards.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in data center infrastructure operations, with a strong focus on third-party vendor management, SLA enforcement, and service delivery for high-density GPU/HPC platforms.
  • Crisis management: Proven ability to drive incident recovery and direct third-party vendor teams during critical data center outages under high-pressure conditions.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to bridge technical vendor teams, internal stakeholders, and enterprise client representatives.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Expertise: Demonstrated capability in methodical troubleshooting, post-incident investigations, and auditing vendor-supplied RCAs (using frameworks like 5-Whys or Fishbone) to drive long-term infrastructure reliability.
  • Technical & Facility Knowledge: Solid understanding of enterprise server platforms (NVIDIA Blackwell GPU architectures, high-speed networking RoCE,infiniband) and data center facility constraints (high-density power distribution, liquid cooling).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Lead Designer (B2B Marketing + Brand), London
description:
Purpose of the role
HH Global is at a pivotal point in its brand evolution. As we continue to strengthen our market position and tell our story more effectively, creative excellence will be critical to our success. This role offers the opportunity to shape how we as a global organization, present ourselves to clients, prospects, partners and colleagues. You'll play a central role in defining the future look and feel of HH Global, helping us create a brand experience that is more inspiring, more differentiated and more impactful than ever before.
We're looking for a highly creative and strategically minded Lead Designer to help elevate HH Global's brand and creative output globally. Sitting within the Brand Creative team and working closely with the Global Marketing function, this role will serve as the creative lead across key marketing and brand initiatives. You'll help shape the future direction of our visual identity, play an instrumental role in our upcoming brand refresh and bring fresh thinking that pushes our brand into new and more distinctive territory.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong conceptual thinking with exceptional design craft. You'll be responsible for developing creative ideas, visual narratives and brand experiences that elevate our market presence across campaigns, content, events, digital platforms, thought leadership and strategic business initiatives.
Alongside leading creative development, you'll act as a brand champion and trusted partner to teams across the business, helping drive best practice, consistency and creative excellence across everything we produce. While this role will predominantly focus on marketing and brand initiatives, there will be opportunities to support high-value pitch activity, executive communications and strategic business projects where creative thinking can make a meaningful impact.
This is a blended / hybrid role based between Home and our office in Bishopsgate.

Brand evolution + creative leadership

Help define and elevate the visual language of HH Global, ensuring it reflects our ambition, innovation and leadership position within the industry
Lead the conceptual development of creative ideas, campaigns and visual storytelling approaches across key marketing initiatives
Translate business objectives and marketing strategies into engaging and impactful creative solutions
Develop scalable design frameworks, templates and systems that support consistency while enabling creativity

Marketing + brand design

Drive the visual execution of major brand campaigns, content programs, events and strategic marketing initiatives
Partner with content, communications and marketing teams to bring stories and ideas to life through compelling visual experiences
Work closely with external agencies and internal teams to ensure creative output consistently reflects best-in-class standards
Explore new formats, technologies and design approaches that help differentiate HH Global in the market

Brand guardian + creative excellence

Serve as an ambassador for the HH Global brand, promoting consistency and excellence across all visual communications
Support the continued development and adoption of brand guidelines, tools and resources
Provide expert guidance on visual storytelling, presentation design, brand application and creative best practice
Review key brand assets and high-profile projects, providing creative direction and quality assurance where required

Support high-value client pitches and strategic business opportunities through creative ideation and design leadership
Contribute to the development of premium pitch presentations, immersive experiences and branded environments when required
Support executive-level communications and key internal initiatives that require high-impact creative thinking

Team collaboration + mentorship

Work closely with the Head of Brand Creative and Global Head of Marketing to drive the ongoing evolution of the HH Global brand

Foster a culture of creativity, innovation and continuous improvement
Share knowledge, inspiration and emerging best practices across the team

Experience in brand design, marketing design or creative agency environments
A strong portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, brand development and creative excellence across multiple channels and formats. The portfolio should demonstrate the design journey from conceptualization to final output

Experience leading creative projects from concept through to execution _ ability to develop strategic creative solutions that align with business and marketing objectives
Experience supporting high-value pitch, bid or sales enablement activity
Knowledge of event, experiential and environmental design
Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging senior leaders both through written and oral presentations _ experience working within complex, fast-paced and multi-stakeholder environments
Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality creative output _ ability to balance creativity with commercial and business objectives
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects _ strong presentation design skills, particularly within PowerPoint and Keynote
Experience designing for digital platforms, websites and social channels _ understanding of motion graphics, animation and video storytelling principles
Knowledge of UX, UI and digital design best practices _ experience using AI-powered creative tools to enhance efficiency, ideation and content creation workflows
Strong understanding of design systems and brand governance
Desirable: experience leading or supporting major brand refreshes or rebrands | designing within B2B, technology, professional services or global corporate environments | collaboration with offshore design teams | experience supporting high-value pitch, bid or sales enablement activity

Brand evolution: playing a visible, credited role in the brand refresh; not just present in the room, but shaping the actual direction of the visual identity, challenging where challenge is need and shaping the direction of the roll out of the new brand

title: Process Technician - 3rd shift
description:
The Fastener Solutions Division of Avery Dennison is a worldwide manufacturer of plastic fastening systems used in the automotive, apparel, retail, industrial and packaging industries. Our three-shift injection molding and extrusion operation is located in Fitchburg, MA. The Fastener Solutions Division is ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 certified.

This role will be on 3rd shift, 10:45pm to 7am

The hiring rate for this role is $30.25/hour + $1.75 Shift Differential

The successful Process Technician candidate will ensure that equipment is functioning and operating at top efficiency and quality. This position is a technical role, with responsibilities to include equipment start-ups, monitoring / adjusting machine parameters, assisting in changeovers and handling process and equipment issues. We are looking for candidates aspiring to develop skills in troubleshooting, diagnosis, and corrective action. This role will need to be continually learning and absorbing knowledge from established/senior process technicians and applying what they learn.

Activities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Run and oversee all aspects of the plastic injection molding/ extrusion process, including setup, operation, and troubleshooting of machinery.
  • Collaborate closely with line inspectors and packers to uphold product quality and meet production goals.
  • Use precision instruments to monitor meters, gauges, temperatures, and pressures to maintain adherence to production specifications.
  • Configure machines with precision to accommodate varying production needs and ensure optimal performance.
  • Conduct regular tests and inspections to verify product quality according to established procedures.
  • Actively participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, increase efficiency, and reduce waste.
  • Maintain accurate production records and promptly report any equipment malfunctions or deviations from process standards.
  • HS diploma or GED required. A preferred candidate will have additional targeted technical education in plastics materials or in manufacturing machine processing
  • Minimum 3yrs of experience in plastic extrusion or similar manufacturing environments
  • Ability to interpret technical documents and follow detailed instructions.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and efficiency.

title: Staff Engineer (M/F/D)
description:
We are opening a Staff Software Engineer position with a cross-squad scope. It is a senior individual contributor role, reporting directly to the Head of Engineering.

Your impact will be measured by how much the whole engineering team improves with you in it: the quality of our architecture, the speed at which squads deliver, and the technical level of the engineers around you. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you will shape the technical direction of our three squads, lead the technical initiatives no single squad can own, help teams with their hardest problems, and keep writing code. This is a job for someone who still likes to build.


Our Tech Department?

Our stack

  • Ruby on Rails monolith

  • Micro-services in Go, Ruby

  • Postgres, MySQL and Redis

  • ElasticSearch or Algolia, depending on our use case.

  • gRPC

  • Kafka

  • React, TypeScript, Next.js, React testing library and Storybook

  • AWS hosting, Kubernetes, monitored with Grafana.

  • Continuous deployment with Github & CircleCI


Our organization (the famous “Spotify model” adapted so differently by each company)

  • 60 people (engineers, product people and data team)

  • 1 product engineering tribe with 3 impact teams and 3 Staff Engineers

  • 1 platform tribe including a QA team, a core engineering team, a devops & SRE team

  • Each team with a hands-on Engineering Manager

  • Staff Engineers report directly to the Head of Engineering

  • Software craftsmanship: clean code, testing, peer programming, code review, etc.


What you will do

Architecture and technical direction across squads

  • With the other Staff Engineers, you define and maintain the target architecture of the platform and turn it into a technical roadmap that squads follow because it is clear and practical.

  • You anticipate the technical problems the product will hit in the next 6 to 12 months and make the design decisions that avoid them.

  • You frame the most complex and ambiguous technical topics at the system level (data models, service boundaries, event flows, integrations with external tools) and bring them to a decision.

  • You make trade-offs explicit for Product and Engineering leadership: what a pattern brings versus what it costs, what we build now versus what we defer.

Hands-on technical leadership

  • You write code on the critical and transverse pieces: shared libraries, core services, migrations, performance and reliability work that spans squads.

  • You know large sections of the codebase in depth, and you are the person squads call when they are stuck on a hard problem or a production incident.

  • You set the example on testing, observability and deployment practices, and you make good practice the easy default rather than a rule to enforce.

  • You remove complexity wherever you find it: fewer moving parts, fewer ways of doing the same thing, less work for the same outcome.

Growing the engineering team

  • You mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and you help seniors become mentors themselves.

  • Jointly with the chapter leads, you run the backend community: design reviews, tech talks, workshops, shared guidelines and documentation.

  • You represent JobTeaser engineering outside the company, at meetups, in articles or in open source.

Working with engineering leadership

  • You work with the Head of Engineering and the Engineering Managers to structure technical work, staff transverse initiatives and weigh technical investment against product needs.

  • You help technical debates reach a decision, then communicate and support that decision once it is made.

  • You pick up transverse topics that have no natural owner.



What will be your next challenges?

  • Consolidate our tech stack, practices and tooling across our microservice architecture into a cohesive technical vision

  • Lead explorations and architectural design of complex new features and integrations with new tools

  • Supervise the proper documentation of our architectural decisions and practices

  • Participate in the animation of the community of backend and frontend developers

  • Guide improvements to our platform’s monitoring, alerting and reliability

  • Mentor and assist other backend developers and teams on complex problems

Who are you? 🎯

  • We care more about judgment and track record than about years of experience. As a reference point, you probably have 8 or more years in software engineering, including a substantial period in a transverse or lead role spanning several teams (Staff, Principal, Lead or equivalent) in a product company such as a SaaS, a marketplace or a platform.

  • You have strong backend skills in Ruby or another backend ecosystem, and you are at ease with distributed systems, relational databases, Kafka, REST and gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes.

  • You have built and operated business-critical systems at scale, led a large migration or architectural transition across several teams, and can point to measurable improvements in stability, performance or scalability that you drove.

  • You know when structure adds value and when it gets in the way. You prefer clear code to clever code, and you can say "not yet" as easily as "yes".

  • You align engineers, managers and product people without hierarchical authority, and you are comfortable with disagreement when it leads to a better decision.

  • You ask why before how, and you connect technical choices to what users and the business get out of them. You can help Product weigh a roadmap against its technical trade-offs.

  • You explain complex things simply, in writing and in conversation, and you enjoy making other engineers better.

  • You follow what LLMs and agents are changing in software engineering and in products, and you have already used them, for your own work or in something you shipped.

At JobTeaser, get ready to…

  • 💚 Join a mission-driven company with a concrete impact on the new generation.
  • 🌏 Share our three core virtues with our people all over Europe: #OneTeam, #Ownership, #Innovation.
  • 🚀 Take part in a dynamic internal life, where everyone can contribute (all-hands, local parties, team drinks, team-buildings, etc.).
  • 📚 Grow and develop your career with a strong training policy, including an annual individual budget for learning opportunities (95% of our employees were trained last year!).
  • 🏡 Enjoy our flexible work environment: remote-friendly, with one month per year from anywhere in Europe, and home office equipment support. This position can even be fully remote.
  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Benefit from our Family Care Policy: 4 additional paid days off during your return month from parental leave, 3 paid child-sick days per year, and other initiatives to support parents.

title: Process IT Ingenjör
description:
E.ON i Sverige är en del av den internationella energikoncernen E.ON SE med huvudkontor i Essen, Tyskland. Inom koncernen arbetar runt 70 000 personer i 17 länder. Runt om i Sverige arbetar runt 2100 engagerade medarbetare. Vårt nordiska huvudkontor finns i Malmö. I Sverige levererar vi el, värme och smarta energilösningar till drygt en miljon hushåll och företag. E.ON:s roll är att ta ansvar för och driva utvecklingen framåt, för att fler ska kunna ställa om. Med våra investeringar och våra kunders vilja att bidra arbetar vi för att fortsätta elektrifiera samhället och möta framtidens energibehov.

Vill du vara med och säkra framtidens energiförsörjning? Samhället genomgår just nu en av de största omställningarna i modern tid. Elektrifiering, digitalisering och ökade säkerhetskrav ställer helt nya krav på energibranschen. På E.ON är vi mitt i denna resa, där vi bygger framtidens energiinfrastruktur för ett mer hållbart samhälle.

Nu söker vi en Process IT Ingenjör till vårt team Grid IT Systems i Malmö.

Din roll

Du blir en del av ett specialistteam som ansvarar för de IT/OT-system som driver och övervakar Sveriges elnät. Här arbetar du i gränslandet mellan IT och OT, i en verksamhet där hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och stabilitet är avgörande.

Du kommer att arbeta med drift, utveckling och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska plattformar och samtidigt bidra till den digitala utvecklingen av E.ONs elnätsverksamhet.

• Förvalta och utveckla Windows Server- och Active Directory-miljöer.

• Arbeta med virtualisering och applikationsleverans genom VMware vSphere och Citrix.

• Säkerställa en robust och säker IT/OT-miljö med fokus på tillgänglighet och driftsäkerhet.

• Hantera certifikat, PKI-lösningar och säkerhetsrelaterade frågeställningar.

• Automatisera och effektivisera processer genom PowerShell.

• Arbeta med nätverk, autentisering och integrationer såsom DNS, Kerberos, LDAP och GPO.

• Delta i projekt, teknisk utveckling och införande av nya lösningar.

• Samarbeta med interna specialister och externa leverantörer.

Dina erfarenheter

• Erfarenhet av Windows Server och Active Directory.

• Arbetat med VMware, Citrix eller liknande plattformar.

• Kunskap inom IT-säkerhet, certifikathantering och PKI.

• Är bekväm med PowerShell och automatisering.

• Förstår nätverk, autentisering och integrationslösningar.

• Gärna har erfarenhet från OT-, industri- eller annan verksamhetskritisk miljö.

• Trivs med att lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar och utveckla långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

Hur är det hos oss?

Hos oss får du arbeta med teknik som har direkt påverkan på samhället. Du blir en del av ett kompetent team där samarbete, innovation och utveckling står i centrum. Samtidigt bidrar du till att skapa ett säkrare, smartare och mer hållbart energisystem för framtida generationer.

På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.

Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin egen hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är t.ex. arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!

Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav.

Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är xx

What We Offer

title: Maintenance & Equipment Engineer (Aviation Exp)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Maintenance & Equipment Engineer to support the PMC team in the planning and delivery of ORAT activities for a major aviation project. The role will focus on ensuring that aviation facilities, equipment, systems, maintenance processes, and operational resources are ready for safe and effective operations prior to transition to the operational team.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate maintenance and equipment readiness activities as part of the overall ORAT program.
• Develop and maintain maintenance readiness plans, equipment readiness schedules, and transition requirements.
• Review facility and equipment design to ensure operability, maintainability, accessibility, reliability, and lifecycle requirements are adequately addressed.
• Identify and track equipment and maintenance readiness requirements through construction, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.
• Coordinate with operational stakeholders to define maintenance requirements, procedures, staffing, training, spare parts, tools, and consumables.
• Develop and maintain asset registers, equipment databases, tagging requirements, and maintenance data required for operational readiness.
• Review and validate preventive and corrective maintenance strategies, maintenance plans, and maintenance schedules.
• Coordinate the development and review of O&M manuals, maintenance procedures, equipment documentation, warranties, spare parts lists, and technical handover records.
• Support testing, commissioning, operational trials, demonstrations, and readiness exercises to verify equipment and systems are operationally ready.
• Participate in ORAT inspections, readiness assessments, operational demonstrations, and scenario-based exercises.
• Identify equipment and maintenance-related readiness gaps, risks, and constraints, and develop and track corrective actions.
• Coordinate with the Contractor, equipment suppliers, operators, and Client stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of equipment and maintenance readiness issues.
• Support the development and implementation of maintenance training and competency requirements for operational and maintenance personnel.
• Verify the availability of critical spares, specialist tools, consumables, equipment, and maintenance resources prior to operational commencement.
• Support asset acceptance, operational handover, and transition from the project delivery team to the operator.
• Coordinate with ORAT workstreams to ensure maintenance and equipment requirements are integrated with operations, facilities, ICT, security, HSE, and other operational functions.
• Support the development and execution of operational readiness and transition activities.
• Prepare readiness reports, dashboards, risk registers, action trackers, and management updates related to maintenance and equipment.
• Ensure maintenance and equipment readiness activities comply with aviation regulations, authority requirements, project standards, and operational procedures.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aviation Engineering, or related discipline.
• 8+ years of relevant experience in maintenance, equipment engineering, asset management, operational readiness, or airport operations.
• Proven experience in aviation/airport projects, preferably with direct involvement in ORAT or operational transition programs.
• Strong understanding of ORAT principles, operational readiness, activation, transition, and facility handover.
• Experience developing and implementing maintenance strategies, asset registers, preventive maintenance programs, and O&M requirements.
• Experience coordinating equipment readiness, testing and commissioning, operational trials, training, and handover activities.
• Knowledge of airport facilities, aviation systems, specialist equipment, and operational interfaces is highly desirable.
• Experience working with airport operators, maintenance teams, Contractors, equipment suppliers, Designers, and Client stakeholders.
• Familiarity with asset management, maintenance management, and equipment lifecycle requirements.

title: Handläggare
description:
På Åklagarmyndigheten känner vi stolthet när vi går till jobbet. Tillsammans är vi över 2 250 engagerade och kompetenta medarbetare som står upp för rättssäkerhet, rättstrygghet och demokratiska värden. Oavsett roll i myndigheten bidrar alla till vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag. För oss är arbetet mot brottsligheten ett lagarbete där varje medarbetares kompetens och insats gör skillnad. Vill du bli en del av Åklagarmyndigheten? Vi strävar efter att vara en välkomnande och inkluderande arbetsplats som speglar samhällets mångfald. Ansök redan i dag! 1 plats(er).

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Anställningen är placerad på Norrorts åklagarkammare. Som handläggare möter du en händelserik vardag med varierande arbetsuppgifter.

Du arbetar självständigt men också tillsammans i grupp för att få det administrativa arbetet att fungera. Service är en stor del i ditt vardagliga arbete, både internt och externt.

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bl.a. att:

  • ge åklagare administrativt stöd, t.ex. arbete i brottmålsdiariet, hantera arkivering och utföra allmänna kontorsuppgifter
  • kontrollera, bedöma och registrera inkomna ärenden
  • vara kontakten utåt i många sammanhang och därmed ge god service till både allmänheten och till andra myndigheter, främst via telefon och e-post
  • utföra arbetsuppgifter som fördelas från administrativ chef t.ex. viss beredning.

Vardagen är händelsestyrd och det kan snabbt inkomma brådskande ärenden som gör att du behöver ta snabba beslut och kunna göra en avvägning av vad som är brådskande eller inte.

Dina kvaliteter och kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som

  • har gymnasieexamen eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
  • har aktuell och relevant skicklighet som motsvarar några års väl vitsordat arbete med administrativa uppgifter
  • har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av arbete i it-miljö och med digitala verktyg inom administration, telefoni, möten m.m.
  • har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person vill vi att du

  • är noggrann, strukturerad och kan följa de förhållningsregler och rutiner som finns
  • är självständig och ansvarstagande
  • är stresstålig då arbetsbelastningen vid vissa tillfällen kan vara hög
  • är stabil med god självkännedom
  • har lätt för att samarbeta och har ett öppet förhållningssätt gentemot din omgivning
  • är serviceinriktad
  • har god kommunikationsförmåga.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av arbete inom rättsväsendet.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.

Inför erbjudande om anställning kan det bli aktuellt för Åklagarmyndigheten att genomföra registerkontroll i misstankeregistret och belastningsregistret. Registerkontrollen genomförs på slutkandidaten.

Tester kan förekomma i rekryteringsprocessen.

Åklagarmyndigheten är en beredskapsmyndighet. Vid en anställning kan du komma att krigsplaceras på Åklagarmyndigheten. Läs mer under Jobba hos oss (https://www.aklagare.se/karriar/att-jobba-hos-oss/krigsplacering/).

På grund av arkivbestämmelser sparar vi ansökningar i två år. När du ansöker kommer dina personuppgifter att behandlas enligt offentlighetsprincipen samt dataskyddsförordningen. När du skickar din ansökan till oss, samtycker du till detta.

Vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan på svenska.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

title: Data Quality Assurance Engineer (Temporary)
description:
You are a Data Quality Assurance Engineer who enjoys ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data across complex data environments. You have hands-on experience validating high-volume datasets, testing ETL processes, and using SQL to identify data inconsistencies and verify expected results.

You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across databases, Big Data environments, and backend systems. You bring a strong quality mindset to data-driven solutions and enjoy collaborating with technical teams to identify defects, validate data integrity, and continuously improve testing practices.

Note: This role operates under a 3-month contractor model.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 1+ years of professional experience in Big Data and Data Quality Testing.
  • Experience applying data profiling techniques when working with high volumes of data.
  • Hands-on experience testing ETL processes and validating data throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Strong experience with SQL for data validation and testing purposes, including writing medium to complex queries.
  • Solid understanding of relational and non-relational databases, including data integrity verification.
  • Experience working with scheduling and orchestration tools such as Airflow, AutoSys, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with test management tools such as ALM and requirement/defect management tools such as Jira.
  • Experience creating, documenting, maintaining, and executing test plans and test cases.
  • Experience documenting, tracking, and communicating defects throughout the testing lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a solid quality assurance mindset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full Professional English proficiency.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Perform data quality validations to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data processing within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.
  • Write medium to complex SQL queries to perform data validation and verify expected results.
  • Test and validate ETL processes and data transformations throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Perform testing and verification of backend applications, databases, Big Data environments, and related tools following established best practices.
  • Verify the capture of analytics events in related file systems or databases using SQL or scripting languages such as Python or Shell.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute regression automation for GUI applications, backend services, and ETL processes.
  • Identify, document, track, and communicate defects discovered during testing.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and supporting QA documentation.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to investigate data-quality issues and support defect resolution.

Qualifications

  • 1+ years of professional experience in Big Data and Data Quality Testing.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL testing, data profiling, and high-volume data validation.
  • Strong SQL skills for data validation and testing.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases.
  • Experience with scheduling/orchestration tools such as Airflow or AutoSys.
  • Experience creating and executing test plans and test cases.
  • Full Professional English proficiency.

About Us

As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

title: Inspector (Electrical/ICT)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Electrical Inspector to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In this critical role, you will be responsible for ensuring the safety, quality, and compliance of electrical installations.

The Electrical Inspector will be responsible for inspecting and monitoring electrical works on site to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, applicable codes and standards, and project quality requirements. The role will support the project team in maintaining construction quality, identifying deficiencies, and ensuring timely resolution of electrical issues.

The Electrical Inspector will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and compliance of electrical installations.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct thorough inspections of Electrical systems, installations, and equipment to ensure compliance with contract documents, specifications, relevant local and international codes and standards.
• Conduct daily inspections of electrical, ICT, and ELV systems, including MV/LV distribution, MV substations, structured cabling, CCTV, security systems, fire alarm, and associated infrastructure.
• Monitor installation of street lighting, Apron floodlighting, GPUs, AGL, SAS, and telecom infrastructure.
• Conduct regular surveillance of site work against documented processes.
• Conduct daily inspections of ICT and ELV installations, including structured cabling, racks, termination panels, and active/passive components.
• Ensure proper installation of systems such as CCTV, access control, public address, fire alarm, and building management interfaces.
• Conduct a review of work pack documentation and validate test data as meeting specified requirements and/or within tolerance.
• Ensuring incorporated materials on projects comply with the plans and specifications.
• Witness testing and commissioning of electrical systems.
• Monitor and verify installation methods, workmanship, and Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures compliance.
• Review and verify method statements, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and material submittals.
• Raise non-conformance reports (NCRs) and ensure timely resolution.
• Maintain accurate and detailed records of inspections and progress report out on the site.
• Participate in site coordination and progress meetings with contractors and stakeholders to resolve technical issues on-site.
• Identify and document electrical deficiencies, code violations, and potential safety hazards.
• Collaborate with contractors, engineers, and project managers to resolve electrical issues and ensure timely project completion.
• Prepare detailed inspection reports and maintain accurate records of all inspections and findings.
• Stay up to date with changes in Saudi Arabian and international electrical codes, regulations, and industry best practices.
• Provide expert guidance and recommendations to improve electrical safety and efficiency on project sites.
• Participate in pre-construction meetings to discuss electrical requirements and potential challenges.
• Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager/supervisor.

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in electrical/ ICT & ELV inspection, preferably in infrastructure and hanger projects.
  • Aviation project experience is preferred.
  • Prior experience working with a Project Management Consultant (PMC) is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of Saudi electrical codes, SEC standards, and international regulations.
  • Good understanding of electrical systems used in infrastructure projects (e.g., street lighting, utility networks, cabling, MV/LV substations, AGL, SAS systems, etc.).
  • Strong knowledge of structured cabling, networking, and integrated systems.
  • Strong communication and reporting skills.
  • Ability to work independently and within a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Saudi Arabian and international electrical codes and standards.
  • Extensive knowledge of electrical & ICT systems and components.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and schematics.
  • Proven experience working on construction sites and aviation projects.
  • Expertise in using various testing equipment and inspection tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant inspection software.
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong commitment to safety and quality.
  • In-depth knowledge of construction industry regulations and safety standards.

title: PhD Scholarship: Understanding and addressing anti-government and sovereign citizen extremism in Australia
description:
The research will be undertaken within the School of Criminology & Criminal Justice at Griffith University. Griffith University was recently ranked #1 in Australia for its research on peace, justice and strong institutions and #2 in the world for Impact (2026 Times Higher Education Impact Ratings). You will work specifically within Griffith University’s School of Criminology & Criminal Justice community, the largest in Australia, and widely considered Australia’s #1 criminology research program. At Griffith University, we’ve worked hard to create a culture that will challenge you to be curious, creative and courageous. We also support the professional and personal development of all our HDR candidates and invest in the skills of our people. Griffith University values diversity, inclusion and flexibility.

The selection of applicants for the award of higher degree research scholarships at Griffith University involves consideration of your academic merit and research background. To be successful within this role, you will be able to demonstrate strong analytical skills, have demonstrated experience using the research methods described above, and be able to work independently as part of a research team. You must be able to communicate research findings clearly in writing and in presentations, and engage critically with current literature on procedural justice as well as radicalisation and extremism. You will have evidence of a passion for extremism-related research and have a strong desire to undertake research on anti-government and Sovereign citizen forms of extremism.

  • Expressions of interest are welcome from domestic applicants only. As the project has been funded by the Office of National Intelligence applicants are required to be Australian citizens, Australian permanent residents, or New Zealand special category Visa holders. Note that proof of your status must be provided and approved by the Office of National Intelligence before an offer of scholarship is made.
  • Applicants must have completed a Bachelor’s degree with honours equivalent to first-class honours or second-class honours (Division A), or a Master’s degree (AQF Level 9) incorporating a significant research component of a standard comparable to a Bachelor honours degree, or be regarded by Griffith University as having an equivalent level of attainment in accordance with Schedule One of the HDR Scholarship Policy.
  • a record of research, or a qualification granted by a professional or other body deemed by the Dean, Griffith Graduate Research School, to be of a comparable standard. For further information please refer to the Equivalent Qualifications for HDR Program Admission web page.

Please note:

  • Applicants with a background in psychology, criminology, political science or a cognate discipline are being sought, with additional experience working in the national intelligence or policing field being a distinct advantage.

About the scholarship

The 2026 Griffith University Postgraduate Research Scholarship has an annual stipend of $35,656 (indexed) for a period of up to three years of full-time study. Please see the GUPRS Conditions of Award for more information.

The successful applicant will also be awarded a scholarship top-up of $20,000 per annum for three years from the Office of National Intelligence funded project. The total annual stipend for 3 years will be $55,656. The candidate will also be eligible to access a further $4,500 from the School of Criminology & Criminal Justice to support their research, to undertake relevant professional development, or to attend conferences to present their research.

What Griffith offers

As a scholarship holder, you will study with a University that ranks among the top 2% worldwide and spans across campuses in South East Queensland. At Griffith University, we’ve worked hard to create a culture that will challenge you to be curious, creative and courageous. We also support the professional and personal development of all our HDR candidates and invest in the skills of our people. Griffith University values diversity, inclusion and flexibility and we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. Griffith's strategic goals are to also increase the proportion of women in senior academic and administrative roles and in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics and Medicine (STEMM).

EOI Process

Please do not select the “APPLY” button. All expressions of interest must be submitted to Professor Kristina Murphy (t.murphy@griffith.edu.au), containing:

  • Statement addressing your suitability for the project/scholarship and why you are interested in joining the research project.
  • Evidence that you have completed a program with the required grades as detailed in the about you section (e.g., academic transcript), with a brief discussion of the research component of this program.
  • A curriculum vitae (CV) with your contact details using the Griffith CV template.
  • Names and contact details of two referees who can comment about your suitability to undertake study at a PhD level.
  • Evidence of Australian citizenship, permanent residency, or New Zealand special category Visa holder.

The closing date for expressions of interest is: Friday the 16th of October 2026

The preferred applicant will then be invited to apply for the program and scholarship on-line.

Professor Kristina Murphy (Tina)
Email: t.murphy@griffith.edu.au

For administration enquiries please contact:
Griffith Graduate Research School
Email: hdr-scholarship@griffith.edu.au

title: Senior KDB Developer
description:
Senior KDB+ Developer

Location: London, UK
Employment Type: Permanent / Contract (depending on engagement)
Company: Talan

About the Role

Talan is seeking an experienced Senior KDB+ Developer to join a high-performing front-office technology team supporting Fixed Income electronic and algorithmic trading activities in London.

You will work closely with traders, quantitative specialists and technology teams to design, develop and enhance pricing, trading, hedging and risk management solutions for Fixed Income products. Operating within a fast-paced front-office environment, you will be part of a small, highly collaborative KDB+ development team delivering real-time analytics and trading capabilities with rapid feedback cycles and frequent releases.

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior engineer who combines deep KDB+ expertise with strong analytical thinking and business-facing communication skills. You will also be expected to provide technical leadership and mentorship to more junior team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with traders and stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver effective technical solutions.
  • Design, develop, test and deploy enhancements to Fixed Income algorithmic trading and risk management platforms.
  • Build and maintain high-performance real-time KDB+ processes, schemas and APIs.
  • Develop solutions for trading surveillance, compliance monitoring and algorithm oversight.
  • Create monitoring and visualisation dashboards using Altair Panopticon where appropriate.
  • Perform ad hoc statistical and quantitative analysis of trading algorithm performance, market data and client activity.
  • Support the ongoing maintenance, optimisation and evolution of KDB+ infrastructure and applications.
  • Contribute to release management processes, ensuring robust controls and adherence to governance standards.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior developers and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  • Deliver third-line support and technical expertise to production support and operational teams.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Extensive commercial experience developing with KDB+ / q in a front-office or electronic trading environment.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including design, testing and delivery methodologies.
  • Experience developing and supporting real-time data processing systems.
  • Good knowledge of UNIX/Linux environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with traders and business stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of Fixed Income products, electronic trading, market data or quantitative finance.

Desirable

  • Experience with the TorQ framework.
  • Knowledge of qSpec, qUnit or similar automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience developing dashboards using Altair Panopticon.
  • Exposure to trading algorithm governance, monitoring or compliance tooling.
  • Previous experience mentoring developers or leading technical initiatives.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on senior developer who thrives in a fast-moving front-office environment. You will be comfortable engaging directly with business users, translating complex requirements into robust technical solutions, and delivering high-quality software with short delivery cycles.

If you have a passion for financial markets, enjoy solving complex data challenges and want to work at the intersection of technology and trading, we'd love to hear from you.

The role exists to lead, manage, and deliver NHS Supply Chain’s Freedom of Information (FOI) process in full alignment with the Freedom of Information Act. Manage and oversee all Freedom of Information (FOI) requests to ensure full compliance with the Freedom of Information Act.

Collaborate with internal teams to gather information and liaise with the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) and NHS England on relevant requests.

title: In Custody Careers Advisor
description:
In Custody Careers Advisor (CIAG)

Salary: £27,145 (pro rata £13,572 )
Location: HMP Doncaster

Contract: 0.5 part time 18.75 hours

We’re looking for a dedicated Careers Information Advice and Guidance Advisor to join our team - a crucial role in supporting individuals inside a custodial setting by providing tailored career advice, guidance, and support. This role aims to empower prisoners to identify their career aspirations, develop their skills, and leverage their strengths to prepare for successful reintegration into society upon release.

About the Role:

You will provide tailored careers advice and guidance to prisoners through both one-to-one sessions and group workshops. You will create and manage personalised learning plans to help prisoners to identify and work towards their goals during custody and in preparation for release. Your role will support rehabilitation by equipping individuals with the skills, qualifications, and opportunities needed to secure employment or further training upon release.

You will organise opportunities for prisoners to connect with employers and participate in employment related activities. Through your support, prisoners will be encouraged to take meaningful steps towards long-term career development and positive reintegration into the community.

This is a demanding yet deeply rewarding role. You'll be working in a challenging environment with individuals who have complex needs and may be hesitant to engage. However, when you help someone break the cycle and take real steps towards transforming their life, the impact is truly life-changing—for them and for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Caseload management: Conduct one-to-one assessments to identify prisoners’ skills, career aspirations and training needs and develop a Prisoner Learning Plan (PLP) and effectively manage your caseload to achieve sustained employment, training, education and completion of prison employment outcomes.
  • Facilitation: Delivery of engaging sessions to groups of participants around topics such as employability skills, career planning and effective disclosure. Ensuring that goals are realistic and consider any barriers to employment sectors due to the nature of certain types of convictions.
  • Relationship Building: Foster genuine, trusting, and non-judgemental relationships with participants creating a safe space for personal growth.
  • Stakeholder management: Engage with prison education departments, training providers, employers and probation services to create employment pathways.
  • Quality Recording: Work towards agreed KPIs, targets, ensuring quality assurance standards in accordance with the service provider are met.

What We are Looking For:

  • Experience delivering guidance, support or advisory services to individuals
  • Ability to assess individual needs and develop action plans to support progression
  • Experience of managing a caseload and working towards agreed targets or outcomes
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate and influence a diverse range of individuals
  • Experience of working with individuals facing barriers to employment or education
  • Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and manage competing demands
  • Hold a Level 3 or Level 4 Information, Advice and Guidance (IAG) qualification, or be willing to work towards this

Whilst we welcome applications from those with lived experience, this role requires an enhanced DBS check and HMPPS EL1 vetting. Due to the time required to complete these checks, successful candidates will be offered a start date at least 6 weeks from the point of job offer. This should allow sufficient time for all necessary pre-employment clearances to be obtained

• Align therapy plans with available funding and funding types

• Participate in team meetings, peer reviews, and case discussions at an appropriate cadence

Organisational Requirements
• Comply with and promote policies relating to WHS, emergency procedures, child safety, and cultural competence
• Participate in risk identification, assessment, and prevention activities
• Engage in networking and maintain collaborative relationships with professionals and agencies
• Maintain discipline-specific registration/membership and adhere to relevant codes of conduct

What you’ll bring:

Experience/ Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience in solution-focused therapy and early intervention

  • Demonstrated ability to engage with a range of children and families and external stakeholders
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • Exceptional observational and report writing skills
  • Ability to work within a multidisciplinary team and the ability to work autonomously in the community

Qualifications / Compliance:

  • NDIS Workers Screening Check
  • Current Drivers’ Licence and vehicle
  • Current Working with Children Check or Working with Vulnerable People Registration (state specific)

What you’ll get:

Flexibility and Wellbeing

  • Flexible hours and compressed work options

  • Up to 16 weeks paid primary carer leave

Reward and support

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Registration and professional membership contribution
  • Relocation reimbursement up to $10,000, if applicable
  • Dedicated admin support so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Work in an environment that focuses on multidisciplinary collaboration, improving outcomes together

Growth, your way

  • Structured mentoring and leadership programs
  • Ongoing opportunities to build your experience, including Fly In Fly Out (FIFO) work supporting children in remote areas
  • National and global career pathways through the APM Group

Who we are:

We’re a dedicated and passionate team of allied health professionals helping children and young people aged 0-16 to reach their full potential. Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with families to deliver personalised, evidence-based support across communication, motor, cognitive and social development. We are a registered NDIS provider and our clinics offer therapy under different funding models. As part of the APM Group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in.
