title: 6-Month Student Placement - Electronic Engineering Consultant - 2027
description:
Interns at TTP use their engineering skillsets to support multi-disciplinary project teams in inventing new products and technologies, utilising commercial aptitude to drive projects forward. To succeed in this role, you’ll demonstrate leadership, build collaborative relationships with clients and ultimately work to having a strong understanding of industries we work across.

From a technical perspective, you will be involved in all aspects of technology and product development: from invention, to analysis, to prototype design and transfer to manufacture. The diversity in our work means that you can find yourself making a difference in a wide range of applications as vast as building state-of-the-art drug delivery devices, accelerating drug discovery through AI & next-gen DMTA, or developing a 5G NTN handset antenna.

You will have the opportunity to work on multiple such projects at any one time, so over a year at TTP your experiences and applications will be vast, and you can expect to develop and expand your understanding of entirely new fields of science and technology rapidly.

Equal to your technical work, you will also develop as a consultant. This means harnessing your entrepreneurial mindset: building an understanding of the markets we work in, engaging directly with clients to present your findings, and proactively ensuring their requirements are fully understood and met. As you gain experience, you will have opportunities to work on complex projects, build teams, and help expand TTP’s reach by building connections and engaging with clients.

We believe growth happens best in a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely and curiosity is encouraged – this is why we have the requirement for all staff to work on-site five days a week. You'll receive mentorship and guidance when needed, but also the space and trust to take initiative, explore your interests, and shape your own development. You'll be encouraged to contribute early, take ownership of your work, and collaborate across disciplines to deliver impactful solutions.

  • Deep intellectual curiosity and inventiveness, with a desire to understand how things work at a fundamental level. You should have an academic record that reflects your capacity for rigorous, first-principles thinking - being on track for a minimum 2:1 in Electronic Engineering or a closely related discipline, with strong accompanying A-Levels (or equivalent, i.e. IB qualifications).

  • Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, excited by the opportunity to turn breakthrough technologies into real-world products, ventures, and impact.

  • Proactive and self-starting, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and a drive to make things happen.

  • Collaborative and emotionally intelligent, able to build trust, influence stakeholders, energise those around you, and communicate complex technical ideas with clarity, empathy, and precision, regardless of your audience's background.

  • Strategic and systems-minded, able to see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges and opportunities while considering the commercial aspects of technology product development, and navigate ambiguity while keeping priorities sharp and focused.

We're looking for candidates who want to impact the industry both commercially and technically; those who don't just solve problems - but who seek them out, thrive on them, and elevate those around them while doing so.

We recruit on a rolling basis, so although there is no application deadline, the advert will close once all spaces have been filled. We recommend applying early for the best chance. You must have completed at least 2 years of your degree when your 6-month placement begins, so students at the beginning of second or third year are welcome to apply.

TTP operates from an award-winning campus in green surroundings, just south of Cambridge. This is a paid internship with generous benefits, including free lunch, as well as a wide range of clubs to join covering sports and social activities.

description:
As an Internal App Builder at Base44, you’ll design, build, and lead projects end-to-end. We are looking for an independent, proactive builder who can take full ownership of projects from concept to deployment without needing hands-on guidance.

title: Develop your radiology career in Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.

We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals.

Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.

Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.

Professional Development

The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.

For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.

You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.

Support for your family

Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.

Language training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.

Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.

Requirements

We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.

Interested?

Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Junior AI Engineer  – AI Code Quality Validation for T Cloud Public (m/f/d)
description:
Mission
Strengthen Meridian software handover readiness by combining AI-assisted software engineering with code quality, security validation, dependency analysis, and build evidence generation for complex cloud platform repositories.

Role focus
This position focuses on trustworthy validation of large codebases. The candidate should use AI development platforms alongside static analysis, dependency scanning, build diagnostics, and expert review to identify risks in OpenStack-derived services, infrastructure code, integration scripts, and platform automation.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

  • Analyse repositories for maintainability, dependency risks, hidden coupling, insecure patterns, build fragility, licensing signals, and documentation gaps relevant to due diligence.
  • Use AI coding agents to accelerate code review preparation, vulnerability explanation, remediation proposal drafting, and technical debt clustering across large codebases.
  • Run and interpret quality, dependency, secret, container, and infrastructure scanning tools while documenting false positives, residual risks, and required expert review.
  • Support reproducible build and release validation by analysing logs, pipeline definitions, container images, package sources, artefact flows, and configuration assumptions.
  • Create evidence packs that link findings to code locations, tool results, reviewer decisions, risk severity, mitigation options, and readiness implications.
  • Collaborate with security, DevOps, architecture, and test specialists to ensure AI-assisted validation results are actionable and aligned with enterprise assurance expectations.

Examples of market tools, models, and SDLC platforms expected

  • AI coding and review environments such as Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Continue, Cline, Aider, or VS Code-based assistants connected to approved model endpoints.
  • Open-source or Chinese coding-capable models such as DeepSeek Coder, Qwen/Qwen-Coder, CodeGeeX, StarCoder, Code Llama, Mistral, or similar internally hosted models.
  • Quality and security tooling such as SonarQube, Semgrep, Trivy, GitGuardian, Syft, Grype, dependency-check, Falco, SBOM tooling, and container/image scanners.
  • Engineering environments including GitLab, GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, ArgoCD, package registries, Python tooling, and log analysis workflows.

YOU WILL SUCCEED IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years in software engineering, secure development, DevSecOps, platform engineering, or quality-focused engineering roles.
  • Strong Python skills plus practical experience in at least one backend or systems language such as Go, Java, C, C++, or Rust.
  • Hands-on experience with code review, vulnerability triage, dependency analysis, CI/CD inspection, container security, or software supply-chain evidence generation.
  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants for code understanding, documentation, remediation proposals, test generation, or large-repository review acceleration.
  • Good understanding of OpenStack-derived cloud platforms, distributed services, Kubernetes, Linux, and enterprise build and release processes is strongly preferred.
  • Comfortable producing concise, evidence-backed findings in high-accountability environments where confidentiality, auditability, and reviewer judgement are essential.
  • Fluent spoken & written English

WHY SHOULD YOU CHOOSE US?

We believe in balance between work and personal life. An attractive and extensive work-life balance portfolio guarantees lasting motivation for employees and thus a better quality of life, promotes physical and mental well-being and contributes to a positive work environment. All this with the aim of providing more freedom in reconciling work, career growth, private life and individual lifestyle. Therefore we offer to our employees over 25 different benefits to improve their personal and professional life in these areas:

  • Financial benefits
  • Benefits with focus on learning and development

  • Benefits with focus on family and work – life balance
  • Other benefits

For more information about our benefits click to Benefits

Final salary is negotiable.

We are offering base salary depending on seniority level and previous experience of candidate. In addition to base salary we provide variable part and other financial benefits. Base salary will not be lower than 2000€ /brutto.

title: Dispatch Coordinator
description:
BlueScope is an Australian-born global success story spanning 15 countries. Our team of over 16,500 people is our strength and we want our people to be safe, successful and well. We’re leaders and innovators in transforming steel into smart products and solutions that support society, today and in the future. We’re proud of brands, like COLORBOND ® steel that inspire and protect everything from hospitals to bridges and stadiums.

The Opportunity

Orrcon Steel Distribution is looking for a Dispatch Coordinator to join the team based predominately in Kewdale, WA with the potential of working at Bibra Lakes, WA. Orrcon Steel Distribution is a leading Australian supplier of steel and aluminium products, offering a comprehensive range engineered to meet the demands of diverse industries. Our products are backed by strong technical expertise, full traceability, and stringent quality standards. Supported by strategic supplier partnerships and a nationwide network of distribution centres, we ensure consistent availability, reliable performance, and dependable supply for customers across Australia.

As a Dispatch Coordinator, you will plan, co-ordinate and control the dispatch of our products, both incoming and outgoing, ensuring high levels of customer service are met. You will be interacting with cross-functional teams including operations, supply chain and sales.

This role is a full-time role working Monday-Friday, with typical working hours 7:00am - 3:30pm, and the potential of earlier starts from time to time. Enjoy a competitive remuneration package including our profit share program (annual bonus). You will have access to various health and wellbeing initiatives including Employment Assistance Program, Employee Real Deals and on-going learning, support and training.

What Will You Do?

In this critical role you will be responsible for:

  • planning, coordinating and controlling inbound and outbound stock movement at the Kewdale site
  • leading and controlling inventory integrity within the site warehouse and ensuring accuracy of stock holding at all times
  • accurate data entry in dispatching orders and expediting for incoming orders
  • liaising with customer service, sales and operations teams, along with third-party transport providers
  • upholding the high safety standards of the site predominantly with issues related to transportation, Chain of Responsibility and Load restraint compliance

More About You

We are on the lookout for a dedicated team player who has the following:

  • high levels of attention to detail and ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • knowledge and experience of MS Office, SAP, WMS or similar ERP systems
  • effective stakeholder engagement and collaboration with departments and teams
  • a positive attitude and willingness to work within the team
  • commitment to your own safety and wellbeing and care for others

Why BlueScope​

As we’re creating strength for the future through our people, products and solutions, BlueScope supports you to build your expertise within a safe and positive team environment. At BlueScope, you’ll:​

  • Learn and develop as you grow. Work alongside specialists and keep your skills and knowledge at the forefront of industry with our lifelong learning culture.​
  • Experience connection and care. Experience a positive, inclusive work environment where we look out for each other’s safety and wellbeing.​
  • Build innovative products. Seek better, smarter ways to work, help develop sustainable solutions and make things happen.​
  • Deliver work that matters. Every action you take matters in delivering for our customers and strengthening communities for the future. We value what you do. ​

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and valued to be their authentic selves, and we encourage Women and First Nations people to apply. We’re passionate about driving sustainability outcomes that matter to our communities, including action on climate and our 2050 net zero goal.​ At BlueScope, we offer work-life flexibility through our B-flex program.

It’s an exciting time in our history as, together, we work towards Our Purpose: “We create and inspire smart solutions in steel, to strengthen communities for the future.” ​

Come and discover us at www.bluescope.com/auscareers​

Join us, creating strength for the future.

title: Senior Speech Pathologist
description:
When you join Early Start Australia, you’ll be part of an allied heath team that’s in it together. A local team that’s right beside you, supported by leaders who know the work. With flexibility and support to thrive, you’ll continue to grow and build a meaningful career, your way.

What you’ll do at our Montrose clinic:

Therapy Service Delivery
• Identify and complete assessments appropriate for each client
• Manage a discipline-specific caseload, including complex clients, using a case management approach
• Contribute to the selection and maintenance of assessment and therapy resources
• Develop, implement, evaluate, and adjust tailored therapy programs aligned to client goals
• Deliver services across clinic, home, school, and community settings as required
• Collaborate with allied health team members to achieve optimal client outcomes
• Develop and deliver specialised programs such as group therapy and parent workshops
• Maintain strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality requirements
• Ensure practice remains aligned with current best practice and contribute to continuous service improvement

• Develop and implement tailored therapy programs for each client, including:

  • Completing initial appointments
  • Developing goal plans based on identified support needs
  • Creating measurable, targeted intervention strategies
  • Collaborating with other health professionals where required (e.g. Speech, Psychology)
  • Preparing home and session-based resources and activities
  • Developing session plans as needed
  • Conducting school and home visits when appropriate
  • Monitoring progress and adjusting goals and programs accordingly
  • Completing reviews and reports as required
  • Identifying suitability for additional services or group programs and incorporating into plans where appropriate

Reporting and Documentation
• Record all treatment notes and activities in PMS within 24 hours of sessions
• Provide timely, high-quality reports to stakeholders (e.g. clients, families, health professionals, NDIA)
• Ensure reports and correspondence meet ESA standards
• Report and document client incidents or complaints in the appropriate systems

Funding and Payments
• Align therapy plans with available funding and funding types
• Obtain and review NDIS plans where relevant to inform therapy planning
• Provide accurate information to support correct invoicing of client-related services

Professional Development
• Participate in team meetings, peer reviews, and case discussions at an appropriate cadence
• Maintain accurate records in line with organisational processes and manager direction
• Utilise professional development opportunities to build role-relevant skills

Organisational Requirements
• Comply with and promote policies relating to WHS, emergency procedures, child safety, and cultural competence
• Participate in risk identification, assessment, and prevention activities
• Engage in networking and maintain collaborative relationships with professionals and agencies
• Maintain discipline-specific registration/membership and adhere to relevant codes of conduct
• Uphold privacy and confidentiality in line with organisational policy and legislation

What you’ll bring:

Experience/ Skills:

• Demonstrated experience delivering high quality evidence-based and goal-focused therapeutic intervention in an early intervention and/ or paediatric allied health setting

• Understanding and supporting the principles of individualised services including the ability to adapt services to meet individual needs

• Demonstrated ability to engage with a range of children and families and external stakeholders

• Demonstrated senior clinical knowledge with significant experience in relevant discipline

• Demonstrated experience mentoring, supervising and/or supporting others of the same discipline (including supervision of graduates and/ or allied health students)

• Strong communication, interpersonal, organisational and time management skills

• Exceptional observational and report writing skills

• Ability to work independently within and collaborate across a multidisciplinary team

Qualifications / Compliance:

  • Relevant qualification in Speech Pathology
  • Registration with AHPRA and Registration with SPA
  • NDIS Workers Screening Check
  • Current Drivers’ Licence and vehicle
  • Current Working with Children Check or Working with Vulnerable People Registration (state specific)
  • National Police Check
  • Accredited First Aid Certificate

What you’ll get:

Flexibility and Wellbeing

  • Flexible hours and compressed work options
  • Up to 12 weeks annual leave.
  • Up to 16 weeks paid primary carer leave
  • Wellbeing support program for you and your family

Reward and support

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Registration and professional membership contribution
  • Relocation reimbursement up to $10,000, if applicable
  • Dedicated admin support so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Work in an environment that focuses on multidisciplinary collaboration, improving outcomes together

Growth, your way

  • CPD allowance + paid professional development leave
  • Structured mentoring and leadership programs
  • Ongoing opportunities to build your experience, including Fly In Fly Out (FIFO) work supporting children in remote areas
  • National and global career pathways through the APM Group

Who we are:

We’re a dedicated and passionate team of allied health professionals helping children and young people aged 0-16 to reach their full potential. Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with families to deliver personalised, evidence-based support across communication, motor, cognitive and social development. We are a registered NDIS provider and our clinics offer therapy under different funding models. As part of the APM Group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

Apply today or reach out to Ayesha on 0461 101 104 or Ayesha.din@apm.net.au for a confidential chat to learn more.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Business Platform
description:

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Business Platform team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The Business Platform powers the backend capabilities that enable businesses and enterprises to onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia.

In this role, you will design, build, and evolve backend platform services that manage business profiles, store metadata, business configuration, and related operational workflows. You'll work on systems that sit close to the source of truth for business data and workflows—systems that directly influence how businesses set up their operations, how internal teams operate reliably, and how downstream products consume trusted business information. What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 5+ years in backend/platform engineering with high-scale production systems.

  • Tech Stack: Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, caching, and observability.
  • Data & Messaging: SQL/NoSQL databases, event-driven architectures, and messaging systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ).
  • Core Competencies: Strong problem-solving and communication skills; version control (Git) proficiency. SaaS or e-commerce domain experience, mentoring junior engineers.

  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team med stark sammanhållning och djup yrkeskunskap. Vårt kunnande sitter inte bara i ritningar – det lever i våra medarbetare, i hur vi arbetar och i hur vi lär av varandra. Det är den kunskapen vi vill föra vidare till dig.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Quant Reports | Canggu, Bali (On-site) | Mid-Level (2–4 Years)

About Quant Reports

Quant Reports is a fintech platform empowering asset and wealth managers to generate branded, QR-coded factsheets, advice documents, and client communications at scale.

The Role

We are seeking an on-site Data Engineer & Client Implementation Specialist based in Canggu, Bali, to bridge financial data pipelines, basic front-end styling, and high-touch customer support. In this role, you will own the client onboarding journey—guiding wealth managers from raw data integration to their first published, QR-integrated report.

What You Will Do

  • Data Engineering & Integration: Map, transform, and verify client data feeds (CSVs, spreadsheets, APIs) into templated report layouts while maintaining strict data integrity.
  • Client Onboarding & Support: Lead tenant setup, user role delegation, and brand asset configuration (logos, colors, fonts) to drive rapid platform adoption.
  • Front-End & Template QA: Use light HTML/CSS to style and QA report covers, tables, charts, DISCLAIMERS, and embedded QR components.
  • Customer Success & Enablement: Create self-serve tutorials, GIFs, and checklists; partner with Product and Support to resolve technical activation issues.
  • Track Adoption Metrics: Monitor time-to-first-value and user retention metrics (week-1 and week-4 active users).

What You Bring

  • Experience: 2–4 years in Data Engineering, Implementation, Technical CS, or Fintech Ops.
  • Domain & Education: Master’s degree or progress toward a CFA charter is highly desirable. Strong understanding of investment performance metrics (m/m, YTD, 1Y p.a.) and benchmarks is required.
  • Technical & Design Skills: Google Sheets/Excel data hygiene (VLOOKUPs, formatting), foundational HTML/CSS, and basic familiarity with design tools (Figma, Canva, or Adobe).
  • Communication: Exceptional written English, keen visual taste, and a proactive client-service mindset.

Benefits

  • On-site position based in Canggu, Bali.
  • Dedicated learning stipend and equipment budget.

title: Destination Services & Community Coordinator
description:
Destination Services & Community Coordinator

A full-time role based at Borough Yards on 2-years fixed term contract to provide dedicated operational, administrative, and community support to both Destination Services Manager and the part-time Community Manager. The Destination Services & Community Coordinator plays a vital dual role in ensuring the smooth, safe, and efficient day-to-day running of the estate while actively supporting placemaking, tenant engagement, commercialisation, and event activation across Borough Yards ensuring continuity of support for community initiatives when the Community Manager is off-site. The role is expected to work 37.5 hours a week, Monday to Friday, with weekend work as required.

Job Description

The Destination Services & Community Coordinator plays a key operational and community support role at Borough Yards, ensuring the smooth, safe, and welcoming day-to-day running of the estate. Reporting primarily to the Destination Services Manager, the role assists with core service delivery, contractor management, site maintenance, administrative coordination, and Health & Safety compliance.

Simultaneously, the role provides dedicated operational support to the part-time Community Manager, assisting with tenant engagement, practical event setup and planning, commercialisation activations, and seasonal campaigns (such as the Borough Yards Christmas lights installation). The post holder ensures seamless continuity of community support and occupier liaison across the estate on days when the Community Manager is off-site.

Key Responsibilities

Facilities & Operational Support

  • Estate Operations: Assist the Destination Services Manager with daily site inspections, building maintenance monitoring, security protocol checks, and site safety compliance.
  • Contractor Management: Act as an on-site point of contact for external service providers (cleaning, maintenance, security, waste management, and specialist contractors). Oversee contractor access, RAMS, permits to work, and site inductions.
  • Health & Safety Compliance: Assist in maintaining Health & Safety documentation, incident logs, compliance records, and risk assessment tracking to ensure a safe environment for visitors, staff, and tenants.
  • Seasonal and Project Delivery: Support the operational setup and execution of estate projects, including seasonal installations (e.g., Borough Yards Christmas lights) and routine maintenance schedules.
  • Fire Warden and First Aid: Undertake Fire Warden and First Aid duties as required on site.

Community, Placemaking and Commercialisation Support

  • On-Site Community Continuity: Serve as the main on-site administrative liaison for community and commercialisation activities on days when the Community Manager is off-site.
  • App Administration and Communications: Provide administrative support for the Borough Yards app (covering both tenant-facing communications and public-facing content), including content updates, user onboarding, digital notices, and engagement tracking.
  • Event and Activation Coordination: Assist with the practical logistics, planning, risk assessments, setup, on-site supervision, and teardown for pop-ups, brand activations, seasonal campaigns, and tenant events.
  • Occupier Communications: Help compile and distribute regular occupier communications, tenant newsletters, operational notices, and event announcements.
  • Commercialisation and Data Tracking: Track and maintain administrative records for commercialisation income, pop-up schedules, brand activations, footfall data, and event performance metrics.
  • Tenant Forums & Meetings: Support the preparation, scheduling, and logistics for tenant forums, occupier meetings, and community updates.

Tenant Liaison & Retailer Support

  • Day-to-Day Engagement: Build strong working relationships with on-site occupiers, acting as a responsive point of contact for daily queries, delivery logistics, waste management, and operational issues.
  • Issue Escalation: Promptly log, track, and escalate tenant concerns, lease queries, or operational risks to the Destination Services Manager or Community Manager as appropriate.
  • Occupancy & Records Management: Maintain accurate tenant contact lists, emergency contact databases, occupier handbooks, and lease/unit records.

Financial & General Administration

  • Financial Processing: Raise purchase orders (POs), process invoices, log service charge expenses, and support financial year-end reconciliations.
  • Administrative Support: Maintain Centre Management documentation, manage digital files, draft routine correspondence, and order office supplies/stationery as required.
  • Regional Liaison: Collaborate with the wider Colliers Regional Facilities Management and Property Management teams when necessary.
  • Ad-Hoc Duties: Perform other related operational and administrative duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Destination Services Manager or Community Manager to meet operational requirements.

Skills Required

  • GCSEs or equivalent education
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, , with a professional and friendly customer-facing approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive, adaptable mindset suited to supporting two distinct operational functions (Operations/FM and Placemaking/Community).
  • Good organisational, multitasking, and time-management skills with high attention to detail
  • Good practical working knowledge of Health & Safety regulations and estate compliance standards.
  • Technical Proficiency in MS Office (including Outlook, Word, Excel), digital engagement/app platforms, and comfortable learning property/financial software systems

Experience

  • Previous experience in a similar support role would be beneficial

Why Join Colliers UK?

  • Accelerate your career – Colliers is committed to developing its people through structured career progression, learning opportunities, professional qualifications, and internal mobility.

  • Enterprising culture – Employees are empowered to think differently, take ownership, and make decisions that drive success. Innovation and entrepreneurship are central to the Colliers culture.

  • Collaborative environment – Teams work closely across service lines and geographies, creating opportunities to learn from industry experts and deliver exceptional outcomes for clients.

  • Global business, local impact – As part of a global organisation with thousands of professionals worldwide, employees benefit from international expertise while working on projects that shape local communities.

  • Strong focus on people and wellbeing – Colliers invests in its employees through competitive benefits, flexible working approaches, and a culture that supports individual success.

title: Landscape Internship
company: FOCAL POINTE OF ST LOUIS LLC
description:
2027 St Louis Summer Landscape Internship - Clayton

Love working outside and want to put your degree to work?

Looking for a career and a company you can grow with, not just a summer job?

Want to see what it takes to operate a large-scale commercial landscape company?

What if you could spend your summer experiencing it firsthand?

Focal Pointe's 2027 Summer Landscape Internship gives you the opportunity to explore the many sides of the professional landscape industry. You'll rotate through different areas of our business, work alongside experienced professionals, get hands-on experience, and see how everything from horticulture and irrigation to construction, design, client relationships, and business operations comes together.

This isn't an internship where you'll spend the summer doing the same thing every day.

It's an opportunity to see the industry from the ground up and start discovering where you could build a career.

Where Will You Spend Your Summer?

This internship is based in our Clayton market. You'll primarily work alongside Focal Pointe teams in this market while also having opportunities to connect with other Focal Pointe professionals and interns throughout the summer.

What Could Your Summer Look Like?

Our internship is designed to give you exposure to multiple career paths within the landscape industry. Depending on your location and rotation schedule, you may experience areas such as:

  • Estate Gardening and Detail Crews
  • Commercial Landscape Maintenance
  • Irrigation and Technical Services
  • Plant Health Care
  • Landscape Construction and Installation
  • Account Management
  • Landscape Design
  • Business Operations
  • A self-selected area based on your career interests

Throughout the summer, you'll have the opportunity to learn how these different areas work together to serve our clients and operate a large-scale commercial landscape company.

Toward the end of the program, you'll have the opportunity to spend additional time in an area that aligns with your interests and career goals.

Will You Actually Get to Do Things?

Yes.

This is a hands-on internship. You won't spend your summer standing on the sidelines.

Depending on your rotations, you may:

  • Work alongside landscape maintenance, gardening, and construction teams
  • Assist with landscape installation and field layout
  • Learn about annual and perennial plant care
  • Assist with irrigation installation, troubleshooting, startups, and repairs
  • Learn about Plant Health Care practices and equipment
  • Take site measurements and learn how they are used for estimating and bidding
  • See how landscape designs move from concept to installation
  • Shadow Account Managers and learn how they build and maintain client relationships
  • Work alongside Operations Managers and learn how teams, schedules, and projects are managed
  • Learn about the business operations that support a commercial landscape company

Some days will be physical. Some will challenge you to think differently. Some may introduce you to an area of the industry you've never experienced before.

That's exactly what the internship is designed to do.

title: Diabetessköterska
description:
Om VC Avestahälsan

Vårdcentral Avestahälsan har funnits sedan 2012 och har idag knappt 8000 listade patienter. Hos oss arbetar ca 35 medarbetare som distriktsläkare, ST-läkare, AT-läkare, BT-läkare, fysioterapeuter, arbetsterapeut, barnmorskor, BVC-sköterskor, distriktssköterskor med olika profilområden, rådgivningssköterskor, medicinska sekreterare, samtalsterapeuter, arbetsterapeut samt undersköterskor och eget lab.

Läs gärna mer om vilka vi är och vad vi gör på http://avestahalsan.se/vardcentralen/

Vi är en privatägd vårdcentral som har vårdvalsavtal med Region Dalarna så för den enskilde patienten gäller exakt samma förutsättningar, vårdgarantier och avgifter mm som på en offentligt driven vårdcentral. Vårdcentral Avestahälsan är fristående från stora vårdbolag och har verksamhet enbart i Avesta men med många listade patienter även från omgivande kommuner både i södra Dalarna och norra Västmanland.

Avestahälsans vision är att aktivt bidra till Sveriges bästa lokala sjukvårdssystem. Vi strävar mot att vara Sveriges mest attraktiva vårdarbetsplats som attraherar den bästa hälso- och sjukvårdspersonalen. Vi ska bedriva vård av absolut högsta kvalitet med trygga och trogna patienter.

Våra lokaler utökades och renoverades 2021 och är väl anpassade för verksamheten. Vi delar fastigheten med Företagshälsovård Avestahälsan.

Våra ledord är: Kompetens – Omtanke – Service – Tillgänglighet


DIABETESSKÖTERSKA

På Vårdcentral Avestahälsan är vi 6 distriktssköterskor, 2 barnmorskor samt ytterligare 4 sjuksköterskor. Flera är profilerade och vidareutbildade inom BVC, diabetes, KOL/Astma, demens, inkontinens, hjärta/kärl, psykisk hälsa samt rehabkoordinator. Därutöver har vi hjälp av några glada pensionärer som hoppar in då och då och hjälper till med främst vaccinationer. Telefonrådgivning är en stor och viktig arbetsuppgift för alla våra sköterskor, oavsett profilområde.

En av våra diabetessköterskor kommer att gå i pension mars 2027 så vi söker en till diabetessköterska att välkomna in i vårt härliga gäng! Vi söker en sjuksköterska på heltid där cirka halva tiden kommer vara som diabetessköterska. Vi arbetar teambaserat och sätter individuella behandlingsmål för patienterna.


Arbetsuppgifter

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat innefatta:

- Telefonrådgivning.

- Sedvanlig egen mottagning för våra typ-2-diabetespatienter.

- Uppföljning av dessa patienter och dosjustering av medicinsk behandling.

- Medicinjusteringar både inom delegation och i samråd med läkare.

- Hålla motiverande samtal om levnadsvanor.

- Hålla patientutbildningar för pre-diabetes-patienter.


Kvalifikationer

Krav

Legitimerad sjuksköterska

Diabetessköterskekompetens


Meriterande

Distriktssköterska

Erfarenhet av arbete inom primärvård och/eller arbete med sjukvårdsrådgivning.


Personliga egenskaper

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Du bör vara ansvarstagande och känna dig trygg i din yrkesroll samt ha god förmåga att samverka så väl internt som externt. Du har intresse för att delta i mottagningens utvecklingsarbete.


Är du diabetessköterska och nyfiken på hur det är att arbeta hos oss?

Tveka då inte att snarast maila oss ett personligt brev och CV till sokjobb@avestahalsan.se.

Kontakta gärna vår nuvarande diabetessköterska, Åse, för att höra mera om hur vi har det och vad arbetet hos oss innebär.


Intervjuer och tillsättning kommer att ske fortlöpande så skicka in din ansökan snarast möjligt.


Bifoga även kontaktuppgifter till minst två referenser varav en tidigare/nuvarande chef.

Avestahälsan tillämpar drogscreening i anställningsprocessen.

Varmt välkommen till oss på Avestahälsan!

title: Personlig assistent sökes till 5-årig flicka i Nybro
description:
För vår kunds räkning i Nybro, söker vi en erfaren personlig assistent som är lyhörd för vår kunds behov och önskemål. 
 
Brev från kund:
 Hej!
 
Jag heter Ilse:)

Jag är en glad, pigg och nyfiken tjej som bor i Nybro tillsammans med min mamma och våra tre katter.
Därför behöver du kunna tåla pälsdjur, mina katter är viktiga för mig och de hänger gärna efter mig hemma.

Jag söker nu en personlig assistent för timanställning som kan vara en trygg och rolig del av min vardag när någon av mina ordinarie assistenter behöver vara lediga, är sjuka osv. 
Du bör kunna hoppa in med kort varsel, arbeta dag, kväll och natt samt helger. 

Jag har svår epilepsi, autism och en sällsynt komplex tumörsjukdom, vilket gör att jag behöver mycket stöd, tillsyn och en person som kan ligga steget före och hjälpa mig att navigera vardagen på ett tryggt sätt både medicinskt och i övrigt. 

Jag pratar lite engelska, men för det mesta kommunicerar jag genom olika ljud, kroppsspråk och mina egna hittepåord. Jag har också en kommunikationsplatta som förhoppningsvis kanske kan hjälpa mig lite med tiden. 

Jag tycker om att:

- Vara ute och upptäcka saker
- Bada
- Bygga och leka med Lego
- Leka med Barbie
- Leka och hitta på saker tillsammans

Jag är samtidigt mycket känslig för intryck, så det är viktigt att du kan läsa av mig, förstå när det blir för mycket och hjälpa mig att skapa lugn och trygghet.
 

Vem är du?

Jag tror att du är en person som:

Har mycket tålamod och är trygg i dig själv
Är pedagogisk och kan anpassa dig efter mina behov
Är uppmärksam och kan se faror innan de uppstår.
Gillar att vara aktiv och hitta på saker
Är lekfull och kan möta mig där jag befinner mig
Är lyhörd och kan läsa av både mina signaler och mitt mående
Förstår att små framsteg kan vara stora framsteg.
 

Det viktigaste för mig är inte att du har lång erfarenhet av just mina diagnoser. Det viktigaste är att du är trygg, engagerad, nyfiken och vill lära känna just mig.
Personkemin är viktigare än erfarenhet men jag ser det som viktigt att du utgår från att du vill jobba med mig länge och inte kortvarigt då jag behöver stabilitet och långvariga relationer. 

Det kan vara bra för dig att veta att jag är känslig för infektioner och det kan dessvärre bli en del karensdagar då man behöver vara hemma vid minsta symtom. Men detta berättar vi mer om när vi ses:)
 

Krav:
Rökfri
Har körkort
Kan uppvisa ett utdrag från belastningsregistret

Som min assistent blir du en viktig person i min vardag, du är någon som hjälper mig att vara trygg, delaktig och få göra sådant som jag tycker om.
Tror du att du passar in i mitt team så hör av dig! 
 


Om företaget

Monument Assistans är alternativet för personer med personlig assistans som söker skräddarsydda lösningar. Vi har hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet av personlig assistans. För att vi ska kunna hjälpa våra kunder på allra bästa sätt så arbetar vi med hög tillgänglighet och ett nära och personligt samarbete.

Vi vet att vår personal är nyckeln till att bedriva en bra personlig assistans. Därför är det centralt för oss att du som medarbetare är både känner stolthet och glädje över att arbeta hos oss. Vi på Monument Assistans vill därför ge dig möjligheten att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vi uppskattar nyfikna och engagerade medarbetare.

Vi erbjuder dig goda lönevillkor, ett nära ledarskap och friskvårdsersättning. Vi ger dig en arbetsmiljö där det är högt i tak och där du har goda möjligheter att påverka din egen arbetssituation. Vi tar gärna fram individuella fortbildningslösningar beroende på i vilken typ av uppdrag du arbetar i. Hos oss får du möjligheten att växa!

Vi ser gärna att du som studerar och söker denna tjänst är inskriven på längre studier och att du minst har ett år kvar av dina studier.

Om oss

aleja ab är ett bemanningsföretag verksamt främst i Stockholm.

Vi bemannar inom en mängd olika branscher – bland annat inom transport och lager, bygg och rivning, sanering och renhållning samt andra tunga arbeten utan krav på större förkunskaper eller utbildning.

Vad vi kan erbjuda dig

Att arbeta hos oss innebär att du erbjuds möjligheter att dels kunna arbeta fast hos en och samma kund över en längre period, alternativt att på en kort tid få en bredare arbetslivserfarenhet genom många olika korta, intensiva uppdrag.

Vad vi söker hos dig

Vi letar efter hungriga, nyfikna och snabblärda killar och tjejer med en vilja för att jobba och leverera resultat.

Fullgjord värnpliktsutbildning är starkt meriterande eftersom arbetet är fysiskt och psykiskt krävande.

Arbetet mäts individuellt, och du skall drivas av att vilja plocka mer och tävla mot både dig själv och internt i gruppen. Du som söker ser arbetets upplägg som en rolig utmaning snarare än ett stressande moment.

Vi söker dig som är morgonpigg, flexibel och inte rädd för att prova nya saker eller möta nya människor. Hos oss finns det även möjlighet att prova på olika typer av arbeten, bl a inom lager, sanering, montering, grovarbete och rivning.

För att du skall kunna bli anställd som extra personal hos oss måste du vara studerande, och kunna visa upp ett giltigt studieintyg, alt försörja dig på annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, tex ett annat deltidsarbete.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Just nu har vi en kund som behöver hjälp med renoveringar av förskolor. I arbetet ingår bland annat rivning av väggar och golv samt grovstädning.

title: IT Security Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
IT Security Engineer (m/w/d)

As an IT Security Engineer, you will contribute to the protection and continuous improvement of Vusion's
IT environment, with a primary focus on Security Operations & Incident Response and Identity & Access
Management.


You will investigate security incidents and tickets escalated by the SOC, coordinate remediation with the
relevant technical teams, and contribute to strengthening identity and access controls across the
organization.


You will also act as the local security point of contact for the Austria site, working closely with local IT
and business teams while maintaining strong alignment with the headquarters cybersecurity team. This
will give you a key role in supporting local security needs, coordinating security topics, and ensuring that
corporate security standards are effectively applied on site.


We are looking for a versatile security engineer with strong technical foundations and a genuine interest
in Identity Security. The role will allow you to progressively develop deeper expertise in this area and
become a key technical point of contact for Identity & Access Management.

Key Responsibilities:

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Review and analyze security incidents and tickets escalated by the SOC using evidence from SIEM, EDR, identity, endpoint, network and cloud security solutions.
  • Perform technical investigations to determine the root cause, scope and potential impact of security incidents.
  • Investigate suspicious authentication activity, identity compromise, malicious endpoint behavior and network anomalies.
  • Coordinate containment, remediation and recovery actions with Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, Digital Workplace and Application teams.
  • Document investigations, remediation actions and lessons learned to ensure effective follow-up and knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of incident response procedures, SOC use cases and detection capabilities.


Identity & Access Management

  • Contribute to the security and continuous improvement of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory environments.
  • Support and improve identity lifecycle processes, including Joiner, Mover and Leaver activities.
  • Implement and maintain authentication and access controls such as Multi-Factor Authentication,
  • Conditional Access and passwordless authentication.
  • Support Privileged Identity Management (PIM), privileged access controls and the application of least privilege principles.
  • Participate in Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations and application onboarding using SAML, OAuth 2.0 and
  • OpenID Connect.
  • Contribute to access reviews, identity governance and the secure management of privileged and sensitive access.
  • Develop deeper expertise in Identity Security and progressively become a technical point of reference for this domain

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5 years of experience in IT Security, Identity & Access Management or Security Engineering.
  • Hands-on experience investigating security incidents using SIEM, EDR, identity, endpoint, network and infrastructure logs.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, with a strong interest in Identity & Access Management and Identity Security.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalling, VPNs, proxies and network segmentation.
  • Knowledge of Windows and Linux environments and their main security mechanisms.
  • Knowledge of authentication and federation technologies, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and Kerberos.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security technologies is highly value
  • Ability to troubleshoot security issues across identity, endpoint, system, network and cloud layers.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into secure technical solutions and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Certifications

The following certifications are appreciated but not mandatory:

  • Microsoft SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft SC-200 - Security Operations Analyst
  • Microsoft AZ-500 - Azure Security Engineer
  • CompTIA Security+

Skills

  • A curious and hands-on engineer who enjoys investigating security issues and understanding how technologies work.
  • A structured problem solver able to analyze complex incidents across identity, endpoint, system and network layers.
  • A proactive mindset with a strong interest in Identity Security and the motivation to progressively build deep expertise in this area.
  • Someone comfortable collaborating with SOC, Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, Digital Workplace and Application teams.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical security risks and recommendations to different stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (approx. 10–20%).
  • Autonomy, rigor, teamwork and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Fluent English skills, both written and spoken

We feel supported. You will too.

VusionGroup is a place where people feel safe, happy and respected. We offer programs and benefits to support you in whatever comes next in your life, including:

  • Pay: Competitive pay and shareholder equity

title: Commercial Portfolio Analyst- Energy
description:
We're all about impact. What you’ll do..

This isn’t a back-office reporting role where work disappears into a drawer. As a Commercial Analyst, you will have direct ownership of models that guide our energy metering strategy and ensure we deliver on our major commercial commitments.

Here is where you’ll make your mark:

  • Powering Smart Meter delivery: From day one, your flagship focus will be our Smart Demand planning. You will ingest and calibrate complex data streams—balancing customer demand against third-party installer capacity—to help UW stay on course to install thousands of smart meters this year.
  • Driving P&L optimisation: You will model and forecast our growing metering portfolio, building scenario and sensitivity frameworks that actively capture margin and protect against commercial risk.
  • Influencing major contract levers: You’ll evaluate commercial trade-offs across key supplier relationships, delivering the evidence base that senior leaders rely on to negotiate and make strategic calls.
  • Moving from data to direction: You’ll turn ad-hoc requests into strategic opportunities, providing regular, high-visibility insights that shape our energy team’s roadmap.

We get it done together. Your team and the people you will work with…

At Utility Warehouse, nobody works in a silo. We believe the best results come from high trust, open communication, and genuine collaboration.

  • Dedicated technical mentorship: You will report directly to a Senior Commercial Analyst, an exceptional data specialist who will coach you day-to-day, helping you take your modelling skills to the next level and teaching you advanced analytics tools like SQL and Python as you grow.
  • Strategic leadership & commercial vision: You’ll work alongside our Head of Commercial Contracts, and Commercial Managers who will guide your commercial instincts, contractual awareness, and executive stakeholder presence.
  • Executive visibility: You’ll have direct exposure to our Energy Director, regularly presenting data that underpins key commercial decisions for the entire energy division.
  • External partner collaboration: You’ll work closely with key external partners like our primary metering provider, fostering a collaborative, joint problem-solving relationship that balances commercial rigour with shared operational success.
  • How we work: We enjoy a flexible hybrid setup. Our formal baseline is two days per week in our vibrant Farringdon office, for collaborative days, meeting, workshops, and team lunches.

You will be a great fit if you:

  • Think like an owner: You don’t just deliver what’s on the ticket. When you spot an anomaly, a trend, or an inefficiency in a dataset, your first instinct is to investigate and propose a practical solution.
  • Are sharp with spreadsheets, sharper with context: You are confident wrangling messy, multi-layered data in Excel (from complex logic to sensitivity tables), but your real superpower is connecting that analysis to commercial P&L drivers and margins.
  • Have 2–3 years of commercial or analytical experience: You might have a STEM or numerical degree, or proven experience in business analytics, commercial finance, or supply chain. Prior energy sector experience is welcome, but by no means a dealbreaker.
  • Love to learn: You don’t need to be a finished SQL or Python developer today. What matters is that you have a proactive mindset, strong numerical intuition, and an appetite to expand your technical toolkit under dedicated mentorship.
  • Keep it simple: You can take a complicated operational scenario and translate it into a clear, compelling insight that anyone can understand and act on.

So why pick UW?

We’ve got big ambitions so there’s going to be plenty of challenges. There are also a lot of benefits:

  • An industry-benchmarked salary. We’ll share it during your first conversation.
  • Flexible hybrid working — 2 days a week in our London hub
  • Discounts on our services
  • Matched-contribution pension scheme and life assurance up to 4x salary.
  • Family-friendly policies designed to help you and your family thrive.
  • Discounted private health insurance, Employee Assistance line and free Virtual GP.
  • Belonging groups helping shape an inclusive future.
  • A commitment to learning and progression through our Career Framework

Apply here!

You’ve got this far… Hit apply — we can’t wait to hear from you!

Worried you don’t hit every criterion? We welcome applications from diverse backgrounds — get your application in and let’s chat!

Claire Fennell will be your point of contact throughout the recruitment process.

Not sure you meet all the requirements? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs if they think they may not meet every qualification, when in fact they often do.

We provide equal opportunities, a diverse and inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone. You are welcome to apply no matter your age, disability, gender, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity status, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. Please don’t be afraid to ask about what we can do to support your needs. All requests will be carefully and fairly considered.

Please note, if you are successful and offered a role at UW, you will be subject to a background check. Where checks are unsatisfactory or incomplete and/or a failure to reveal information relating to convictions that you are required to identify as part of the background checks, could lead to withdrawal of an offer of employment.

title: Personlig assistent i Oxie: Timanställning/behovsanställning
description:
Jobba med omtanke - Personlig assistent sökes till aktiv och sportintresserad man i Oxie

Vill du ha ett varierande arbete där du får vara en viktig del av en annan människas vardag? Vi söker nu en flexibel personlig assistent som vill hoppa in vid behov hos en man i Oxie – både vid planerad och akut frånvaro i det ordinarie assistansteamet.

Vår kund är en aktiv person med stort intresse för sport, träning och tävling. Fotboll ligger honom varmt om hjärtat och det blir gärna en tur till en fotbollsmatch. När det är dags för en lugnare stund uppskattas bland annat kortspel. Till aktiviteter och matcher tar sig kunden och assistenten tillsammans med färdtjänst.

Kunden har behov av personlig assistans efter en stroke. Han använder rullstol men kan gå med trepunktsstöd i hemmet. Han har även epilepsi, som ibland visar sig genom tysta anfall. Det är därför viktigt att du är uppmärksam, närvarande och trygg i att observera kundens mående och behov.

Arbetet kan vara både roligt, socialt och utvecklande, men det kan också uppstå situationer som kräver tålamod, lyhördhet och ett professionellt förhållningssätt på grund av kundens hjärnskada. För att skapa en trygg och fungerande vardag är det väldigt viktigt att du utför alla arbetsuppgifter enligt rutiner och samtidigt är lyhörd för kundens behov och önskemål.

Arbetstider

  • Schemat är förlagt med 12-timmarspass alla veckodagar enligt nedan:
    • 09:00-21:00
    • 21:00-09:00 med vaken natt

Din profil

För att du ska känna dig trygg i rollen ser vi att du gärna:

  • Har erfarenhet av arbete med personer som har epilepsi.
  • Har erfarenhet av arbete med personer som haft stroke.
  • Kan arbeta med ett lågaffektivt bemötande.
  • Kan följa rutiner och instruktioner noggrant.
  • Är lyhörd, uppmärksam och närvarande i din roll som personlig assistent.
  • Är flexibel och kan hoppa in med kort varsel.

Vill du bli en viktig del i någon annans vardag och arbeta i ett företag där omtanke står i fokus? Skicka då in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev.

För arbete som personlig assistent hos oss krävs utdrag från belastningsregistret enligt lagen om registerkontroll vid arbete i hemmet åt äldre personer eller vuxna personer med funktionsnedsättning.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande – skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Observera att vi inte har möjlighet att besvara alla frågor via telefon eller e-post på grund av sekretess. Mer information om tjänsten och kunden lämnas vid en eventuell anställningsintervju.

Vänligen notera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post eller telefon.

Företagsinformation

Vi på Omtanken i Skåne AB erbjuder personlig assistans med personlig service och ett genuint engagemang. Vår utgångspunkt är alltid att brukarens behov och önskemål ska stå i centrum – det är grunden i allt vi gör.

Vi utför personlig assistans med stor respekt för människovärde och personlig integritet. Hos oss möter du det lilla assistansbolaget med stort hjärta, hög tillgänglighet och en närhet som gör skillnad – både för våra brukare och våra medarbetare.

Vår värdegrund:

Vi vill att både brukare och medarbetare ska känna sig sedda, hörda och bekräftade för den de är. Det skapar trygghet, kontinuitet och en assistans av hög kvalitet.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer Azure
description:
We are looking for a talented Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team and take ownership of the infrastructure and delivery processes that support our production services. You’ll work closely with engineering teams to build, deploy, monitor, secure, and operate scalable cloud environments.

Project details

  • Start: ASAP
  • Duration: 12+ months
  • Focus: Azure, AKS, Terraform, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, security, observability, and cloud migration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes (AKS).
  • Manage production-grade AKS clusters, including private networking, node pools, autoscaling, workload identity, ingress, certificates, and cluster upgrades.
  • Own Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, workspaces, and multi-environment deployments.
  • Design and maintain advanced CI/CD pipelines for secure and efficient application delivery from development through production.
  • Implement monitoring and observability across Kubernetes, applications, and Azure services.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure, networking, identity, and production issues.
  • Apply cloud security best practices, including vulnerability scanning, threat modeling, and centralized secrets management.
  • Design and maintain multi-region high availability and disaster recovery solutions, including failover and failback procedures.
  • Collaborate closely with application engineering teams to establish and improve operational standards.
  • Support cloud migration initiatives, including workloads moving between Azure and Google Cloud.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a DevOps Engineering role with strong Azure expertise.

title: Skal du skrive masteroppgave våren 2027 og ønsker skriveplass i Deloitte Advokatfirma?
description:
Skal du skrive masteroppgave i rettsvitenskap våren 2027? Hvert semester tilbyr vi skriveplass til dyktige og engasjerte jusstudenter ved vårt kontor i Oslo.

Som student med skriveplass hos oss får du:

  • Faglig veiledning fra våre advokater relatert til oppgaven
  • Karriereveiledning
  • En egen fadder som sørger for at du blir godt integrert i arbeidsmiljøet
  • Et økonomisk stipend på 40.000 kroner
  • Plass i vårt kontorlandskap i Bjørvika
  • Mulighet til å delta på diverse faglige og sosiale Deloitte-arrangementer
  • Egen laptop og tilgang til bibliotek, kaffebar og kantine

"Med skriveplass hos Deloitte får du sitte i kontorlandskap med engasjerte og erfarne advokater, hvor det er lav terskel for å diskutere problemstillinger knyttet til masteroppgaven din. Du får verdifull faglig veiledning og blir inkludert i det gode sosiale miljøet i firmaet." – Skriveplasstudent 2025

Med åpenhet for nye ideer, en god dose pågangsmot og lysten til å lære nye ting, vil du være en viktig bidragsyter hos oss. Stipendet tildeles studenter som skriver masteroppgave knyttet til våre virksomhetsområder; skatt, avgift, transaksjoner, personvern, IT-rett og forretningsjus, herunder blant annet fast eiendom, arbeidsrett og selskapsrett.

Hvorfor velge Deloitte?

Vi har et stort og variert tilbud til ansatte innen ulike kulturarrangement, idrett og sosiale aktiviteter, og det vi er mest stolt av er fokuset vi har på folka våre. Her er noe av det våre kolleger sier de setter mest pris på som ansatt i Deloitte:

  • Folka – «Her er det ingen som kjemper om plassen – vi løfter hverandre frem og setter genuint pris på hverandre»
  • Medbestemmelse i egen utvikling – «Din people leader er der for å hjelpe deg å avdekke og bygge videre på det du er god på – og rollen din vokser i takt med deg»
  • Kontinuerlig utvikling – «Varierte oppgaver sikrer at du alltid lærer noe nytt – og det gjør du i trygge omgivelser, omgitt av kolleger som ønsker at du skal lykkes»
  • Samholdet i teamet – «Kollegene dine blir mer enn bare arbeidsplassen – mange av dem blir venner for livet»

Hvordan søke?

Vi ønsker at du laster opp et motivasjonsbrev der du i grove trekk redegjør for din planlagte oppgave. Motivasjonsbrevet lastes opp i vårt rekrutteringssystem sammen med CV og vitnemål. Vi vurderer alle søknader, og aktuelle kandidater vil bli innkalt til intervju.

Dersom du har noen spørsmål vedrørende skriveplassordningen, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med advokatfullmektig Guro Bakken Ravndal (guravndal@deloitte.no). For spørsmål vedrørende rekrutteringsprosessen kan du ta kontakt med Amalie Worm Andersen (amaandersen@deloitte.no)

title: Software Engineering Graduate Programme FY28
description:
Job Description

Software Engineering Graduate Programme FY28

Application Deadline: 25 October 2026

Department: Technology Ireland

Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time

Location: Dublin

Compensation: €35,000 / year

Description

Technology is changing the world faster than ever before – and at the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

Every day around the world, we work with exceptional people, the latest and greatest tech and leading companies across industries.

You’ll learn, grow and advance in a diverse culture of shared success, where we’ll empower you to bring your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work.

Join us and do extraordinary things.

On this programme, you can expect to be working directly with our clients to help deliver projects using some of the most advanced technologies on the market. You will help drive and deliver business transformation, develop industry-leading specialist skills, and help transform our clients around the world. This will include designing, building, testing and deploying strategic solutions for our clients.

As a key member of project teams, you’ll work side by side with our clients in a variety of roles, understanding the challenges and requirements, helping to formulate a plan of action and collaborating with local and global teams to deliver innovative solutions.

As an Analyst in Software Engineering, we are looking for people with an interest in getting hands-on with technology. But we don’t expect you to know it all. Depending on the nature of the project we will train you in technologies such as Java/J2EE, C#, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, React and Angular.js but as it is with Tech – this changes constantly and at Accenture, we stay current.

While you might be coming into Software Engineering, writing code won’t be the full day job and we know that you will want to gain other skills within Business and Consulting, so we’ll also train you in the best delivery practices such as DevOps, Cloud, Agile, Generative AI & Accenture Delivery Methods. You will also get the opportunity to gain industry certifications across various technologies and delivery methodologies.

What We're Looking For

On the Software Engineering Graduate Programme, we’re looking for a passion to grow and develop, a desire for self-improvement, a curious mind, and a strong work ethic. You will bring a creative and innovative mindset to your work and clients while ensuring the highest quality work delivered on time.

We’re also looking for you to demonstrate a passion for technology in either your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.

For Software Engineering, IT skills are essential. You will need a degree in IT, computer science, or a technology-related subject with a minimum 2:1 classification, obtained or predicted. However, if you have a real passion and flair for technology, as well as an understanding of how it can be used, we will consider a maths, science, or engineering degree. We expect you to have a real interest in software engineering and end-to-end design and delivery, and you’ll know a thing or two about programming.

What's In It For You?

Training & Development

We believe that your career is your adventure. All this training, experience and client exposure is focused on turning you into an expert in exploring how a client’s vision is achieved through using the latest technologies whilst developing and sustaining the skills our client's demand.

What you know is what we can sell to our clients. So, we’ll invest in your development from your first day. And realising you need to be up-to-speed as soon as possible, we’ll make sure you have all the training you need. As well as an award-winning induction programme and a supportive graduate community within the Technology Analyst Group, you can look forward to mentoring from some of our most successful leaders. The training you’ll receive will be broad and practical. It will combine sessions that focus on critical soft skills as well as the technical skills you’ll need to develop into a trusted and successful Tech Consultant.

You’ll join us in one of our Dublin offices on your first day and we will run an intense 5-week training programme with you, predominantly in person learning every day where possible, to give you our full attention and have you ready to rock as soon as possible.

All training will help you get the all-round skills for success, but it will be your experience that will really make the difference, which is why the variety of live project work we’ll give you will be so important.

We are also dedicated to your continued learning, which means it doesn’t stop after week 5. We will provide you with a training plan that will guide you through the full Analyst programme and turn you into the Technology Consultant you were made to be.

Rewards & Benefits

At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package. You can read up about some of these benefits here.

Where You’ll Work

Accenture is a people first business which thrives on collaboration, knowledge sharing and building strong connections.

As a dynamic and constantly evolving business, we love the flexibility of a hybrid working model. However, due to the nature of our work, you may be delivering projects on client sites anywhere in the Ireland and sometimes outside of Ireland. You will be expected to work on client site or in your assigned office for a minimum of 1-2 days a week (but up to 5 depending on business and client requirements).

There is an expectation for all graduates to be based within a commutable distance of your assigned office which will be Dublin.

Does this appeal to you? If so, we want to hear from you!

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as applicable by law. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. title: Landscape Internship
company: FOCAL POINTE OF ST LOUIS LLC
description:
2027 St Louis Summer Landscape Internship - Hazelwood

Love working outside and want to put your degree to work?

Looking for a career and a company you can grow with, not just a summer job?

Want to see what it takes to operate a large-scale commercial landscape company?

What if you could spend your summer experiencing it firsthand?

Focal Pointe's 2027 Summer Landscape Internship gives you the opportunity to explore the many sides of the professional landscape industry. You'll rotate through different areas of our business, work alongside experienced professionals, get hands-on experience, and see how everything from horticulture and irrigation to construction, design, client relationships, and business operations comes together.

This isn't an internship where you'll spend the summer doing the same thing every day.

It's an opportunity to see the industry from the ground up and start discovering where you could build a career.

Where Will You Spend Your Summer?

This internship is based in our Hazelwood market. You'll primarily work alongside Focal Pointe teams in this market while also having opportunities to connect with other Focal Pointe professionals and interns throughout the summer.

What Could Your Summer Look Like?

Our internship is designed to give you exposure to multiple career paths within the landscape industry. Depending on your location and rotation schedule, you may experience areas such as:

  • Estate Gardening and Detail Crews
  • Commercial Landscape Maintenance
  • Irrigation and Technical Services
  • Plant Health Care
  • Landscape Construction and Installation
  • Account Management
  • Landscape Design
  • Business Operations
  • A self-selected area based on your career interests

Throughout the summer, you'll have the opportunity to learn how these different areas work together to serve our clients and operate a large-scale commercial landscape company.

Toward the end of the program, you'll have the opportunity to spend additional time in an area that aligns with your interests and career goals.

Will You Actually Get to Do Things?

Yes.

This is a hands-on internship. You won't spend your summer standing on the sidelines.

Depending on your rotations, you may:

  • Work alongside landscape maintenance, gardening, and construction teams
  • Assist with landscape installation and field layout
  • Learn about annual and perennial plant care
  • Assist with irrigation installation, troubleshooting, startups, and repairs
  • Learn about Plant Health Care practices and equipment
  • Take site measurements and learn how they are used for estimating and bidding
  • See how landscape designs move from concept to installation
  • Shadow Account Managers and learn how they build and maintain client relationships
  • Work alongside Operations Managers and learn how teams, schedules, and projects are managed
  • Learn about the business operations that support a commercial landscape company

Some days will be physical. Some will challenge you to think differently. Some may introduce you to an area of the industry you've never experienced before.

That's exactly what the internship is designed to do.
