title: Refugee Resettlement | Education Liaison
description:
Catholic Charities is looking for the right people; people who wish to serve their community as a part of a family friendly organization doing good within the Houston-Galveston area. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees. People of all faiths helping people in need.

Refugee Resettlement assists in helping create a home-away-from-home, we assist government-approved refugees in becoming self-sufficient through cultural orientation, job development, family reunification and resettlement.

The Refugee Education Liaison is responsible for building and maintain partnerships with local school districts and community organizations as well as providing in-school and/or after school academic help to refugee students who have been identified by the school as having need. The Refugee Education Liaison will supplement the instruction students receive in class, help student’s complete homework, and guide students toward study practices that will encourage long-term success. The Refugee Education Liaison will also assist the Education Coordinator in delivering school orientations for newly arrived families, encouraging family engagement, performing outreach to local stakeholders, and other key components of the School Impact Grant. The successful candidate will have a passion for working with refugee students, engaging community partners, and show academic competence in core subject areas. This position requires extensive travel between multiple school districts, community centers, and homes within the service area.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES

  • Build relationships and establishing partnerships with local schools which serve high populations of refugee students. Establish sites for the expansion of in-school tutoring and after-school programs. Attend ongoing collaborative meetings with school personnel and educate staff and faculty on Catholic Charities services and other resources available to refugee students and families. Perform professional development trainings to educate teachers and school personnel on the topic of working with refugee students.
  • Create new relationships and nurture already established partnerships with community organizations which serve refugee populations. Schedule regular outreach meetings to member agencies of the Houston Refugee Consortium to ensure RSI services are extended to all eligible refugees. Attend Quarterly Consultation meetings and other meetings in the community to share information about the RSI program to stakeholders.
  • Create a welcoming, friendly learning environment for refugee students, create a curriculum that focuses on academic, cultural, and social-emotional engagement, prepare lessons and materials according to the curriculum, implement lesson plans at the after school/summer program. Collaborate with teachers to identify the areas where ESL intervention and other academic support are most needed for refugee students. Track student progress through pre-and post- testing, promotion rates, and report cards received from the school.
  • Work with refugee families to educate them about the American school system and encourage parent engagement in school by coordinating activities such as parent-teacher meetings and parent orientations.
  • Register students in after school program, create/update registration, and permission forms for the after-school program, set up and attend meetings with school administrators, monitor student progress, monitor attendance, write a weekly report detailing activities completed, maintain case files.
  • Travel frequently across the region to serve students at different locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Internship Programme 2027: Software Engineer (Python)
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

About The Internship Programme

Our Internship Programme is built for ambitious students who want to make their summer count. Over 8-10 paid weeks, you’ll work on real projects, solve meaningful challenges, and grow your skills alongside industry experts. It’s your chance to learn, innovate, and launch an exceptional career.

Top performers may be offered a place on our Graduate Programme the following year, giving you the opportunity to return and continue your journey at Revolut.

About The Role

Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We’re looking for Python Interns who want to write clean, scalable code, build data-driven systems, and gain hands‑on experience with distributed technologies.

Our stack includes Python 3, SQL, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Airflow, Kubernetes, Docker, GCP, and a TDD approach.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Join us from anywhere

The Internship Programme is open to international applicants ready to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, the UAE, or the UK. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).

Key dates

  • Applications: open from May 2026
  • Recruitment process: July–December 2026
  • Programme start: June / July 2027

Roles are filled on a rolling basis — apply early.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Helping build well‑designed, scalable APIs
  • Supporting the creation of data pipelines for reporting, analytics, and data science
  • Working in cross‑functional squads to design new data models and flows
  • Expanding your knowledge of Python and SQL through real‑world projects
  • Collaborating with engineers experienced in distributed systems
  • Sharing progress with global teams and learning from senior engineers
  • Managing tasks, tracking progress, and presenting outcomes
  • Receiving regular feedback to support your development

What You’ll Need

  • To be in your penultimate year of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, maths, physics, or a similar field (graduating in 2028)
  • A portfolio of coding projects or open‑source contributions
  • A problem‑solving mindset
  • A proactive, curious, and results‑driven approach
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills
  • To be comfortable working in a fast‑paced, diverse team environment
  • Full‑time availability for summer 2027
  • The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

title: Website Content Migration Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced, highly organised, Website Content Migration Specialist for a 3-month contract period to support the migration of website content to a new digital platform. Based in our North Ryde Support office this role will be instrumental in delivering our website migration project.

This hands-on role is responsible for reviewing, remediating and migrating website content in Directus using approved CMS components, agreed templates, technical specifications, brand standards, accessibility requirements and SEO best practice.

Working closely with the website project team and key business stakeholders, the role will help ensure content is migrated accurately, consistently and on schedule, while supporting quality assurance and launch readiness.

What You’ll Lead

  • Content Preparation and migration- Migrate, review and remediate approved website content in Directus using agreed templates, approved CMS components and page specifications. Review migrated pages against current Greencross Vets approved designs and correct missing, incomplete, duplicated, obsolete or incorrectly migrated content.
  • Directus component usage. Use and validate approved Directus components, including banners, WYSIWYG content, HTML code blocks, FAQs, FAQ tabs, membership plans, comparison tables, carousels, Instagram feeds, Vimeo videos, Typeform embeds, general content blocks, and shared or nested content components.
  • Image and asset management, Source, organise and prepare approved images and supporting assets for migration.
  • Content development and brand consistency. Develop, edit and refine website content in line with brand, tone of voice, content guidelines and page objectives.
  • SEO and discoverability. Work with the SEO digital partner specialist and agency to understand and action agreed SEO migration recommendations.
  • Quality assurance and launch readiness- Proofread and review migrated pages for accuracy, consistency, formatting, links, images, metadata and accessibility requirements.
  • Project coordination and stakeholder management. Coordinate with the project manager, developers, designers, SEO specialists, agencies and content owners to keep migration work moving.
  • Design and deliver employment relations education, compliance programs and leader capability initiatives across frontline, operational and executive leadership populations.
  • Partner on organisational change, workforce transformation, restructures, acquisitions and major business initiatives to ensure compliant and values-aligned outcomes.

About You

You are an experienced Content Migration Specialist with a growth mindset, who is flexible, approachable and adaptable to adjust to project deliverables.

You will bring:

  • Previous experience in website content management, digital content production or website migration.
  • Experience using a content management system, with Directus or component-based CMS experience highly regarded.
  • Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills. Confidence working with spreadsheets, content trackers and project management tools.
  • Working knowledge of SEO best practice for website content.
  • Experience preparing and optimising images for digital channels.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of content and repetitive tasks while maintaining quality.

What do we need?

  • Collaborative and easy to work with.
  • Flexible when project requirements or priorities change.
  • Committed to delivering a consistent and high-quality client experience.

Why Join Greencross?

  • Participate in a critical project function with meaningful influence across a diverse team
  • Make your impact in a meaningful contract role
  • Work with an experienced team in a purpose-led business focused on pets, people and wellbeing.
  • Join a growing organisation with career pathways across the broader Greencross and Petbarn network.

If you’re looking to be part of a fast-paced team that moves at pace and want to make an impact in a values led organisation, then email your resume to belinda.krezo@gxltd.com.au

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Frontend Developer — TypeScript / React About the Role

We are looking for a Frontend Developer to join our team and help build secure, scalable healthcare applications.

You’ll work primarily with TypeScript, React, and Next.js, building intuitive and reliable user experiences for applications where security, privacy, and data integrity are critical.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on complex frontend applications and cares deeply about code quality, usability, and maintainability.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
  • Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable frontend components.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to translate requirements into high-quality user experiences.
  • Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and third-party services.
  • Implement authentication and authorization flows using AWS Cognito, including MFA and OIDC/SAML-based identity federation.
  • Build interfaces with role-based access control (RBAC) and granular, per-case permissions.
  • Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare data and contribute to maintaining HIPAA/PHI compliance requirements.
  • Implement and maintain audit-related functionality across the application.
  • Write and maintain automated tests using Playwright, Vitest, and React Testing Library.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and frontend architecture decisions.
  • Help improve frontend performance, reliability, accessibility, and overall user experience.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong professional experience with TypeScript.
  • Solid experience building production applications with React.
  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture and best practices.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.
  • Experience writing automated tests, ideally with Playwright, Vitest, and/or React Testing Library.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts such as MFA, OAuth/OIDC, SAML, and RBAC.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS Cognito.
  • Experience building applications that handle sensitive or regulated data.
  • Previous experience working in healthcare or other highly regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and PHI requirements.
  • Experience with granular permissions and audit trails.
  • Experience integrating with third-party platforms such as Salesforce.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js
  • Authentication: AWS Cognito, MFA, OIDC, SAML
  • Integrations: REST APIs, Salesforce
  • Testing: Playwright, Vitest, React Testing Library
  • Security & Compliance: HIPAA, PHI, RBAC, Audit Trails

Why Join Us?

You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful healthcare technology, solving challenging frontend problems where security, privacy, usability, and reliability are equally important.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Build What Matters at RevStar

  • Role Title: Data & AI Engineer (Databricks Specialist)
  • Reports To: Data & AI Practice Lead
  • Location: Remote (US-Based / Eastern or Central Time Zone Preferred)
  • Employment Type: Contract

Ready to build greenfield Lakehouse solutions at the bleeding edge of AI and big data? RevStar is an innovation shop and official Databricks Partner launching a dedicated, cloud-agnostic Data, ML, and AI practice. Tired of spending months in endless corporate approval loops only to build AI concepts that never reach production? We turn modern Lakehouse architectures and production AI into live, scalable enterprise solutions in fast-paced execution cycles. We build fast, cut bureaucratic red tape, and ship production-ready solutions for client founders and tech leaders who value real engineering impact. In this role, you will work directly with data architects, scientists, and client leaders to turn complex data into scalable, production-ready AI models. Above all, our team operates on three core principles:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.
  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

Your Impact Pillars

1. Databricks Lakehouse & Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark and Delta Lake across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). Implement robust Lakehouse architectures that seamlessly process both structured and unstructured data at enterprise scale. Automate data ingestion, storage, and feature engineering workflows to support downstream analytics and real-time AI workloads.

2. Performance Tuning & MLOps Integration: Fine-tune Spark jobs for low latency, high throughput, and maximum cloud cost-efficiency across client environments. Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to operationalize AI models inside Databricks using MLflow for tracking, versioning, and deployment. Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Databricks CLI) to establish automated, production-grade deployments.

3. Data Governance & Client Leadership: Enforce enterprise data security, access controls, and compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2) within Unity Catalog and cloud ecosystems. Collaborate directly with client tech leaders, product managers, and engineering teams to translate complex AI data requirements into clear business outcomes. Author clean technical documentation and lead seamless solution handoffs to client engineering teams upon project completion.

What You Bring

  • Core Experience: 3+ years in cloud-native data engineering with 2+ years of dedicated, hands-on Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow experience.
  • Technical Mastery: High proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark frameworks, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or Databricks CLI).
  • Strong Differentiator: Active Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Associate or Professional) or Databricks ML Professional certification is strongly preferred and will set your application apart.
  • Consulting Mindset: Proven track record operating in fast-paced Agile/DevOps consulting environments, delivering cloud-agnostic architectures with exceptional client communication.
  • Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive.
  • Remote-First Working Environment - Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage - Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan - Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.
  • Annual Learning & Development Stipend - Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
  • Peer Mentorship & Coaching - Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities - Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
  • Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities - Build relationships and give back to the community.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture - Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

Equal Opportunity Employment

At RevStar, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our customers, and our community. RevStar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Reasonable Accommodations

RevStar is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact HR at hr@revstarconsulting.com.

title: Cloud (Technology) Engineer for FCI (m/f/d)
description:

title: IDD Intake Assistant
description:
Position Summary
The IDD Intake Assistant serves as the initial point of contact for individuals, families, providers, and community partners seeking IDD services through Pecan Valley Centers. This position is responsible for coordinating intake and referral activities, maintaining accurate documentation and tracking systems, supporting eligibility and assessment processes, providing customer service and community resource information, and ensuring timely communication and follow-up throughout the intake process. The IDD Intake Assistant works closely with Service Coordinators, Eligibility Specialists, providers, and other stakeholders to facilitate access to services and support compliance with program requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Intake and Referral Management

  • Receive, review, and process referrals for IDD services.
  • Community First Choice (CFC) referrals through LIDDA Connect.
  • Diagnostic and Determination (DID) referrals.
  • Requests for medical records and follow-up utilizing established review checklists.
  • Referrals to Eligibility Specialists.
  • Referrals and requests for Service Coordinators.
  • Conduct initial screening activities, including phone calls and IRAC Discovery processes.
  • Gather demographic and preliminary intake information from individuals and families.
  • Provide information regarding available programs, services, and eligibility requirements.
  • Schedule intake appointments, assessments, and related evaluations.
  • Complete reminder calls for all scheduled intake appointments.

Documentation and Records Management

  • Collect, review, organize, and maintain required intake documentation.
  • Enter and update client information in electronic health record (EHR) and case management systems.
  • Maintain accurate intake records and supporting documentation.
  • Capture and update intake data daily on designated tracking spreadsheets maintained in Microsoft Teams.

Client and Family Support

  • Respond to inquiries regarding IDD services, waiting lists, intake procedures, and eligibility processes.
  • Provide information regarding community resources and referral options.
  • Assist individuals and families in navigating service access and required documentation.

Coordination and Communication

  • Coordinate appointments and intake activities with intake staff, Eligibility Specialists, Service Coordination Supervisors, and Service Coordinators.
  • Communicate with schools, medical providers, community agencies, and external partners as needed.
  • Track intake progress and conduct follow-up regarding missing or incomplete documentation.
  • Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders to support efficient service delivery.

Eligibility and Assessment Support

  • Assist in gathering records and supporting documentation required for eligibility determinations.
  • Support future financial assessment functions as assigned.
  • Monitor timelines and tracking systems for assessments, evaluations, and eligibility-related activities.
  • Prepare intake packets and documentation for review by IDD professionals and program staff.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Answer and respond to calls received through the IDD Intake Line.
  • Maintain intake logs, reports, spreadsheets, and other tracking systems.
  • Perform general clerical and administrative duties as assigned.
  • Distribute Intermediate Care Facility (ICF) packages, including DID and ICAP booklets and score sheets, to community providers.
  • Conduct Permanency Planning interviews and submit completed information to the Program Manager for review and entry.
  • Maintain and update the Permanency Planning tracking spreadsheet.
  • Maintain access and utilize required systems and databases, including:
    • Medicaid and Social Security Community-Based Organization (CBO) Portal
    • CARE System
    • Texas Medicaid & Healthcare Partnership (TMHP)
    • LIDDA Connect
    • Client Assignment and Registration System (CSIL) or other designated databases

Other Duties

This position may perform other duties as assigned to support the mission, goals, and operational needs of Pecan Valley Centers. Responsibilities may be modified as program requirements and organizational needs evolve.

title: Engineering Consultant
description:

You will also have the opportunity to be immersed in digital transformation initiatives, advanced manufacturing technologies, and Pharma 4.0™ applications. title: Refugee Resettlement | Case Aide
description:
Catholic Charities is looking for the right people; people who wish to serve their community as a part of a family friendly organization doing good within the Houston-Galveston area. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees. People of all faiths helping people in need.

Refugee Resettlement assists in helping create a home-away-from-home, we assist government-approved refugees in becoming self-sufficient through cultural orientation, job development, family reunification and resettlement.

The Case Aide will be supporting the activities and objectives of the Refugee Resettlement program. Working closely with Case Managers and other program staff, the Case Aide assists in ensuring the successful integration and self-sufficiency of refugees within the local community. This position involves a combination of administrative tasks, client support, and cultural sensitivity. The Case Aide is required to maintain a flexible, organized, and efficient work schedule and support the delivery of quality services to clients.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES

  • Assist clients with basic needs such as transportation, orientation, and accessing community resources. Serve as a liaison between clients and Case Managers, conveying important information and addressing client concerns. Provide translation and interpretation services as needed to facilitate communication between clients and program staff or external service providers. Offer emotional support and encouragement to refugees as they navigate the challenges of resettlement.
  • Assist to Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, including case notes, progress reports, and required documentation for program compliance. Ensure that clients are properly enrolled in both the program’s internal and funder-provided database. Ensures that case files are opened and all documentation in the case file is accurate and completed in a timely manner.
  • Assist in preparing and submitting reports to funding agencies or other stakeholders. Help clients on completing necessary forms and applications related to housing, employment, healthcare, and benefits.
  • Participate in the development and delivery of cultural orientation sessions for clients, promoting understanding of local customs, laws, and resources. Foster a welcoming and inclusive environment for clients by demonstrating cultural sensitivity and respect for diversity.
  • Coordinate logistics for client appointments, workshops, and events. Assist in coordinating transportation for clients to attend appointments, language classes, job interviews, and other essential activities. Provide orientations to clients on-site at locations such as banks, credit unions, apartments, and grocery stores to teach them how to carry out day-to-day functions such as depositing checks, withdrawing cash, opening accounts, using benefits cards, paying rent, paying utility bills, etc.
  • Support Case Managers with administrative tasks such as scheduling, filing, and maintaining program materials. Perform other duties, as assigned by supervisor.

title: Senior Data Engineer AWS
description:
About Us

Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. We combine strong technical expertise with a product mindset to lead complex software initiatives end-to-end. We work with international clients, value autonomy and clear communication, and build long-term partnerships through technical excellence.

More information: http://coderio.com

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable, high-performance data platforms supporting large volumes of financial and transactional data. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in Python, SQL, Apache Spark, AWS, and modern data engineering architectures, with proven experience working with production-grade systems in fast-paced environments.

Candidates must reside exclusively in Argentina, Brazil, or Uruguay.

What You Can Expect (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, and maintain high-throughput, low-latency batch and streaming data pipelines to ingest and process financial transactions from diverse global sources.

  • Design, scale, and optimize cloud data warehouse and lakehouse architectures capable of handling massive volumes of structured and unstructured data.

  • Collaborate with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to understand business needs and translate them into scalable, reliable data solutions.

  • Implement and enforce data quality frameworks, automated testing, monitoring, and alerting to ensure data integrity, reliability, high availability, and compliance with SLAs.

  • Drive the adoption of DataOps practices, including CI/CD, workflow automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for data systems.

  • Champion data governance, privacy, and security standards across data storage and compute layers, including GDPR/LGPD compliance.

  • Mentor and guide junior and mid-level Data Engineers, promoting engineering excellence, best practices, and modern architectural patterns.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Big Data, or related Software Engineering roles, with a proven track record managing high-volume, production-grade data systems in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for complex data processing, optimization, and software development; Scala or Java experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake, and modern lakehouse architectures, including Data Mesh principles.

  • Strong expertise in AWS data services, particularly S3, Glue, Athena, EventBridge, Firehose, and Lambda.

  • Solid experience with data orchestration and warehousing technologies, including Apache Airflow or similar DAG-based tools and platforms such as Snowflake, AWS Redshift, or Google BigQuery.

  • Experience designing real-time streaming architectures using technologies such as Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis, as well as familiarity with modern data transformation and modeling tools such as dbt.

  • Strong knowledge of DevOps/DataOps practices, including Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar), Infrastructure as Code, and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

  • Advanced English proficiency is required, with the ability to communicate effectively in English in both technical and non-technical contexts.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in Fintech, Payments, E-commerce, or other high-growth technology environments, particularly working with financial transactions or highly regulated data.

  • Experience with Databricks and advanced cloud lakehouse architectures.

  • Knowledge of data privacy, governance, and security frameworks, including GDPR/LGPD, as well as experience implementing secure data platforms.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, advanced DataOps automation, and mentoring Data Engineers or contributing to technical architecture decisions.

Benefits

  • 100% remote
  • Long-term commitment, with autonomy and meaningful impact
  • Strategic, high-visibility role within a modern engineering culture
  • Collaborative international team with strong technical leadership
  • Career development and growth opportunities within Coderio

Why join Coderio?

At Coderio, we value talent and excellence. While we are primarily a remote-first company, this specific strategic role offers the opportunity to work directly on-site to drive high-stakes initiatives. We are passionate about technology, collaboration, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive and challenging environment with real growth opportunities. If you are motivated to design solutions that make a difference, we are waiting for you.

title: Senior Speech Pathologist
description:
When you join Early Start Australia, you’ll be part of an allied heath team that’s in it together. A local team that’s right beside you, supported by leaders who know the work. From small shifts to life-changing breakthroughs, you’ll make a positive impact for children, young people, and their families across Australia. With flexibility and support to thrive, you’ll continue to grow and build a meaningful career, your way.

What you’ll do at our Launceston clinic:

Therapy Service Delivery
• Identify and complete assessments appropriate for each client
• Manage a discipline-specific caseload, including complex clients, using a case management approach
• Contribute to the selection and maintenance of assessment and therapy resources
• Develop, implement, evaluate, and adjust tailored therapy programs aligned to client goals
• Deliver services across clinic, home, school, and community settings as required
• Collaborate with allied health team members to achieve optimal client outcomes
• Develop and deliver specialised programs such as group therapy and parent workshops
• Maintain strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality requirements
• Ensure practice remains aligned with current best practice and contribute to continuous service improvement

Therapy Programs
• Develop and implement tailored therapy programs for each client, including:

  • Completing initial appointments
  • Developing goal plans based on identified support needs
  • Creating measurable, targeted intervention strategies
  • Collaborating with other health professionals where required (e.g. Speech, Psychology)
  • Preparing home and session-based resources and activities
  • Developing session plans as needed
  • Conducting school and home visits when appropriate
  • Monitoring progress and adjusting goals and programs accordingly
  • Completing reviews and reports as required
  • Identifying suitability for additional services or group programs and incorporating into plans where appropriate

Reporting and Documentation
• Record all treatment notes and activities in PMS within 24 hours of sessions
• Provide timely, high-quality reports to stakeholders (e.g. clients, families, health professionals, NDIA)
• Ensure reports and correspondence meet ESA standards
• Report and document client incidents or complaints in the appropriate systems

Funding and Payments
• Align therapy plans with available funding and funding types
• Obtain and review NDIS plans where relevant to inform therapy planning
• Provide accurate information to support correct invoicing of client-related services

Professional Development
• Participate in team meetings, peer reviews, and case discussions at an appropriate cadence
• Maintain accurate records in line with organisational processes and manager direction
• Utilise professional development opportunities to build role-relevant skills

Organisational Requirements
• Comply with and promote policies relating to WHS, emergency procedures, child safety, and cultural competence
• Participate in risk identification, assessment, and prevention activities
• Engage in networking and maintain collaborative relationships with professionals and agencies
• Maintain discipline-specific registration/membership and adhere to relevant codes of conduct
• Uphold privacy and confidentiality in line with organisational policy and legislation

What you’ll bring:

Experience/ Skills:

• Demonstrated experience delivering high quality evidence-based and goal-focused therapeutic intervention in an early intervention and/ or paediatric allied health setting

• Understanding and supporting the principles of individualised services including the ability to adapt services to meet individual needs

• Demonstrated ability to engage with a range of children and families and external stakeholders

• Demonstrated senior clinical knowledge with significant experience in relevant discipline

• Demonstrated experience mentoring, supervising and/or supporting others of the same discipline (including supervision of graduates and/ or allied health students)

• Strong communication, interpersonal, organisational and time management skills

• Exceptional observational and report writing skills

• Ability to work independently within and collaborate across a multidisciplinary team

People

• Support development of early career clinicians by engaging in clinical supervision and providing CPD opportunities

• Participate in reward and recognition program

• Participation in meetings

Qualifications / Compliance:

  • Relevant qualification in Speech Pathology
  • Registration with AHPRA and Registration with SPA
  • NDIS Workers Screening Check
  • Current Drivers’ Licence and vehicle
  • Current Working with Children Check or Working with Vulnerable People Registration (state specific)
  • National Police Check
  • Accredited First Aid Certificate

What you’ll get:

Flexibility and Wellbeing

  • Flexible hours and compressed work options
  • Up to 12 weeks annual leave.
  • Up to 16 weeks paid primary carer leave
  • Wellbeing support program for you and your family

Reward and support

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Registration and professional membership contribution
  • Relocation reimbursement up to $10,000, if applicable
  • Dedicated admin support so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Work in an environment that focuses on multidisciplinary collaboration, improving outcomes together

Growth, your way

  • CPD allowance + paid professional development leave
  • Structured mentoring and leadership programs
  • Ongoing opportunities to build your experience, including Fly In Fly Out (FIFO) work supporting children in remote areas
  • National and global career pathways through the APM Group

Who we are:

We’re a dedicated and passionate team of allied health professionals helping children and young people aged 0-16 to reach their full potential. Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with families to deliver personalised, evidence-based support across communication, motor, cognitive and social development. We are a registered NDIS provider and our clinics offer therapy under different funding models. As part of the APM Group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

Apply today or reach out to Ayesha on 0461 101 104 or Ayesha.din@apm.net.au for a confidential chat to learn more.

title: Personlig assistent Solna
description:
Personliga assistenter sökes till ung man i Solna

Jag är en ung man med ryggmärgsskada som nu söker två personliga assistenter till mitt team. Tjänsterna passar dig som vill arbeta på ett fast schema samt dig som vill hoppa in vid behov.

Som personlig assistent kommer du att vara ett stöd i min vardag och hjälpa till med de moment som jag själv inte kan utföra. Arbetet omfattar bland annat personlig omvårdnad, förflyttningar, hushållssysslor och att följa med på olika aktiviteter.

  • Har ett positivt förhållningssätt och god samarbetsförmåga
  • Kan arbeta självständigt och ta initiativ när det behövs
  • Talar och förstår svenska
  • Erfarenhet som personlig assistent är meriterande men inget krav


Jag bor i Solna och ser gärna att du också bor i närområdet, eftersom det underlättar vid inhopp med kort varsel.

Det viktigaste för mig är att vi trivs tillsammans och att du har ett genuint intresse av att arbeta med människor.

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka gärna en presentation av dig själv och berätta lite om vem du är, din bakgrund och varför du söker tjänsten.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

A-Assistans Leimir AB är ett privat företag som anordnar personlig assistans till assistansberättigade i hela landet. Vi har ca 600 personliga assistenter anställda. title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer - Team Lead
description:
Mitek (NASDAQ: MITK) is a global leader in digital & biometric identity authentication, fraud prevention, and mobile deposit solutions. Our verified identity platform and advanced image capture solutions are built on the latest advancements in biometric recognition, artificial intelligence, computer vision and machine learning, and trusted by over 7,500 organizations worldwide. We are headquartered in San Diego, California, with operations in the United Kingdom, Spain, France, Mexico, and the Netherlands. Visit us at www.miteksystems.com.

We are Virtual 1st! Whether you choose to work remotely from your home office or in-person from one of Mitek’s offices, our practices, processes and tools are designed to enable your success. At Mitek, the Future of Work is about flexibility and preference wherever and whenever we are working. Because we care about our candidates, employees and customers, we include an in-person meeting as part of our hiring process. It’s one of the ways we live our mission to “Protect What’s Real.”

At Mitek, we believe that teams are more resilient, effective, and innovative when they benefit from a wide range of ideas, lived experiences, and perspectives. The strength of our organization is deeply rooted in the people who power it.​ We know that a workforce reflecting the richness of our communities and customers helps us better serve their needs.


We are looking for a Full Stack Engineering Team Lead to provide day-to-day technical direction to a full stack engineering team while remaining close to the code.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can turn product priorities into practical technical plans, guide sound architecture decisions, and help engineers deliver reliable software with confidence.

You will work across front-end, back-end, cloud, and infrastructure components, balancing immediate delivery needs with the long-term quality, security, maintainability, and scalability of the platform.

What You’ll Do (Essential Responsibilities):

  • Lead the team’s day-to-day technical direction and support delivery against agreed priorities.
  • Contribute hands-on to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of production software.
  • Guide architecture and design decisions across front-end, back-end, cloud, and infrastructure components.
  • Break down complex initiatives into clear, actionable technical work and help the team estimate effort and dependencies.
  • Mentor engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and help colleagues strengthen their engineering capabilities.
  • Review code and reinforce engineering standards for quality, maintainability, scalability, security, observability, and testing.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, and dependencies early, communicate them clearly, and drive appropriate action.
  • Improve development practices, tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and the team’s ways of working.
  • Promote ownership throughout the application lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Build a collaborative culture grounded in accountability, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and Mitek’s values of Delivering, Learning, and Caring.

What You'll Need (Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

  • Significant professional software engineering experience, including experience leading technical work or mentoring other engineers.
  • Strong back-end development experience. Production experience with Go would be highly desirable.
  • Strong experience with JavaScript and single-page application frameworks, particularly React.
  • A track record of designing and delivering production-grade full stack applications.
  • A strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, distributed systems, and modern application development practices.
  • Experience building clean, maintainable, production-hardened code and writing unit, integration, and performance tests.
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services. Exposure to services such as S3, SQS, ECS, EC2, and Lambda would be particularly relevant.
  • Proficiency with Git, collaborative software development workflows, code reviews, and modern engineering practices.
  • The ability to translate business and product requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to guide the resolution of complex production issues.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English, with the ability to build alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

What Would be Nice (Preferred Skills & Experience):

  • TypeScript, Redux, HTML, CSS, and template engines such as Freemarker or Thymeleaf.
  • Experience with non-relational databases such as MongoDB, DocumentDB, or RavenDB.
  • Experience provisioning cloud infrastructure through code using CloudFormation, Terraform, or a comparable technology.
  • NPM or a comparable package manager and Cypress or similar front-end testing tools.
  • Experience designing distributed systems using serverless technologies or microservices architectures.
  • Bash scripting and familiarity with Java, Groovy, or Python.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and coordinating delivery across several technical or business stakeholders.
  • Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Team Lead, Lead Engineer, or in a similar player-coach role.

What Success Looks Like:

You will be successful in this role when:

  • The team consistently delivers reliable, high-quality software against clear priorities.
  • Architecture and technical decisions are pragmatic, documented, and understood by the people who need to act on them.
  • Risks, blockers, and dependencies are identified early and handled constructively.
  • Engineers receive the guidance, context, and support they need to work effectively and continue developing.
  • The platform becomes easier to maintain, operate, secure, and scale while the team continues delivering customer value.

LIFE AT MITEK

At Mitek, meaningful work and practical impact matter. Our culture is shaped by people who deliver for customers, keep learning, challenge convention, and care for one another.

We believe teams are stronger, more effective, and more innovative when they include different ideas, lived experiences, and perspectives. We therefore encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every preferred qualification listed above.

We sincerely appreciate your interest in Mitek. We know your time is valuable and look forward to learning more about what you could bring to our team.

AI IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

Mitek may use AI-enabled tools to support administrative or analytical parts of the recruitment process, always with human review. AI does not make our hiring decisions.

Candidates are welcome to use AI responsibly when preparing an application, but live interviews must reflect their own experience and thinking.

You can find more information at:


We take pride in enabling career growth in an environment of innovation and teamwork. Our commitment to all Mitekians is to do meaningful work that matters. Our culture is defined by delivering our best to our customers by providing high value solutions and impactful outcomes, by continuously challenging convention, and by caring for each other through collaboration and celebrating our successes. We are committed to creating competitive, equitable compensation & benefits programs and career development opportunities.

Requirements

  • Proven experience managing large-scale operational projects, specifically leading office relocations – must.

Hiring process with us

You are comfortable working with ambiguity and can turn high-level ideas into clear requirements, practical recommendations and well-supported decisions. You take pride in building trusted relationships, improving how work gets done and helping teams adopt changes that support APS’ corporate and divisional priorities.
A typical day for the Senior Business Analyst
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will provide senior-level business analysis, project leadership, project coordination and client relationship management for high-priority corporate and technology initiatives. Depending on the size and complexity of the work, you may lead smaller initiatives or support larger projects as part of a multidisciplinary project delivery team.You will work with business areas, project teams, technical partners and external stakeholders to understand needs, assess options, define requirements and support the design and delivery of effective business and system solutions.

  • Facilitate working sessions, interviews and discussions with stakeholders to clarify needs, document requirements and support decision-making.• Lead or support the planning and coordination of projects and initiatives, including scope definition, scheduling, resource analysis, risk management, testing, implementation and post-implementation review activities. • Develop project plans, statements of work, estimates, reporting materials and governance artifacts to support effective delivery of smaller projects and initiatives.• Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, facilitate decisions, and work with stakeholders to address challenges that may impact scope, schedule, budget or outcomes.• Conduct research, feasibility studies, business case analysis, impact assessments and risk analysis to support recommendations.• Identify operational impacts from new tools, systems or processes and develop change management, communication and training approaches to support adoption.• Build strong relationships and serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors and external stakeholders.• Lead business requirements gathering, process review and solution design activities, translating business needs into clear design specifications, process models, use cases, reports, testing plans, etc., which support the successful implementation of corporate and IT-enabled initiatives.• Provide guidance, coaching and business analysis expertise to colleagues, project teams and business partners.

What you bring
You bring a strong mix of business analysis expertise, project delivery experience, relationship-building skills and sound judgement. You are able to work independently, manage competing priorities and communicate complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • University degree with four years of directly related experience; or diploma with six to eight years of directly related experience; or certificate with nine years of directly related experience.• Senior-level experience in business analysis and project coordination, process design, business case development, project planning, stakeholder engagement, solution assessment, testing, and implementation.• Ability to build trusted relationships, influence without direct authority, consult with stakeholders and support agreement on recommended actions.• Experience supporting corporate or technology initiatives from initiation through implementation, including testing, change management and post-implementation review.• Strong analytical, problem-solving, research, statistical and financial analysis skills.• Excellent written, verbal, facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly across different audiences and levels of the organization.• Experience coordinating projects through a structured project lifecycle, including planning, scheduling, risk management, issue resolution, status reporting and benefits realization.• Ability to proactively identify project risks, dependencies and operational impacts and develop practical mitigation strategies.• Strong knowledge of project delivery methodologies, business analysis practices, risk management, governance frameworks and continuous improvement methods.• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools and project or portfolio management software; experience with Microsoft Project is considered an asset.• Knowledge of pension services, public sector operations or a regulated environment is considered an asset.• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with tact, discretion and professionalism.

title: Principal Architect | Strategic Enterprise Architecture
description:
Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are building and evolving Connect, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by AI, cloud and on-premises technologies. Clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ data and insights to innovate and grow. As a Principal Architect within the Enterprise Architecture team, you will define architecture for key components and capabilities across NIQ platforms, ensuring alignment with business strategy, product objectives, technology standards, and the long-term platform vision. You will partner with architecture peers, Product and Operations leaders, engineering leaders, and development teams to take solutions from initial requirements through design, delivery, and production operation. A key focus of this role is shaping the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and agentic AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will combine broad enterprise architecture experience with practical knowledge of AI-enabled systems and will grow into an end-to-end platform architect as their knowledge of NIQ's platforms expands.

Role Mandate: Act as the strategic Enterprise Architecture partner and single point of architecture accountability for an assigned NIQ product portfolio. The role connects business and product strategy to target-state architecture, capability ownership, technology roadmaps, governed standards, and delivery feedback. It is intentionally strategic while remaining close enough to Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Architecture Practice teams to ensure that direction is actionable and produces measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain the portfolio target-state architecture and rolling three-year technology roadmap, aligned with business priorities, product strategy, engineering plans, and enterprise transformation goals.
  • Serve as the named strategic architecture partner and single point of EA accountability for the assigned portfolio, building trusted working relationships with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data Science, Security, and business leadership.
  • Create and maintain business-capability, domain, application, data, and platform maps that expose ownership, dependencies, duplication, maturity gaps, lifecycle risk, and opportunities for simplification or growth.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clear architecture outcomes, transition states, investment options, sequencing recommendations, and measurable decision criteria.
  • Guide platform-placement and build-versus-buy decisions, balancing enterprise reuse and standards with appropriate portfolio autonomy, speed, cost, resilience, and client commitments.
  • Define and contribute reusable reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and decision trees, including patterns for AI, Generative AI, agentic AI, data, integration, cloud, security, and observability.
  • Drive adoption of approved architecture standards and bring standards, reference architectures, major exceptions, and cross-functional decisions through the lightweight EA governance process for ratification.
  • Own visibility of portfolio architecture risks, strategic exceptions, technical debt, capability gaps, and cross portfolio dependencies; ensure actions, owners, and escalation paths are clear.
  • Partner with the Solution Architecture pillar to triage architecturally significant demand, shape initiatives early, and ensure delivery-level learning feeds back into portfolio strategy, standards, and roadmaps.
  • Assess emerging technologies and market shifts, especially AI and agentic commerce, and convert relevant signals into adoption guidance, controlled experiments, investment recommendations, and roadmap implications.
  • Enable self-service architecture by creating high-quality, reusable content for NIQ architecture knowledge repositories and supporting AI-enabled access to standards, patterns, decisions, and portfolio views.
  • Establish and run an effective operating cadence, including strategic portfolio reviews, intake alignment with Solution Architecture, reference artifact alignment with the Architecture Practice, and architect-only sessions to drive capability and domain consistency.
  • Define outcome-oriented measures for the portfolio, such as roadmap adoption, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, decision cycle time, standards adoption, and value realized from technology investments.
  • Support M&A due diligence and integration planning by assessing capability fit, architecture compatibility, technology risk, redundancy, security considerations, and potential integration paths.
  • Mentor architects and engineering leaders, communicate complex decisions clearly, and influence across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, solution architecture, platform architecture, or enterprise architecture, including significant experience with enterprise-scale products and data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to define target-state architectures and multi-year technology roadmaps, and to connect them to business capabilities, product objectives, investment decisions, and executable transition plans.
  • Experience operating as a strategic advisor to senior Product, Engineering, Technology, Operations, or business leaders, with evidence of influencing decisions across multiple organizations and geographies.
  • Strong knowledge of capability-based planning, domain and platform mapping, application rationalization, technology lifecycle management, technical debt, and architecture risk management.
  • Experience creating and driving adoption of enterprise standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, architecture decision records, and governance processes that are pragmatic and lightweight.
  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, data, integration, API, security, resilience, observability, and distributed system architecture, preferably in Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments.
  • Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI architectures, including model and tool integration, retrieval augmented generation, orchestration, context and memory, evaluation, guardrails, observability, human oversight, and Responsible AI controls.
  • Ability to assess emerging technologies and develop clear build-versus-buy, adoption, migration, and total-cost of-ownership recommendations.
  • Experience partnering with Solution Architecture and delivery teams on architecturally significant initiatives while preserving a strategic, portfolio-wide perspective.
  • Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to express complex architecture choices as concise options, trade-offs, decisions, roadmaps, and executive-level narratives.
  • Proven facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to establish accountability and progress in a matrixed organization.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in data, analytics, measurement, consumer intelligence, retail, media, or other information intensive product environments.
  • Knowledge of ArchiMate, capability-based planning methods, and enterprise architecture repositories such as ADOIT.
  • Experience with product operating models, agile delivery, portfolio planning, FinOps, and outcome-based technology investment governance.
  • Experience supporting technology due diligence, post-merger integration, platform consolidation, or large-scale modernization and simplification programs.
  • Hands-on engineering or architecture experience with APIs, Python, databases, data pipelines, cloud-native platforms, MLOps or LLMOps, or enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI.
  • Thinks in business capabilities, portfolios, platforms, and multi-year outcomes rather than isolated projects.

Successful Profile:

  • Balances enterprise consistency with purposeful autonomy and avoids governance for its own sake.
  • Creates clarity from complexity, makes decision ownership explicit, and converts strategy into reusable architecture assets.
  • Builds trust through early engagement, pragmatic recommendations, transparent trade-offs, and reliable follow-through.
  • Uses delivery feedback to continuously improve target states, standards, patterns, and investment guidance.

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

title: Senior RF & PHY Systems Engineer
description:
Serve as the technical focal point for advanced RF and physical layer (PHY) modem systems, driving the definition, analysis, and hands-on performance verification of next-generation wireless architectures. In this role, you bridge baseband signal processing and analog RF hardware, taking architectural and technical ownership of link performance, system behavior, and end-to-end functionality.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Experience: 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience in RF and physical layer (PHY) system design, analysis, or performance engineering for wireless communications.
  • System & Performance Scope: Proven track record defining and executing system evaluations associated with RF, baseband, PHY, and modem performance.
  • Programming & Data Analysis: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm validation, data analysis, instrument automation, and custom test script development.
  • RF Test & Measurement Expertise: Deep practical knowledge in operating high-frequency RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and vector network analyzers (VNAs).
  • System Debugging Intuition: Exceptional deep-dive debugging skills capable of isolating issues across the boundaries of RF, digital hardware, and physical layer software.
  • RF Principles: Solid understanding of RF chains and parameters, including Noise Figure (NF), third-order intercept point (IP3), return loss (RL), and receiver architectures (Superheterodyne / Zero-IF).
  • Communication & Documentation: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with a proven ability to author technical system documents and specifications.

Nice to have

  • Digital Communications & Impairments: Practical knowledge of I/Q modulation (QAM, PSK), Digital Predistortion (DPD), Automatic Gain Control (AGC), and Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) characterization.
  • Cross-Functional Interface: Experience acting as a technical bridge or focal point communicating directly with RFIC design, algorithm, software, and firmware teams.
  • Engineering Mindset: Strong pragmatic problem-solving skills, broad system-level perspective, and a collaborative approach in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

The county also administers a road district, a rural law enforcement district, and a local sewer district. The Facilities Department reports to the county administration division.

the position

Under supervision of the Jail Lieutenant, this position’s duties include providing for the safety and security of the Clatsop County Jail. Receive, book, and lodge Adults in Custody (AIC). Maintain custody and surveillance of AIC. Transport AIC to and from court, medical appointments, and evaluations. Supervise AIC assigned to outside custody such as work crew. Protect the courthouse and grounds. This position is represented by the Clatsop County Law Enforcement Association (CCLEA) union.
This recruitment is to create a pool of qualified applicants for the Clatsop County Sheriff’s Office Correction Division of Deputies.

Mandatory QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum 21 years of age, a United States citizen and possess and maintain driving privileges in the state of Oregon within 30 days after employment.
High school diploma or demonstrate successful completion of General Education Development (GED) test.
Must meet DPSST “Minimum Standards for Employment as a Law Enforcement Officer” OAR 259-008-0010.
Must pass entry-level pre-employment evaluations, including Oregon Physical Ability Test (ORPAT), drug screen, and psychological evaluation prior to appointment.
Must not have been convicted of any felonies nor any law involving the unlawful use, possession, delivery, or manufacture of a controlled substance, narcotic, or dangerous drug, nor any law involving dishonesty or moral turpitude as identified in Oregon Administrative Rules 259-008-0070.
Must be of good moral fitness as determined by a comprehensive background investigation, including credit check.
Possess Basic Corrections Certificate or can obtain within one year of original appointment.
Maintain Corrections Certification

Requested QUALIFICATIONS

Previous college-level training or experience in law enforcement or corrections.
Knowledge of modern policies, procedures, and techniques for the custody, care, and transportation of AIC, applicable laws, ordinances, and jail standards.
Knowledge of investigative methods and techniques, first aid, use of fingerprinting, photographic, breathalyzer, and video monitoring equipment, and report writing.
Bilingual English/Spanish

to Apply

This posting is to build a pool of applicants for future vacancies. Candidates from diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Clatsop County is an equal opportunity employer, does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age or disability, and is committed to workplace diversity.

The company acts as a trusted adviser to investors, non-profit organizations, public-private partnerships, and developers around the globe as they navigate the challenges inherent in complex construction projects. https://www.sbiconsultants.com/

Job Description

SBI Consultants is currently looking for a Data Science Engineer (DSE) to join our team.

The Data Science Engineer supports the company's ongoing data infrastructure transformation by helping implement and maintain a centralized data architecture that enables analytics-driven decision-making across the organization. This role blends technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with practical understanding of business operations, especially within the construction industry.

The Data Science Engineer works closely with senior team members to design and optimize data systems, develop analytical models, and support AI/ML-driven initiatives.

Duties & Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of a centralized multimodal database to support organizational business objectives
  • Build and optimize data pipelines for automated ETL processes across structured and unstructured data sources
  • Support continuous data ingestion for project lists, metadata, cost data, and schedule information
  • Contribute to defining and applying data governance frameworks, quality standards, and workflow protocols
  • Coordinate with project managers and engineers to ensure accurate, timely data collection and updates
  • Monitor database performance and report findings, issues and opportunities for optimization

AI/ML Development & Advanced Analytics

Contribute to the development and deployment of AI models and machine learning algorithms for:

  • Complex querying of scope, quantities, costs, and schedules
  • Value engineering optimization
  • Risk mitigations & predictive analytics
  • Support the creation of analytical models to evaluate costs, schedules, potential savings, and risk factors
  • Aid in developing of benchmarking tools segmented by sector and project type
  • Conduct historical data analysis to identify trends and patterns
  • Support strategic decision-making through data-driven insights

Business Intelligence & Visualization

  • Maintain and enhance existing Power BI dashboards with rigorous quality controls
  • Support the design and implementation of portfolio-level dashboards with key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Train internal staff on data literacy and dashboard utilization
  • Facilitate data analysis and support cross-functional teams in deriving actionable insights
  • Ensure timely and accurate project data visualization

Technology Support

  • Research emerging data technologies, AI tools, and analytics platforms
  • Provide part‑time support for projects and cost management activities as needed
  • Other ad hoc assignments

Competencies

  • Ability to align data solutions to business objectives
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with engineers, project managers, and executives
  • Problem‑solving mindset with attention to data quality and accuracy
  • Commitment to continuous learning in rapidly evolving data technologies

Computer/Technical Skills

Data Engineering:

  • Good understanding of data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and workflow automation
  • Some Knowledge of relational and non-relational database architecture; structuring of data lakes
  • Understanding of data security and access control
  • Proficient in data cleaning, transformation and ingestion techniques

Data Science

  • Data analysis
  • Visualization: Power BI skills; other Dashboarding experience a plus
  • Exposure to machine learning frameworks and LLM implementation
  • Interpreting and communicating data insights

Programming languages: Proficiency in Python, familiarity with C++ and SQLis desirable

Cloud Platforms: Working knowledge of one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)

Qualifications

Bachelor degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science or related field from an accredited university. Master degree preferred.

  • 2+ years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML.
  • Experience assisting in AI/ML model development, testing, and deployment in production environments; recent exposure (within past 1-2 yrs) to modern AI technologies including LLMs.
  • Experience building or contributing to data pipelines, ETL workflows and data architecture design.
  • Demonstrated experience working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets
  • Preferred but not required: Familiarity with construction industry data, cost estimating methodologies, and project management systems
  • Experience with construction-specific software and data structures
  • Understanding of project lifecycle data from planning through closeout
  • A Plus: Relevant professional certifications in cloud platforms, data engineering, or machine learning such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or similar cloud platform certifications; Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate; Professional certifications in data science or machine learning (e.g., Google Professional Data Engineer)

Communication Skills

This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams including engineering, project management, and executive leadership. Excellent communication skills to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Ability to establish productive interpersonal working relationships and engage across all levels of the organization.

Compensation

Offered rate of compensation will commensurate with individual education, qualifications, experience, skills and work location.

Benefits Package

We strive to provide our employees with hybrid and flexible work environment within projects' constrains. This role requires employee to work from the office at least 4 days per week.

title: Senior Consultant | Mandarin
description:

SW Accountants & Advisors (SW) is Australia’s best kept accounting secret. We are a leading advisory and accounting firm with a 90-year history in Australia. SW provide a full range of audit, business advisory, corporate finance, tax, private clients, and wealth management solutions. Own it, Love your work, Share the load, Embrace the ride, Open doors. Our values are at the very heart of our firm and guide the way we interact within our firm’s teams, with our clients, and the way we interact and engage with you.

You will also be responsible for delegating work to junior staff members, ensuring you review all work and mentor them though the process. Complete the audit file for the full range of the firm’s clients; from planning to finalisation of the audit file

Clear all Manager and Partner review points in relation to each audit assignment taken
Review a financial report from the client’s trial balance and complete the disclosure checklist
Prepare non-standard management letters, correspondences and reports to client
Complete special assignments under the direction of the Audit Manager
Work co-operatively with other team members, mentor junior team members
Understand the nature of a client’s business operations, needs and expectations, and identify any audit related issues
Provide constructive advice to clients, and promptly and accurately follow up any queries

Minimum of 3 years’ experience working in an Audit environment in a Chartered / CPA accounting practice
Degree qualified and be near to qualifying or fully qualified as a CA/CPA
Technically proficient and keen to develop knowledge with the latest accounting and auditing developments
Previous experience mentoring and coaching junior staff members, and review their work
Prior experience working with and developing good relationships with clients
Good time management skills and ability to prioritise work and meet deadlines for multiple clients
Present professionally and possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Experience with an Audit package such as CaseWare, and Microsoft Office applications
Proficiency in Mandarin is essential

Best kept secrets of SW

Progressive firm, with excellent career opportunities
Hybrid working environment
2 additional AL days per year

Paid volunteer leave
Refer to client and refer a friend bonus scheme
Employee Assistance Program and Wellness perks
Assistance with home office setup
Social Club

1 paid professional membership per year
Weekly lunch provided

title: Rockwear Senior Production Coordinator - Rosebery, NSW
