title: Director, Growth Strategy, Planning + Ops
description:
As we evolve our product, redefine our brand and accelerate global growth, we're creating a Growth organisation capable of operating with the discipline of a world-class technology business and the creativity of a culture-leading brand for independent artists.

Reporting to the the VP Global Marketing this role will be responsible for building the engine that powers this transformation. Acting as a strategic partner to the Leadership Team, you will establish the planning and operating model that enables Brand and Growth to operate as one high-performing global organisation that finds, retains and empowers independent artists at scale.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a highly driven, entrepreneurial leader who enjoys building from the ground up. You will design and embed the frameworks, rhythms and governance that bring clarity, alignment and accountability to how Marketing works - transforming ambition into measurable execution at scale. From annual planning and integrated campaign operations to launch excellence and budget management, you will create the systems that enable the team to move faster, make better decisions and deliver greater commercial impact.

Working closely with Product, Finance, Data, Customer Experience, regional teams and colleagues across Believe, TuneCore’s parent company, you will operationalise the creation, communication and delivery of key strategic initiatives, ensuring they are scalable, measurable and aligned to business priorities. You will champion an insight-led approach to planning, helping the organisation develop a deeper understanding of artist needs, marketing effectiveness and opportunities for growth.

You are equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up your sleeves to make it happen. You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are naturally curious and data-driven, and bring the confidence to challenge thinking, influence senior stakeholders and continuously improve the way teams work together. Above all, you believe that operational excellence is not about process for process' sake - it exists to unlock creativity, accelerate innovation and ultimately help more independent artists succeed at scale.

The tasks and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Strategy + Planning

  • Partner with Leadership to define strategic priorities, resource allocation and investment decisions.
  • Develop and own the annual planning process, translating company objectives into integrated marketing priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Establish quarterly and bi-annual planning rhythms that align Growth, Brand, Product and the business teams around shared objectives.
  • Build and maintain the organisation’s roadmap, ensuring visibility across initiatives, launches and campaigns.

Operations

  • Design and implement scalable operating models, governance and ways of working.
  • Introduce best practice planning processes, briefing frameworks, approval workflows and project management disciplines.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities and decision-making frameworks across the organisation.
  • Drive operational excellence through continuous process improvement and simplification.
  • Lead cross-functional planning, ensuring Product, Growth, Brand, Creative, Regional and Finance teams are aligned from strategy through execution.
  • Create consistent launch frameworks, timelines, playbooks and retrospectives to improve delivery over time.

Marketing Performance & Measurement

  • Build the measurement framework, defining success metrics across Brand, Growth and Int’l teams.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting that provide real-time, actionable visibility of performance, campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Finance + Insights teams to establish attribution models, reporting standards and performance insights.
  • Lead regular business reviews, identifying opportunities to optimise performance and improve return on investment.

Budget + Resource Management

  • Partner with Finance and Growth Leadership to manage annual marketing budgets and investment planning.
  • Track spend across teams, markets and programmes, ensuring effective allocation of resources against strategic priorities.
  • Build forecasting models and investment frameworks that support data-informed decision making.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Act as the operational connector between Growth, Brand, Product, Finance, Data,Customer Experience and Business teams.
  • Facilitate strategic planning sessions, leadership reviews and cross-functional governance meetings.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, transparency and continuous improvement across the organisation.

Some international travel (at least 10-25% of the time) is required

  • 10+ years experience in Marketing Strategy, Marketing Operations, Business Operations or Commercial Strategy within a high-growth technology, SaaS, marketplace or digital consumer business.

  • Demonstrated success building marketing planning processes, operating models and organisational rhythms from the ground up.

  • Experience leading annual planning, quarterly business reviews, integrated launch planning and cross-functional programme management.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes and financial performance.

  • Excellent analytical capability, including experience developing KPIs, dashboards, measurement frameworks and executive reporting.

  • Deep understanding of modern marketing organisations across Brand, Growth, Product Marketing and Creative functions.

  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across complex global organisations.

  • Exceptional organisational and programme management skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.

  • Experience managing budgets, agency relationships and cross-functional investment planning.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building new capabilities within fast-changing environments.

  • Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear action.

  • Passion for music, creators and the independent artist ecosystem is highly desirable.

  • Experience supporting international or multi-market marketing organisations is preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; postgraduate qualification in Business, Marketing or Strategy is advantageous.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

Location: This role will be based out of the London, Believe office in Kings Cross. TuneCore operates on an in-office and remote hybrid model giving our teams flexibility and choice of how they work. Required in-office Tues, Weds, Thurs.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Our Values

TuneCore is a team of creators, for creators. Our mission is to support our artists and labels at every stage of their careers. Our driving forces are fairness, expertise, respect and transparency. As global citizens, we believe that if we build more diverse, equitable and inclusive teams across our company, we will collectively create and offer more innovative solutions and better serve our artists, labels, partners, and employees.

We strive to build a company that reflects the communities we serve and embraces the diversity of the world we live in, where each person’s unique perspective is valued, and where everyone has the same opportunities and is supported in their personal and professional growth. From our hiring practices to the culture we create and nurture, we are committed to listening, learning and evolving. Our goal is to make TuneCore an inspirational place that feels comfortable and familiar no matter how you look, where you call home, who you love, what you believe, or what’s on your playlist.

CSR Strategy: Shaping Music for Good

Our core values are put into action through Shaping Music for Good, Believe and TuneCore’s global corporate social responsibility strategy, integrated at all levels of the company and at the heart of our business model.

We strive to shape the music industry for good by building trusting relationships with artists and partners, investing in the growth and talent development of our local markets, and empowering our community to positively impact society. We work to achieve progress on our core priorities: gender equity, diversity, equity & inclusion, environmental sustainability, and wellness for our employees, artists, and industry partners.

Shapers Program

Employees have the opportunity to join the Shapers Program, a resource group made up of teammates who want to dedicate their time and skills to Shaping Music For Good initiatives. Shapers develop action plans, educate teammates, support the implementation of programs, and inspire action within the organization on causes and issues that align with TuneCore and Believe’s SMFG priorities.

Inclusion in the Music Business Report

In 2025, Believe and TuneCore partnered with the Annenberg Inclusion Initiative, the world’s leading think tank studying diversity and inclusion in the entertainment industry, to produce the second Inclusion in the Music Business report which analyzes the gender, race, and ethnicity among executive leadership in the music industry.

Recognition and Awards

Fast Company's 10 Most Innovative Companies in Music list (2023-2025)

Crain's Best Places to Work in NYC (2022-2024)

Benefits & Perks

At TuneCore we’re committed to the well-being of our employees and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Private health care
  • Pension plan with matched contribution up to 10%
  • 25 days annual leave (+1 day for your birthday, 1 moving house day, up to 3 compassionate leave days)
  • Life assurance and income protection
  • Access to Eutelmed, a digital mental health and well-being platform offering sessions with experienced psychologists
  • 40% discount on gym membership and free sport classes
  • Company wide events, outings and volunteer days – we have team spirit and know how to have fun!
  • Hybrid Work
  • Learning and development opportunities and career development training – we believe in promoting and growing our leadership from within the company and proactively invest in our people.
  • Free distribution subscription for employees – so you can experience the magic of releasing music worldwide (and give us valuable feedback!)

Equal Employment Opportunity

TuneCore, a wholly owned subsidiary of Believe, is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable Accommodations

TuneCore, a wholly owned subsidiary of Believe, is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact Human Resources.

This role is based in London. You must have the right to work in the UK otherwise your application will not be considered.

title: Allround Planner
description:
De Allround Planner is verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen, bewaken en optimaliseren van de supply chain planning van grondstoffen, verpakkingsmaterialen, productie en uitleveringen. De functie zorgt voor een optimale balans tussen klantvraag, productiecapaciteit, voorraadniveaus en beschikbaarheid van materialen, met als doel een maximale leverbetrouwbaarheid en efficiënte inzet van middelen.

Werken als Allround Planner betekent meer dan alleen plannen.

Je komt terecht in een jong, gedreven en ambitieus team waar samenwerking, ontwikkeling en initiatief centraal staan. Geen dag is hetzelfde: je schakelt met verschillende collega's, lost uitdagingen op en zorgt ervoor dat processen soepel verlopen. We bieden je de ruimte om mee te denken, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en jezelf professioneel te ontwikkelen. Ben jij energiek, leergierig en houd je van dynamiek? Dan is dit de ideale kans om je carrière te starten of verder uit te bouwen binnen een team dat samen successen behaalt en tegelijkertijd veel plezier heeft in het werk.

Hoofdverantwoordelijkheden

Material Planning en Groene koffie planning

  • Bewaken van beschikbaarheid van grondstoffen en verpakkingsmaterialen.
  • Opstellen en onderhouden van materiaalbehoeftenplanningen.
  • Initiëren van bestellingen binnen vastgestelde parameters.
  • Actief opvolgen van leveranciersprestaties en leveringen.
  • Voorkomen van materiaaltekorten en overtollige voorraden.
  • Signaleren van risico's in beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit of levertijden.

Production Scheduling

  • Opstellen van gedetailleerde productieplanningen.
  • Optimaliseren van bezetting, capaciteit en omsteltijden.
  • Dagelijkse afstemming met productie over voortgang en afwijkingen.
  • Bijstellen van planningen bij wijzigingen in vraag, capaciteit of materiaalbeschikbaarheid.
  • Monitoren van de realisatie ten opzichte van planning.

Inventory Management

  • Bewaken van voorraadniveaus van grondstoffen, verpakkingen en gereed product.
  • Initiëren van acties ter voorkoming van obsolete voorraad.
  • Optimaliseren van veiligheidsvoorraden en voorraadparameters.
  • Ondersteunen van voorraadanalyses en cycle counts.

Performance Management

  • Analyseren van planning- en supply chain prestaties.
  • Opstellen van rapportages en KPI-overzichten.
  • Identificeren en implementeren van verbeterinitiatieven.
  • Ondersteunen van continue verbeterprojecten binnen de supply chain.

Bevoegdheden

  • Aanpassen van planningen binnen afgesproken kaders.
  • Prioriteren van orders en productieruns.
  • Escaleren van leverings-, voorraad- en capaciteitsproblemen.
  • Initiëren van corrigerende maatregelen bij dreigende verstoringen.

Opleiding

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.
  • Opleiding in Supply Chain Management, Logistiek, Bedrijfskunde of vergelijkbaar.

Ervaring

2 jaar werkervaring in:

  • Het maken van een planning binnen productie-, FMCG- of supply chain omgeving.
  • Het maken van een materiaalplanning, productieplanning of logistieke planning.
  • Ervaring met ERP-systemen, bij voorkeur SAP of OMP of een vergelijkbaar systeem.

Kennis

  • Supply Chain Management.
  • MRP-processen.
  • Voorraadbeheer.
  • Productieplanning.
  • Excel en planningssystemen.

Competenties

  • Analytisch sterk.
  • Goede organisatorische vaardigheden.
  • Besluitvaardig.

title: Full stack web developer & SEO/ AEO specialist
description:
Full stack web developer & SEO/ AEO specialist

About Indo Property Hub

Indo Property Hub (IPH) is building a new generation of Indonesian property technology — combining a property marketplace, property services directory, market insights and other tools into one integrated platform.

We are a growing technology business and are looking for a strong, hands‑on Web Developer to join our team and take responsibility for the ongoing development, maintenance and optimization of the IPH platform.

This is not simply a WordPress content or website administration role.

We are looking for someone who understands what happens behind the website — including backend coding, custom functionality, plugins, databases, integrations, tag tracking, speed optimization, troubleshooting and performance.

The role also includes SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). When there are no immediate development, maintenance or repair tasks, the developer will work on improving the platform’s organic search performance and visibility across Google and emerging AI/answer engines.

THE ROLE

You will have two main areas of responsibility:

1. WEB DEVELOPMENT & PLATFORM MAINTENANCE

You will be responsible for keeping the IPH platform technically strong, reliable and continuously improving.

This includes:

  • Backend WordPress development
  • PHP development and custom coding
  • Developing and modifying WordPress plugins
  • Creating custom functionality where existing plugins are insufficient
  • Troubleshooting and repairing website and plugin issues
  • Working with WooCommerce and WordPress integrations
  • Database management and optimization
  • API integrations and third‑party services
  • Website performance and technical optimization
  • Security and technical maintenance
  • Identifying and fixing bugs
  • Improving existing platform functionality
  • Implementing new features and platform improvements
  • Maintaining compatibility between WordPress, plugins and custom code
  • Working with hosting, CDN and website infrastructure when required

We are particularly interested in someone who can look at an existing system, understand how it works, identify the problem and build the appropriate solution, rather than relying entirely on additional plugins.

2. SEO & AEO OPTIMISATION

When development work is not the immediate priority, you will work closely with the management team on improving IPH’s organic search and AI‑search visibility.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Technical SEO
  • On‑page SEO implementation
  • Website structure and internal linking
  • Schema / structured data
  • Crawlability and indexation
  • XML sitemaps
  • Search Console analysis
  • Core Web Vitals and technical performance
  • Optimizing pages for Google Search
  • AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
  • Optimizing content and page structures for AI‑generated answers
  • Improving entity understanding and topical authority
  • Identifying SEO opportunities from search data
  • Implementing SEO improvements directly on the website
  • Monitoring indexing and search performance
  • Identifying technical issues affecting organic traffic
  • Supporting the creation of scalable SEO landing pages
  • Testing and measuring SEO improvements

You do not need to be a professional copywriter. We are primarily looking for someone who understands the technical side of SEO/AEO and can implement improvements directly on the platform.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong PHP knowledge
  • Experience developing or modifying WordPress plugins
  • Experience with custom WordPress coding
  • Strong understanding of WordPress backend architecture
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex website issues independently
  • Experience with MySQL / WordPress databases
  • Understanding of APIs and third‑party integrations
  • Strong technical SEO knowledge
  • Understanding of Google Search Console
  • Understanding of website indexing and crawling
  • Good understanding of modern SEO principles
  • Understanding of AEO / AI‑search optimisation
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems

Highly Desirable

  • Experience building custom WordPress plugins from scratch
  • Experience with REST APIs
  • Experience with Cloudflare or CDN systems
  • Experience with website performance optimization
  • Experience with structured data / Schema.org
  • Experience with GA4
  • Experience with google tag manager
  • Experience with large or growing WordPress websites
  • Experience with real estate, marketplace or directory platforms
  • Experience implementing SEO at scale
  • Experience optimizing websites for Google AI Overviews and other AI search systems

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

This position is probably not suitable if your experience is primarily:

  • Installing and configuring WordPress themes
  • Installing plugins without understanding their underlying code
  • Making simple visual/page‑builder changes
  • Managing website content only
  • Relying on plugins for every technical problem
  • SEO reporting without the ability to implement technical changes

We need a developer who can actually code and solve problems.

HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME

The workload will vary depending on the needs of the platform on any given day.

For example:

60-80% development, maintenance and troubleshooting

20-40% SEO/AEO optimization

60-70% SEO/AEO optimization

The objective is to keep the developer productive at all times.

When there is an urgent platform issue or a new feature to develop, development takes priority.

Our platform is rapidly evolving, so this role will only suit fast and efficient WebDev's.

When the platform is stable, the focus shifts toward improving IPH’s organic search performance, indexation, AEO and overall technical optimization.

WHAT WE OFFER

Opportunity to work on a growing Indonesian technology platform

Significant responsibility and ownership of the website’s technical development

Direct access to company management

Opportunity to influence the technical direction of the platform

Variety of development, technical SEO and AEO work

Long‑term opportunity as the platform grows, developer now, WebDev manager later, potential WebDev agency General Manager in the future, huge opportunities for skilled and ambitious people.

Professional working environment

Potential for increasing responsibility as IPH expands

This is an opportunity to become a key technical member of a growing technology business rather than simply maintaining a static company website.

The role focuses on the HR data and processes required within S/4HANA, rather than the full SAP HCM suite. You will be responsible for defining the solution architecture, ensuring effective integration with surrounding systems, and supporting the solution throughout implementation and deployment.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Define and own the solution architecture for HR Mini Master (HRMM) in SAP S/4HANA.
  • Design the HRMM solution based on business and technical requirements, covering the relevant subset of SAP HCM functionality required in S/4HANA.
  • Define how employee and organizational data is represented and maintained within S/4HANA.
  • Design and oversee integrations between HRMM and other SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable solution designs.
  • Ensure alignment between HRMM and relevant S/4HANA processes and integration points.
  • Work closely with HR/HCM functional consultants, integration teams, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Support configuration and implementation teams with architectural guidance and design decisions.
  • Support testing, deployment, cutover, and resolution of solution and integration issues.
  • Review solution designs and ensure consistency with the overall S/4HANA architecture.
  • Prepare and maintain solution architecture and design documentation.
  • Strong experience with SAP HCM / HR and a solid understanding of HR master data and organizational structures.
  • Experience designing or implementing HR Mini Master (HRMM) solutions in SAP S/4HANA.
  • Strong understanding of relevant SAP HCM areas, particularly Personnel Administration (PA) and Organizational Management (OM).

title: Editor - Content Review
description:
In this Editor- Content Review role you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality and integrity of cutting-edge research published at Taylor & Francis.

You will be responsible for the delivery of content validation through desk assessment of submissions and published content to ensure alignment with Taylor & Francis’ quality and ethical benchmarks. The successful candidate will report to the Lead – Content Review and will join a team of Content Review Editors.

This is a fantastic role for an individual with exceptional attention to detail, a proactive approach to process improvement and problem-solving, and a real passion for upholding publishing ethics and integrity and supporting the peer review process. You will be managing sensitive and complex stakeholder relationships including authors, editors, suppliers, and colleagues, so excellent communication skills are also essential. We offer excellent training and development opportunities as part of a friendly and collaborative global team environment.

Given the nature of the subject matter involved these roles would suit individuals with a Post-Graduate background preferably in a STEM subject, as you will be required to understand the scientific context of the articles you will support.

What you will be doing:

  • Content integrity screening of submissions to ensure adherence to editorial policy and research integrity standards, suitability of submissions to the journal’s scope, and adherence to ethical and quality guidelines.
  • Assessing articles as required for image quality, plagiarism issues, and identifying any other related concerns.
  • Supporting other desk assessment teams with resolution of escalations and queries.
  • Supporting the wider Publishing Ethics and Integrity team in the delivery of strategic initiatives, including a program of journal ethics audit, testing and piloting of research integrity tools and ethics investigations.
  • Effective liaison with authors, reviewers, academic editors, and internal editorial teams on manuscript completion requirements and timelines.
  • Managing the quality of the content integrity screening services delivery through problem-solving, data analysis, recognising process improvement opportunities, effective feedback, and liaising with the broader Publishing Ethics and Integrity team and the Editorial Operations teams.
  • Staying up to date with internal and external guidelines on ethical publication practices.
  • Providing excellent and empathic customer service and management of internal and external stakeholder expectations.
  • Providing project support to the Team Lead where required, including on process optimization, reporting data analysis on test journals, training, meetings, and workshops by participating, organising, and collating meeting notes as required.
  • Handling confidential information sensitively with consideration for the legal and ethical issues that may arise due to mishandling.
  • Managing your own learning, taking responsibility to identify and develop skills gaps and active knowledge sharing
  • A post-graduate qualification in a STEM subject.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the journal peer review process.
  • An interest and awareness of academic publishing, research integrity and publishing ethics.
  • Confident communication skills (emails, phone, and in-person) with a strong command of English spelling and grammar.
  • Knowledge and experience of process-driven workflows.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing role.
  • Ability to be detail-oriented, accurate, and a problem-solver.
  • Excellent organisational skills and confidence in completing multiple tasks to deadlines.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Global-e (Nasdaq: GLBE) is the world’s leading platform for global direct-to-consumer e-commerce, enabling brands and retailers to seamlessly sell worldwide, delivering localized experiences across markets.

Trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands including Adidas, Alo Yoga, Logitech, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, and Victoria’s Secret, we operate on a massive global scale through dynamic teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

Our technology-based end-to-end solution combines advanced localization capabilities, streamlined global operations and extensive big-data analytics, covering everything merchants need to scale worldwide. We’re a fast-moving, highly collaborative company where innovation, creativity, ownership, and impact are part of everyday work.

We're looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to join Global-e and own the delivery of strategic and technically complex projects.

You'll work with a handful of merchants on an ongoing basis, build deep knowledge of their setup and their business, and become the person both sides rely on to get complex things done.

  • What you'll do
  • Own strategic and technically complex projects end to end for a portfolio of Global-e's most significant merchants - from scoping through delivery.
  • Lead the internal weekly forum for your accounts, bringing together Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions, Integrations and Product to align on project status, roadmap and open technical issues.
  • Own and maintain the product roadmap for your merchants: track feature requests through Product, keep commitments realistic and timelines current.
  • Act as the focal point for your merchants - representing them internally and representing Global-e to them. Own the relationship and the outcome.
  • Navigate ambiguity. Every strategic merchant is set up differently; you'll hold the line on our standards while adapting the approach to each account.
  • Drive resolution on escalations and production issues, routing them to the right teams and staying accountable until closed.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in B2B / Enterprise Project Management, including experience managing demanding, high-visibility clients.
  • Strong technical understanding and the ability to communicate effectively with both engineering teams and clients’ technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience in software development, web technologies, or e-commerce integrations – a strong advantage.
  • Strong interest and affinity for AI – required.
  • Proven ability to drive projects and deliver results through cross-functional teams without direct management authority.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and work well under deadlines in a fast-changing environment.
  • Self-driven and able to independently manage and prioritize tasks.
  • Excellent written and verbal English; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Experience working with distributed, international teams across different time zones.

title: Applied Scientist, AWS Developer Tools Science
description:
We are looking for a Applied Scientist who is passionate about building services and tools for developers that leverage generative artificial intelligence and machine learning. You will be part of a team building Large Language Model (LLM)-based services with the focus on enhancing the developer experience in the Cloud. The team works in close collaboration with other AWS services such the AWS IDE Toolkit, AWS Bedrock, AWS MCPs and Agent Toolkit and develops aws-bench Open Source agent benchmark. If you are excited about working in cloud computing and building new AWS services, then we'd love to talk to you.

As a Applied Scientist, you love designing, implementing, and evaluating machine learning solutions to difficult applied problems, and diving into complex data sources crawled from the web or internal logging tools. You are recognized for your expertise and work closely with software engineers to drive the delivery of end-to-end modeling solutions. Your work focuses on ambiguous problem areas where the business problem or opportunity may not yet be defined. The problems that you take on require scientific breakthroughs.

You actively participate in mindful discussions with customers, engineers, and scientist peers, and define the right modeling and component design approach and implement ML solutions to achieve the desired customer experience and scientific and business outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Use Python and various open source libraries to develop and/or improve LLMs, AI agents and agentic tools for business applications
- Build benchmarks that measure AI agents performance on AWS workloads and idenitifes improvement areas and build documentation, instructions or tools to improve how agents interact with AWS.
- Own the technical quality of a product where modeling improvements can improve technical designs and drive value for other scientists and engineers
- Understand the challenges that developers face when building cloud-based solutions, and develop generalizable solutions.
- Collaborate with developers and pave the way towards bringing your solution into production systems. Participate in cross team projects and ensure technical blockers are resolved.
- Communicate and document your research by writing internal documents, giving talks/demos, and striving to publish papers in external scientific venues.

A day in the life
Utility Computing (UC)

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful start-ups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fuelled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

About the team
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Developer Tools Science team uses generative AI and foundation models to reimagine the experience of all builders on AWS. From the IDE to web-based tools and services, AI will help engineers work on large and small applications. We build AWS-specific benchmarks, explore new technologies and find creative solutions. Curiosity and an explorative mindset can find a place here to impact the life of engineers around the world.

If you are excited about this space and want to enlighten your peers with new capabilities, this is the team for you.

title: Med Tech
description:
Position Summary

Hours are 2pm-10pm

The Medication Technician is responsible for the safe, accurate, and timely administration of resident medications in accordance with physician orders, facility policies, state regulations, and delegated nursing oversight. This role plays a critical part in promoting resident health and well-being through diligent medication management, observation of resident responses, accurate documentation, and prompt communication of medication-related concerns. The Medication Technician helps maintain a safe, supportive, and resident-centered environment while ensuring compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide assistance with activities of daily living (ADLs), including bathing, grooming, dressing, toileting, and mobility.
  • Support residents with meal preparation, dining, and hydration, ensuring nutritional needs are met.
  • Perform light housekeeping duties including laundry, room tidiness, and common area upkeep.
  • Promptly report changes in resident condition or behavior to supervisory staff.
  • Administer prescribed medications and treatments to residents according to physician orders, delegated nursing authority, facility policies, and applicable state regulations.
  • Accurately document all medications administered, refused, held, or discontinued in the Medication Administration Record (MAR) and other required documentation systems.
  • Monitor residents for medication effectiveness, adverse reactions, side effects, or changes in condition and promptly report concerns to the nurse, supervisor, or healthcare provider as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate medication inventory, including receiving, storing, counting, ordering, and disposing of medications in accordance with regulatory and facility requirements.
  • Ensure all medications are stored, secured, and handled according to manufacturer guidelines and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Conduct routine medication cart audits, controlled substance counts, and medication record reviews to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Communicate effectively with residents, family members, physicians, pharmacies, nurses, and other team members regarding medication-related matters.
  • Assist with scheduling medication refills and coordinating pharmacy services to maintain continuity of resident care.
  • Observe and document resident health status, reporting changes in physical, mental, or emotional condition to appropriate clinical staff.
  • Support resident health and wellness by encouraging medication compliance while respecting resident rights, dignity, and independence.
  • Participate in care planning discussions and provide medication-related observations that contribute to resident service plans.
  • Respond appropriately to medication errors, incidents, or emergencies, following established reporting and corrective action procedures.
  • Complete all required documentation, training, certifications, and continuing education related to medication administration and resident care.
  • Adhere to infection prevention and control practices, resident rights policies, confidentiality requirements, and HIPAA regulations.
  • Ensure compliance with State Regulations, facility policies, and all applicable medication administration regulations.

aleja ab är ett bemanningsföretag verksamt främst i Stockholm.

Just nu söker vi för kunds räkning tolv st personer som kommer arbeta med klottersanering.

title: Control Room Specialist
description:
Control Room Specialist

Location: Viborg, Denmark
Employment: Full-time, 35 hours per week
Working hours: Shift work supporting 24/7 data center operations

Do you thrive in a technical environment where reliability, safety and attention to detail are critical?

We are looking for a Control Room Specialist (CRS) to join our team in Viborg. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the continuous and reliable operation of critical data center infrastructure.

As a Control Room Specialist, you will monitor and respond to critical systems, alarms and environmental conditions, while working closely with technicians and other teams to maintain high availability and minimize operational and safety risks.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working with complex technical systems, stays calm under pressure and takes pride in doing things right.

Your role

As part of the operations team, you will be a central point of contact for the data center's critical and non-critical infrastructure. You will monitor systems, respond to alarms and incidents, support troubleshooting and contribute to continuous improvements in operational excellence.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Monitoring and operating critical and non-critical data center infrastructure and systems

  • Responding promptly to alarms and alerts and taking appropriate action to minimize downtime

  • Acting as an incident specialist and coordinating with cross-functional teams during incidents

  • Monitoring power, cooling capacity and environmental conditions within the data halls

  • Working with BMS, SCADA, CMMS, Fire Life Safety and network systems

  • Supporting troubleshooting, analysis and optimization of technical systems

  • Performing facility rounds of SCADA/BMS systems and physical inspections of the facility

  • Supporting and guiding operators, technicians and other relevant personnel

  • Developing, reviewing, auditing and executing operating procedures, standards and specifications

  • Supporting change control activities and ensuring procedures are followed

  • Working with and escorting external contractors while ensuring compliance with facility rules

  • Participating in training, construction and commissioning activities as required

  • Contributing to continuous improvement and operational excellence

  • Working shifts to support 24/7 data center operations and being flexible when coverage of other shifts is required

What we're looking for

We are looking for a technically minded and responsible professional who can maintain focus in a high-pressure environment and who understands the importance of safety, reliability and attention to detail.

You ideally have:

  • Technical education or training, preferably as an Electrician, Marine Engineer or Cooling Technician

  • Experience from a control room environment, including monitoring BMS, SCADA and Fire Life Safety systems

  • Experience with automation, CTS, CR, SCADA, networks and servers

  • 1–3+ years of experience in a mission-critical environment, such as a data center, shipping, power/heat plant or oil & gas

  • Electrical or mechanical certification/licence

  • The ability to read and understand electrical and mechanical manuals, drawings and sketches

  • The ability to work safely and proficiently with hand and power tools

Who you are

You are a team player with strong communication skills and a practical, solution-oriented mindset. You remain calm when things get busy and are comfortable taking responsibility when an issue needs to be resolved.

We value someone who:

  • Communicates effectively in English, both verbally and in writing

  • Has strong problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Is comfortable working in a high-pressure environment

  • Has a strong attention to detail and takes pride in their work

  • Has a positive, can-do attitude

  • Works well as part of a team and contributes to a positive working environment

  • Can adapt to changing priorities and operational needs

  • Is proactive, reliable and willing to step in when needed

  • Has good technical writing skills and can contribute to MOPs, SOPs and EOPs

A role where you can grow

We believe in continuous learning and development. As part of the role, you will participate in structured training and development, with expectations to complete:

  • Level I training within 60 days

  • Level II training modules within 6 months

  • Level III training modules within 9 months

Why this role matters

Data centers depend on reliable infrastructure around the clock. As a Control Room Specialist, you will be one of the people ensuring that critical systems are continuously monitored, issues are identified quickly and the facility operates safely and efficiently.

If you enjoy technical responsibility, teamwork, problem-solving and working in an environment where every detail matters, this could be the opportunity for you.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Director of Data Science
description:
Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model - a proprietary AI-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass-box architecture, it uses market data - not personal data - with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul.

The Large Market Model group (LMM) is looking for a Director of Data Science to lead its production engineering, overseeing MLOps, ML engineering and Data engineering. The Director owns the end to end ML lifecycle of the market model, from the data pipelines that feed it, through model training and serving, and on to the monitoring that keeps it healthy once it is live in customer systems.

Crucially, the Director is responsible for setting the roadmap across these functions, alongside LMM management and senior executives, and for turning it into work each function can execute. We are looking for a manager who has led high paced, AI first groups, and who has carried deliveries for systems running live in front of customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Decide priorities across the functions with their leads, and review the technical trade-offs yourself.
  • Manage the leads who run these functions and hold each of them to what their team has committed to.
  • Stay close to production. Own delivery dates, reliability, and what happens when something breaks.
  • Own the infrastructure for model training, serving, and large scale data processing, including its cost.
  • Decide which numbers (KPIs) the group is measured on, then track them and report them.
  • Report the group's progress and risks to senior management, to product, and to the commercial teams.
  • Work with the applied research team to move their results into production.
  • Hire and keep senior engineers, and decide how the group is staffed.
  • Set the engineering standards the group works to: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and model monitoring.


Requirements

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • 8+ years in engineering, with 5+ years leading teams and managers.
  • Worked in a multi group environment, leading projects that involve inter group dependencies
  • Production experience with time series forecasting, reinforcement learning, or large scale optimization.
  • Experience setting the direction for a machine learning or data engineering group
  • Enough depth in production ML systems to review architecture decisions with your senior engineers.
  • Experience holding managers to delivery dates and to the numbers their teams are measured on.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Python, PyTorch, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and orchestration frameworks such as Dask and Dagster.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a relevant field.
  • The ability to explain a technical decision to a commercial audience, and a commercial constraint to your engineers.

NICE TO HAVE

  • An MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or a relevant field.
  • Experience taking a machine learning platform from an early prototype to something a business runs on.

If you want to run the engineering group behind models that set real prices in real markets, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Operator
description:
As we continue to experience remarkable growth and promote our talented team members, we are excited to expand our operator workforce.

At Superheat we perform remote heat treatment in oil refineries, petrochemical plants, and power plants worldwide. Field operations personnel set up the equipment on-site while our SmartCenter Control Room Panel Operators start and monitor the heat cycles remotely.

The SmartCenter Operator manages multiple projects from all over the world in our Corporate SmartCenter Control Rooms. Operators are the critical liaison between Field Operations, Controls Support, Quality Assurance, and Engineering. This includes managing all aspects of assigned projects, from entering client documentation, setting up and monitoring cycle operations following site/client specifications, troubleshooting with multiple departments, and creating client chart packages. With Superheat you will join a strong, experienced team at a company with almost 25 years of Remote Operator Heat Treatment expertise. We pride ourselves as the premier heat treatment provider, developing all our processes, technology, and software in-house.

This position requires strong computer and technical skills as it is 100% computer work. In addition, this position starts with 8hr rotating shift, then advancing to rotating shift work - 12-hour days, and nights, including weekends.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage all tasks and statuses of assigned projects.
Ensure all Quality Assurance instructions are accurate and up to date.
Assist Controls Support and Field Operations with site equipment setup.
Ensure all client documentation is entered accurately following our Quality Assurance program.
Act as liaison between Field Operations, Controls Support, Quality Assurance and Engineering, as required.
Enter all client-specific information into our SmartView database.
Set up and start all heat treatment cycles.
Monitor cycles for trends and alarms, troubleshooting as required.
Document all heat cycle issues and non-conformances, escalating as required.
Document all project-specific process concerns, escalating as required.
Create all client chart packages and distribute them upon completion of the heat treatment cycle.
At the end of each shift, complete shift turnover for incoming shift change.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED

You can work independently while also being a valuable team player. You can identify and prioritize tasks according to urgency and importance and are comfortable seeking clarification when required.
Attention to detail is essential; we work in a fast-paced environment with a high volume of data transfer from client documentation to our SmartView database. Flexibility is also crucial, as our workload varies depending on customer demands.
A strong technical mindset is a must-have, with excellent problem-solving skills and a good understanding of processes. You need to be adaptable and open to changes, as our customers have unique requirements, and we continually refine our processes to deliver the best experience.
Experience with metallurgy, welding, and quality programs is beneficial. However, we are willing to teach an Operator who possesses a positive attitude, multitasking skills, and a willingness to learn. These qualities are essential to our team.

EDUCATIONAL & TRAINING REQUIREMENTS

Secondary School Diploma, or equivalency. Higher education considered an asset.
Superheat will provide relevant in-house training with a dedicated trainer. Once completed, you will be mentoring with an experienced operator.
Driver's License.

PHYSICAL AND COGNITIVE DEMANDS

Sitting for extended periods.
Continuous visual monitoring and alarm management on multiple monitors.
High amount of data entry from client documentation.
Rotating shift work and extended hours.
Strong organizational, prioritization and multitasking skills.

SHIFT & SCHEDULE

Start on 8-hr rotating shifts, then advance to 12-hr rotating 24/7 shifts as positions become available.
Overtime available.
Weekends as needed.
Rotating shift schedule (12-hr days/nights, 8-hr mornings/evenings).
Holidays if required.

Superheat offers a 100% employer-paid Benefit Plan as well as a Defined Contribution Pension Plan with employer contribution. In addition, there are opportunities for advancement within and movement between departments, and even the possibility of travel. If you’re the right individual or have a unique skill set, Superheat can find a place for you to best showcase your talents with our team.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

title: Integration Engineer (Python / System Integration)
description:
Rozwijamy nowoczesną platformę integracyjną wspierającą usługi HR, Payroll oraz portal pracowniczy. Integrujemy systemy kadrowo-płacowe, ERP, aplikacje klientów oraz nowe rozwiązania wdrażane w ramach transformacji cyfrowej organizacji.

Poszukujemy Integration Engineera, który będzie uczestniczył w projektowaniu, rozwoju i utrzymaniu kluczowych integracji biznesowych oraz współtworzył architekturę nowoczesnej platformy integracyjnej wykorzystywanej produkcyjnie przez naszych klientów. Dołączysz do wyspecjalizowanego Zespołu Integracyjnego składającego się obecnie z Głównego Architekta Integracji oraz Integration Engineera. Zespół odpowiada za pełne spektrum działań związanych z integracją systemów, od analizy i projektowania rozwiązań, poprzez implementację i wdrożenia, aż po monitoring i wsparcie środowisk produkcyjnych.

Oprócz realizacji nowych projektów będziesz również uczestniczyć w rozwiązywaniu złożonych problemów integracyjnych jako ekspert trzeciej linii wsparcia (L3), okazjonalnie współpracując także z zespołami pierwszej i drugiej linii wsparcia (L1/L2).

Korzystamy z narzędzi monitoringu takich jak Grafana, Splunk oraz Zabbix, zapewniając wysoką dostępność i jakość obsługiwanych procesów biznesowych.

Zakres obowiązków

  • Projektowanie, rozwój i utrzymanie integracji między systemami ERP (HR, Payroll, Finanse) oraz portalami pracowniczymi
  • Rozwój rozwiązań w Pythonie wykorzystujących API, pliki wymiany danych i mechanizmy automatyzacji
  • Analiza i rozwiązywanie problemów związanych z przepływem danych oraz integracjami produkcyjnymi
  • Udział w projektach wdrożeniowych, migracyjnych i transformacyjnych
  • Współpraca z zespołami biznesowymi HR, Payroll, IT oraz dostawcami systemów
  • Współudział w rozwoju nowoczesnej platformy integracyjnej i danych (DataBricks)
  • Stanowisko na poziomie Regular/Mid

Wymagania

  • Minimum 2 lata doświadczenia w obszarze integracji systemów, rozwoju aplikacji lub automatyzacji procesów
  • Dobra znajomość Python
  • Praktyczna znajomość SQL (wykorzystujemy bazy: PostgreSQL oraz Microsoft SQL)
  • Praca z systemami on-prem oraz chmurowymi (Microsoft Azure)
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z REST API i integracją systemów biznesowych
  • Umiejętność analizy logów i rozwiązywania problemów produkcyjnych
  • Co najmniej podstawowe doświadczenie w pracy z systemami HR, Payroll lub usługami kadrowo-płacowymi
  • Podstawowa praktyczna znajomość procesów kadrowych i płacowych
  • Umiejętność przełożenia wymagań biznesowych obszaru HR i Payroll na rozwiązania techniczne
  • Angielski pozwalający na korzystanie z dokumentacji technicznej oraz komunikacji projektowo-biznesowej (B2)

Mile widziane

  • Apache Airflow lub inne narzędzia orkiestracji procesów
  • Znajomość DataBricks
  • Projekty ETL i migracje danych
  • Znajomość SAP, Xpertis/IFS lub podobnych systemów ERP
  • Doświadczenie z platformami danych i rozwiązaniami chmurowymi (Microsoft Azure)
  • Realny wpływ na rozwój architektury integracyjnej i platform danych
  • Udział w projektach transformacji cyfrowej o znaczeniu strategicznym
  • Możliwość pracy z nowoczesnymi technologiami integracyjnymi i analitycznymi
  • Stabilne zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę o pracę
  • Pracę hybrydową lub zdalną dla osób spoza Warszawy
  • Prywatną opiekę medyczną, MultiSport i ubezpieczenie grupowe
  • Możliwość długofalowego rozwoju zawodowego
  • Szkolenia kierunkowe

Kogo szczególnie zachęcamy do aplikowania

Ta rola może być dla Ciebie szczególnie interesująca, jeżeli:

  • lubisz łączyć programowanie z rozwiązywaniem problemów systemowych
  • interesują Cię integracje i przepływy danych pomiędzy wieloma systemami
  • chcesz mieć odpowiedzialność za rozwiązania od developmentu po produkcję
  • lubisz automatyzować procesy zamiast wykonywać je ręcznie
  • cenisz możliwość wpływania na standardy techniczne i architekturę
  • chcesz pracować nad systemami, których niezawodność i jakość danych mają realne znaczenie biznesowe

Nie musisz spełniać każdego punktu z sekcji „mile widziane”. Jeżeli masz mocne podstawy w Pythonie, SQL i integracji systemów oraz podstawową wiedzę na temat zagadnień HR/Payroll, chętnie porozmawiamy.

title: Urban Planner
description:

Experience: 5–7 Years
Location:Port Blair, Andaman & Nicobar Islands

title: Year In Industry Placement - Mechanical Engineering Consultant
description:
Year In Industry Students at TTP use their engineering skillsets to support multi-disciplinary project teams in inventing new products and technologies, utilising commercial aptitude to drive projects forward. To succeed in this role, you’ll demonstrate leadership, build collaborative relationships with clients and ultimately work towards having a strong understanding of industries we work across.

From a technical perspective, you will be involved in all aspects of technology and product development: from invention, to analysis, to prototype design and transfer to manufacture. The diversity in our work means that you can find yourself making a difference in a wide range of applications as vast as building state-of-the-art drug delivery devices, accelerating drug discovery through AI & next-gen DMTA, or developing a 5G NTN handset antenna.

You will have the opportunity to work on multiple such projects at any one time, so over a year at TTP your experiences and applications will be vast, and you can expect to develop and expand your understanding of entirely new fields of science and technology rapidly.

Equal to your technical work, you will also develop as a consultant. This means harnessing your entrepreneurial mindset: building an understanding of the markets we work in, engaging directly with clients to present your findings, and proactively ensuring their requirements are fully understood and met. As you gain experience, you will have opportunities to work on complex projects, build teams, and help expand TTP’s reach by building connections and engaging with clients.

We believe growth happens best in a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely and curiosity is encouraged – this is why we have the requirement for all staff to work on-site five days a week. You'll receive mentorship and guidance when needed, but also the space and trust to take initiative, explore your interests, and shape your own development. You'll be encouraged to contribute early, take ownership of your work, and collaborate across disciplines to deliver impactful solutions.

  • Deep intellectual curiosity and inventiveness, with a desire to understand how things work at a fundamental level. You should have an academic record that reflects your capacity for rigorous, first-principles thinking - being on track for a minimum 2:1 in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline, with strong accompanying A-Levels (or equivalent, i.e. IB qualifications).

  • Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, excited by the opportunity to turn breakthrough technologies into real-world products, ventures, and impact.

  • Proactive and self-starting, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and a drive to make things happen.

  • Collaborative and emotionally intelligent, able to build trust, influence stakeholders, energise those around you, and communicate complex technical ideas with clarity, empathy, and precision, regardless of your audience's background.

  • Strategic and systems-minded, able to see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges and opportunities while considering the commercial aspects of technology product development, and navigate ambiguity while keeping priorities sharp and focused.

We're looking for candidates who want to impact the industry both commercially and technically; those who don't just solve problems - but who seek them out, thrive on them, and elevate those around them while doing so.

We recruit on a rolling basis, so although there is no application deadline, the advert will close once all spaces have been filled. We recommend applying early for the best chance. You must have completed at least 2 years of your degree when your Year in Industry Placement begins, so students at the beginning of second year are welcome to apply.

This placement will start in August/September 2027.

TTP operates from an award-winning campus in green surroundings, just south of Cambridge.

title: Blackjackdealer - Helsingborg
description:

Vi expanderar i Helsingborg och söker dig som vill arbeta deltid med blackjack på barer, restauranger och nattklubbar. Rollen passar dig som trivs i sociala miljöer, gillar att möta människor och samtidigt är trygg med ansvar och tydliga regler.

Om rollen

Att arbeta som dealer hos oss innebär att du:

  • möter gäster på ett professionellt, tydligt och serviceinriktat sätt

Vi tror att du:

  • är lugn under press och bekväm med ansvar

Om oss

Cherry Spelglädje AB är Sveriges ledande aktör inom landbaserat kommersiellt spel. Sedan 1963 har vi bedrivit casinoverksamhet på barer, restauranger, hotell och nattklubbar över hela landet, från Ystad till Kiruna.

Ansökan

Skicka in din ansökan genom att klicka på ”Sök tjänsten” nedan.

Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta:

Maja Anthonsen

0709-53 10 02

maja.anthonsen@cherry.se

Cherry Spelglädje AB har sedan 1963 - genom seriositet, ansvar och engagemang - levererat spelglädje på restauranger, lounger, barer, hotell och nattklubbar över hela Sverige, från Ystad i Söder till Kiruna i Norr och är uppdelat på tre regioner med kontor i Göteborg och Stockholm. title: Teamlead Product Development | FMCG |
description:
Geef richting aan ons Product Development team

Krijg jij energie van het ontwikkelen van mensen, het bouwen aan een team en het verbeteren van processen? Heb je daarnaast ervaring met productontwikkeling binnen FMCG, Personal Care, Home Care of een vergelijkbare productomgeving? Dan is deze functie als Teamlead Product Development bij Topbrands in Oud-Beijerland misschien jouw volgende stap.

Binnen Brand, Private Label & Licences ontwikkelen we producten voor onder andere Personal Care en Home Care. Ons Product Development team bestaat uit Product Developers en Concept Developers. Samen vertalen zij trends, klantvragen en ideeën naar onderscheidende producten die succesvol in de markt kunnen worden gezet.

Het team is enthousiast en volop in ontwikkeling. Als teamlead vind je het leuk om aan het team te bouwen en samen een professionele werkwijze neer te zetten. Je hebt een duidelijke visie, durft richting te geven en zorgt voor heldere prioriteiten en werkafspraken. Je werkt niet structureel mee in de dagelijkse uitvoering, maar bent wel goed op de hoogte van wat er binnen de operatie speelt. Zo kun je inhoudelijk meedenken, knelpunten tijdig herkennen en het team gericht ondersteunen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teamlead Product Development ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang en creëert een omgeving waarin medewerkers verantwoordelijkheid nemen en zich verder kunnen ontwikkelen.

Je houdt overzicht over alles wat er binnen het team speelt en stemt regelmatig af met de Head of Development over prioriteiten, ontwikkelingen en verbetermogelijkheden.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je geeft op een duidelijke en coachende manier leiding aan de Product Developers en Concept Developers.
  • Je bouwt actief aan een professioneel, betrokken en goed samenwerkend team.
  • Je geeft richting, stelt prioriteiten en verdeelt de werkzaamheden.
  • Je bewaakt capaciteit, kwaliteit, voortgang en deadlines.
  • Je voert voortgangs-, ontwikkel- en beoordelingsgesprekken en begeleidt medewerkers in hun ontwikkeling.
  • Je blijft goed aangesloten bij de dagelijkse operatie en ondersteunt bij inhoudelijke vraagstukken wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Je brengt structuur aan in processen, rollen en werkafspraken en zorgt dat deze duidelijk worden vastgelegd.
  • Je signaleert knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden en zorgt dat deze worden opgepakt.
  • Je stimuleert eigenaarschap, kennisdeling en samenwerking binnen het team.
  • Je stemt actief af met teamleads, management, commercie en andere afdelingen.
  • Je ziet toe op het naleven van interne afspraken, kwaliteitsnormen en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een betrokken en benaderbare teamlead die medewerkers ruimte en vertrouwen geeft, maar ook duidelijke richting durft te geven. Je hebt een visie op hoe je een team verder ontwikkelt en vindt het leuk om mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Je houdt overzicht, ook wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt, stelt de juiste prioriteiten en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Daarbij neem je initiatief en zoek je actief de samenwerking met collega’s binnen en buiten het team.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau.
  • Relevante ervaring met productontwikkeling, bij voorkeur binnen Personal Care, Home Care of een vergelijkbare FMCG-omgeving.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in een leidinggevende rol en met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van medewerkers.
  • Ervaring met planning, capaciteitsmanagement en voortgangsbewaking.
  • Ervaring met het verbeteren en praktisch vastleggen van werkprocessen.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk te schakelen tussen verschillende disciplines en niveaus.
  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en samenwerkingsgerichte manier van werken.

Ervaring als Teamlead Product Development, Teamleider Productontwikkeling of in een vergelijkbare leidinggevende functie binnen FMCG sluit goed aan bij deze rol.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Je krijgt een veelzijdige leidinggevende functie binnen een internationale en ondernemende organisatie. Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Een salaris tot € 5.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur
  • Een functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week
  • 28 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen
  • Een goede pensioenregeling, waarbij Topbrands twee derde van de premie betaalt
  • Volop ruimte om jezelf én het team verder te ontwikkelen
  • Extra’s zoals vers fruit op kantoor en activiteiten als bootcamp en padel

Klaar om richting te geven aan ons Product Development team?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Onze sollicitatieprocedure

We starten met een eerste kennismakingsgesprek om te kijken of er een wederzijdse klik is. Is die er? Dan plannen we een tweede gesprek.

Tussen deze gesprekken door nodigen we je uit voor een assessment bij een extern assessmentbureau. Zo krijgen we meer inzicht in jouw kwaliteiten en ontdekken we samen of de functie goed bij je past.

Wil je na het eerste of tweede gesprek nog wat meer sfeer proeven of een dagdeel meelopen? Dat kan natuurlijk. We vinden het belangrijk dat je een goed beeld krijgt van de functie en de werkomgeving.

Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan doen we je graag een passend aanbod.

title: Product Owner – Customer Operations Platform
description:
We are looking for a Product Owner to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide and help us shape the next generation of internal platforms supporting the traveller’s journey.

If you are passionate about building impactful internal tools, leveraging AI to improve operational workflows, and turning complex processes into simple, scalable solutions, keep on reading — you might be the perfect fit for this role.

  • Level - Professional

What your impact will be:

You will play a key role in shaping the technology that supports our customer care and operations teams. Your goal will be to build tools that simplify daily work, improve efficiency, and contribute to a smoother experience for our travellers.

You will join a dynamic environment where priorities can evolve, with a strong focus on shaping and delivering a new AI-ready back-office and customer operations platform.

This role requires strong ownership, structured thinking, and the ability to translate complex operational needs into clear, actionable product requirements. You will work closely with stakeholders, engineering teams, and internal users to deliver scalable solutions step by step.

What You Will Need to Solve:

Shape and deliver a new customer operations platform:

  • Take ownership of key areas of a new AI-ready back-office and customer operations platform
  • Lead discovery activities to understand current workflows, pain points, and improvement opportunities
  • Help define the future operational model in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders
  • Challenge legacy processes and support the transition towards a modern, scalable platform

Drive AI and automation initiatives:

  • Improve internal user productivity and reduce manual workload
  • Contribute to building smarter, faster, and more efficient ways of working
  • Partner with technical teams to turn automation opportunities into concrete product solutions

Shape product delivery and roadmap execution:

  • Contribute to the product roadmap, prioritising initiatives and backlog items based on value, feasibility, and user needs
  • Translate business and platform goals into actionable initiatives, clear requirements, and iterative releases
  • Break down complex problems into manageable steps and high-impact deliverables
  • Continuously adapt priorities based on business needs, user feedback, and product insights

Enhance the customer operations ecosystem:

  • Identify opportunities across the traveller support journey and internal operational processes
  • Contribute to the broader customer operations platform strategy
  • Ensure alignment between tools, processes, internal users, and traveller experience
  • Promote simple, reliable, and user-centric solutions across the platform

Collaborate with stakeholders and teams:

  • Work closely with engineering, operations, customer service, and product teams
  • Gather, structure, and translate business needs into clear product requirements
  • Facilitate alignment between technical feasibility, operational impact, and user needs
  • Support delivery by clarifying priorities, requirements, dependencies, and expected outcomes

Your expertise:

  • Around 5 years of experience in product ownership, product delivery, business analysis, or similar roles
  • Experience working on internal tools, back-office platforms, case management systems, operational platforms, or B2B/SaaS products
  • Strong discovery skills, including process mapping, requirement gathering, and workflow analysis
  • Hands-on experience or solid understanding of AI and automation topics, such as GenAI, LLMs, workflow automation, or intelligent tooling
  • Ability to balance structured product thinking with pragmatic execution
  • Strong user-centric mindset, with empathy for internal users and operational teams
  • Ability to structure complex problems and turn them into clear, actionable product requirements
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written

Desirable:

  • Experience in the travel or travel-tech industry
  • Experience working on large-scale platform or process transformation initiatives
  • Experience with customer service platforms, operational tooling, or workflow automation projects

Why join us:

  • Be part of a major transformation initiative, building next-generation operational tools
  • Work on AI-driven products with real business impact
  • Join an international, fast-paced, and collaborative environment
  • Contribute to improving the experience of both internal teams and millions of travellers

Perks of working with us:

How we work together:

  • An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities)
  • Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays
  • Flexible start and end of the working day

Wish you were here? We do, too!

Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging:

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

Eligibility criteria:

title: (Senior) Technical Product Manager - Mobile Platform (m/f/x)
description:

As Product Manager for Mobile Core, you define product direction for shared mobile foundations and work with an Engineering Manager, QA engineers, and iOS and Android engineers. Your closest customers are the product and engineering teams that build into our apps.

  • Product management experience across native iOS and Android products, with sound product judgment across both platforms. This role is not tied to a particular implementation framework.
  • Experience in finance, FinTech, banking, brokerage, mobile platform, app-foundation, core-experience, or developer-enablement products is a strong plus.
  • Technical depth to work credibly with mobile engineers on architecture, platform constraints, reliability, and release trade-offs.
  • Experience managing cross-team releases, dependencies, or shared product capabilities, including adoption or migration across teams.

title: Inspector (Architectural)
description:
The Architectural Inspector is responsible for conducting day-to-day site inspections and quality control for all architectural, finishing, and building envelope works across the project facilities. This role ensures that interior/exterior architectural executions, finishing materials, fixtures, and spatial layouts strictly comply with approved design drawings, mock-ups, project specifications, and quality standards.

This role works closely with the site engineering team and technical team, contractor teams, and project QA/QC and HSE personnel to maintain high standards of architectural workmanship and material compliance on-site.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct daily routine site inspections for ongoing architectural works, internal and external.
• Verify that all architectural materials delivered to the site match approved Material Approval Requests (MARs), sample boards, and project specifications.
• Inspect work against approved mock-ups, shop drawings, and finish schedules to ensure high standards of craftsmanship and finish quality.
• Log architectural non-conformances, issue internal snag lists, and perform re-inspections to ensure closed-out Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and punch-list items are properly rectified.
• Review and coordinate with the technical team for contractor technical submittals, material samples, shop drawings, and Requests for Inspection (RFIs) related to architectural packages.
• Verify that builder's works, MEP penetrations, and access panels are neatly integrated into architectural surfaces without compromising aesthetics or functional integrity.
• Coordinate on-site with civil, structural, and MEP inspectors to ensure proper sequencing of architectural works.
• Ensure architectural details comply with accessibility standards, fire-rated assembly requirements, and room function specifications across all facilities (administrative, security, and operational spaces).
• Monitor contractor daily progress and architectural activities and fit-out trades.
• Maintain accurate daily inspection logs and inspection request (WIR/IR) records.
• Assist the Senior Site Supervision Engineer in preparing data for weekly and monthly progress reports regarding architectural milestones.
• Collaborate with the HSE Team during site walks to ensure safe working environments for finishing trades, particularly regarding scaffolding setups, elevated work platforms, dust control, and paint/chemical storage safety.

  • Bachelor’s Degree, Architectural Engineering, or a relevant discipline.
  • Minimum of 10+ years of direct site inspection experience in architectural finishes, interior fit-outs, building envelopes, and multi-building complex construction.
  • Aviation Experience is preferred
  • Prior site experience on aviation building projects, high-spec commercial buildings, or large-scale multi-facility complexes is preferred.
  • Deep practical knowledge of architectural construction activities and installation methods.
  • Ability to read and interpret detailed architectural shop drawings, finish schedules, and material specs.
  • Familiarity with local building codes, international architectural quality standards, and fire-rated assembly requirements.
  • Proficiency in document control platforms (Aconex), CAD software (AutoCAD), and MS Office.
  • Strong eye for detail, quality control mindset
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are a plus.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
REQUIREMENTS:

  • Deep understanding of LLMs (e.g., GPTs, Llama, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Mistral, BERT-family models) and their architectures (Transformers)
